hogarth_serpentine_line_of_grace.text: A three-dimensional compositional path that winds and twists through depth, evidenced by changing contour orientation, occlusion and reappearance, and coherent shifts of light or material around the form. | 윤곽이 깊이 방향으로 비틀리며 가려졌다 다시 나타나는 입체적 곡선 경로 | a winding path whose contour orientation and light change as it turns in depth | three-dimensional line of grace carried by form drape and occlusion | winding three-dimensional path | serpentine twist through depth | 깊이 방향으로 비트는 곡선 | contour orientation changes around the form | front side and back directions evolve | 형태를 돌며 바뀌는 윤곽 방향 | path disappears behind and reappears | depth occlusion confirms the winding route | 가려졌다 다시 나타나는 경로 | light and material response follow the twist | drape highlight and shadow rotate together | 재질과 빛이 비틀림을 따라감 | three-dimensional winding path | changing contour orientation | occlusion and reappearance | rotating drape light and shadow | single coherent depth route | distinct from planar S curve

hourglass_silhouette_relation.text: An adult bilateral silhouette relation in which the upper torso and hip regions visibly expand around a comparatively narrower waist, with smooth transitions whose apparent strength is separated from pose, viewpoint, and garment cinching. | 상체와 골반이 비교적 좁은 허리 양쪽으로 부드럽게 확장되는 성인 실루엣 관계 | a bilateral upper-torso waist and hip width relation with smooth transitions | hourglass reading separated from belt corset pose and camera effects | adult front or restrained three-quarter bilateral silhouette | both side contours remain visible | 성인 정면 또는 완만한 사선 양측 실루엣 | upper torso expands above the waist | shoulder or bust region forms the upper mass | 허리 위 상체가 확장되는 윤곽 | comparatively narrower natural waist | inward bilateral waist transition | 상대적으로 좁아지는 양쪽 허리 | hips expand below the waist | bilateral waist-to-hip flare | 허리 아래 골반의 양측 확장 | pose viewpoint and garment cinching declared separately | natural relation distinguished from belt or corset | 자세 시점 의복 조임과 분리 | adult bilateral silhouette | upper torso expansion | comparatively narrower waist | hip expansion | smooth waist transitions | pose viewpoint and garment separated | no fixed ratio

slender_linear_build.text: An adult body-build relation with consistently narrow transverse volume through torso and limbs, retaining coherent joint transitions across the visible full body. | 성인 몸통과 팔다리의 가로 볼륨이 전반적으로 가늘게 이어지는 선형 체형 | narrow transverse torso and limb volume with coherent joint transitions | slenderness separated from stature and muscular definition | adult head-to-feet body read | torso and both limbs remain comparable | 성인 전신의 몸통과 팔다리가 함께 보임 | consistently narrow transverse torso volume | restrained ribcage waist and pelvic breadth | 몸통의 가로 볼륨이 일관되게 좁음 | slender arm and leg volumes | longitudinal limb axes dominate transverse thickness | 팔다리의 세로축이 가로 두께보다 우세 | torso and limbs share narrow transverse proportions in the same view | ribcage waist pelvis and limb transitions remain comparable | 같은 화면에서 몸통과 팔다리의 가로 비율과 관절 전환이 함께 보임 | adult full-body relation | narrow transverse torso volume | narrow limb volume | coherent joint transitions | neutral geometry

soft_full_figure_volume.text: An adult soft-tissue build relation with substantial continuous volume across multiple torso and limb regions, with smooth transitions across the ribcage, waist, abdomen, hips, upper arms, and thighs. | 성인 몸통과 팔다리 여러 구간에 부드러운 볼륨이 연속되는 풍부한 체형 | substantial soft volume distributed across torso hips upper arms and thighs | fullness shown without forcing an hourglass silhouette | adult torso arms hips and thighs remain readable | multiple body regions share the build relation | 성인 몸통 팔 골반 허벅지가 함께 보임 | substantial continuous soft torso volume | ribcage waist abdomen and hip transitions remain smooth | 몸통의 부드러운 볼륨 전환 | full upper-arm and thigh volume | soft tissue continues through limb transitions | 위팔과 허벅지의 풍부한 볼륨 | torso and limb volumes remain comparable across one coherent view | visible waist contour remains distinct within the continuous soft volume | 한 화면의 연속된 부드러운 볼륨 안에서 허리 윤곽과 팔다리 비율이 함께 읽힘 | adult multiregion body read | substantial soft torso volume | full upper arms | full thighs | smooth transitions

curvilinear_figure_relation.text: An adult whole-body relation with multiple visible outward and inward contour transitions across upper torso, natural waist, hips, and thighs, without requiring an hourglass balance, large bust, high body weight, or attractiveness judgment. | 성인 상체 자연 허리 골반 허벅지 사이에 여러 안팎 곡선 전환이 이어지는 체형 | multiple coherent convex and concave contour transitions across the body | curvilinear geometry independent of one fixed silhouette class | adult bilateral torso and hip contours remain visible | both outer body edges support the reading | 성인 몸통과 골반의 양측 외곽선 | upper torso curves inward toward the natural waist | readable convex-to-concave upper transition | 상체에서 자연 허리로 이어지는 곡선 | waist curves outward through hip and upper thigh | readable concave-to-convex lower transition | 허리에서 골반과 허벅지로 이어지는 곡선 | bust size waist class and body weight declared separately | no attractiveness or glamour-style inference | 가슴 크기 체중 모래시계 매력과 분리 | adult bilateral contours | upper-torso inward transition | waist outward transition | hip and thigh continuity | multiple convex and concave changes | silhouette class separate | glamour style separate

bust_prominence_relation.text: An adult regional relation in which bilateral breast volume projects visibly from the ribcage and reads relative to the natural waist, with coherent front and side projection. | 성인 양측 가슴 볼륨이 흉곽 기준으로 앞과 옆으로 돌출되고 자연 허리와 비교되는 관계 | bilateral bust projection anchored to the ribcage rather than a generic upper-torso crop | regional bust prominence kept separate from curvy or hourglass labels | adult bilateral upper torso remains visible | both bust contours and the natural waist remain readable | 성인 상체 양측과 자연 허리가 함께 보임 | ribcage breadth and depth remain the reference | shoulders and thorax anchor the regional volume | 흉곽의 폭과 깊이가 기준으로 보임 | bilateral bust volume projects from the ribcage | front and side projection remain coherent | 양측 가슴 볼륨의 앞옆 돌출 | ribcage bust waist and hip contours remain separately readable | the regional projection stays anchored to visible ribcage and natural waist landmarks | 흉곽 가슴 허리 골반의 윤곽이 각각 구분되며 지역 돌출의 기준이 보임 | adult bilateral upper torso | ribcage reference | bilateral breast volume | front and side projection | natural waist relation | neutral regional geometry

top_hourglass_silhouette_relation.text: An adult hourglass-family silhouette with visible upper-torso and hip expansion around a narrower natural waist, where the upper expansion is directionally more dominant than the lower expansion without becoming a waistless inverted triangle. | 성인 상체와 골반이 좁은 자연 허리 양쪽으로 확장되되 상부 폭과 볼륨이 더 우세한 관계 | hourglass waist evidence plus an upper-dominant bilateral balance | upper dominance retained without erasing the waist or lower expansion | adult front or restrained three-quarter bilateral silhouette | both outer torso contours remain visible | 성인 몸통의 양측 외곽선이 함께 보임 | comparatively narrower natural waist | bilateral inward waist transition | 상대적으로 좁은 자연 허리 | upper torso and hips both expand away from the waist | hourglass-family upper and lower masses | 허리 위아래가 모두 확장됨 | upper expansion visibly exceeds lower expansion | shoulder ribcage or bust owns the upper dominance | 상부 확장이 하부보다 우세 | adult bilateral silhouette | narrow natural waist | upper and lower expansion | upper-dominant balance | shoulder ribcage or bust owner | not inverted triangle | no numeric ratio

bottom_hourglass_silhouette_relation.text: An adult hourglass-family silhouette with visible upper-torso and hip expansion around a narrower natural waist, where the lower hip and upper-thigh expansion is directionally more dominant than the upper expansion without becoming a waistless triangle. | 성인 상체와 골반이 좁은 자연 허리 양쪽으로 확장되되 골반과 상부 허벅지가 더 우세한 관계 | hourglass waist evidence plus a lower-dominant bilateral balance | lower dominance retained without erasing the upper expansion | adult front or restrained three-quarter bilateral silhouette | both outer torso contours remain visible | 성인 몸통의 양측 외곽선이 함께 보임 | comparatively narrower natural waist | bilateral inward waist transition | 상대적으로 좁은 자연 허리 | upper torso and hips both expand away from the waist | hourglass-family upper and lower masses | 허리 위아래가 모두 확장됨 | hip and upper-thigh expansion visibly exceeds upper expansion | pelvis outer hip or thigh owns the lower dominance | 하부 확장이 상부보다 우세 | adult bilateral silhouette | narrow natural waist | upper and lower expansion | lower-dominant balance | pelvis hip or thigh owner | not plain triangle | no numeric ratio

triangle_lower_body_dominant_relation.text: An adult bilateral silhouette in which pelvic, outer-hip, and upper-thigh breadth visibly exceeds the upper torso, with the waist transition readable but no mandatory high-hip shelf, fixed ratio, or implication about weight or attractiveness. | 성인 골반 바깥 엉덩이 상부 허벅지의 폭이 상체보다 우세한 양측 실루엣 | lower-body breadth dominates the shoulder and ribcage region | pear-family relation without requiring a spoon-like high-hip shelf | adult bilateral torso-to-thigh silhouette | both outer edges remain visible | 성인 상체부터 허벅지까지 양측 윤곽 | shoulder and ribcage breadth remain the upper reference | upper torso is visibly narrower than the lower region | 어깨와 흉곽 폭이 상부 기준 | pelvis outer hips and upper thighs expand coherently | waist-to-hip flare continues into thighs | 골반 엉덩이 상부 허벅지의 연속 확장 | lower breadth visibly exceeds upper breadth | dominance persists without stance or padding | 하체 폭이 상체보다 우세 | adult bilateral silhouette | shoulder ribcage reference | pelvic and outer-hip expansion | upper-thigh continuity | lower-body dominance | high-hip shelf optional | no fixed ratio

rectangle_silhouette_relation.text: An adult bilateral silhouette with relatively small width change among upper torso, natural waist, and hips, producing low waist indentation while preserving anatomical transitions and avoiding any claim of exact equality or a literal geometric outline. | 성인 상체 자연 허리 골반 사이의 폭 변화가 비교적 작고 허리 함몰이 약한 양측 실루엣 | low waist definition across a coherent torso-to-hip contour | straight silhouette relation without literal box geometry or fixed equality | adult front or restrained three-quarter bilateral silhouette | both torso edges remain visible | 성인 몸통의 양측 외곽선이 함께 보임 | upper torso breadth anchors the width comparison | shoulder and ribcage remain readable | 어깨와 흉곽 폭이 기준으로 보임 | small inward change at the natural waist | low bilateral waist indentation | 자연 허리의 양측 함몰이 약함 | hips continue with relatively small width change | torso waist and hips form a coherent near-straight relation | 몸통 허리 골반의 폭 변화가 작게 이어짐 | adult bilateral silhouette | upper torso reference | small width change | low natural-waist indentation | hip continuity | anatomical transitions | no exact equality

inverted_triangle_upper_body_dominant_re.text: An adult bilateral silhouette in which declared shoulder, ribcage, or combined upper-torso breadth visibly exceeds pelvic and outer-hip breadth, with no requirement for a deeply indented waist and no substitution by bust prominence alone. | 성인 어깨 흉곽 또는 상부 몸통 폭이 골반과 바깥 엉덩이 폭보다 우세한 양측 실루엣 | upper-body breadth tapers toward a comparatively narrower pelvis | upper dominance separated from bust-only prominence and top hourglass | adult bilateral shoulder-to-hip silhouette | both upper and lower outer contours remain visible | 성인 어깨부터 골반까지 양측 윤곽 | shoulder ribcage or combined upper-torso breadth is declared | upper owner is visible beyond bust projection alone | 어깨 흉곽 등 상부 폭의 소유자가 명시됨 | pelvis and outer hips form a comparatively narrower reference | upper torso tapers toward the lower body | 골반과 바깥 엉덩이가 상대적으로 좁음 | upper breadth visibly exceeds lower breadth | dominance persists without pads pose or low angle | 상체 폭의 우세가 의복과 시점 없이 유지 | adult bilateral shoulder-to-hip read | declared shoulder or ribcage owner | upper-torso breadth | narrower pelvis and outer hips | upper-body dominance | bust prominence separate | waist class optional

oval_central_torso_silhouette_relation.text: An adult torso relation in which central abdominal and waist width or sagittal depth forms a broad rounded volume between upper torso and pelvis, with weak waist indentation and gradual contour transitions. | 성인 흉곽과 골반 사이 중앙 복부와 허리의 폭 또는 깊이가 둥글게 넓어지고 허리 함몰이 약한 관계 | broad rounded central-torso volume visible in both frontal width and oblique depth | a rounded central torso contour with gradual upper and lower transitions | adult front and restrained oblique torso evidence | central width and sagittal depth remain readable | 성인 중앙 몸통의 정면 폭과 사선 깊이가 함께 보임 | ribcage and pelvis anchor the central comparison | upper and lower torso landmarks remain visible | 흉곽과 골반이 중앙 볼륨의 기준 | broad rounded abdominal and waist volume | central torso expands in width or sagittal depth | 중앙 복부와 허리의 둥근 폭 또는 깊이 | natural waist indentation remains weak | central contour changes gradually rather than pinching inward | 자연 허리 함몰이 약하고 완만함 | adult front-oblique torso read | ribcage and pelvis anchors | rounded central abdominal volume | central width and sagittal depth | weak natural-waist indentation | gradual transitions

diamond_central_torso_silhouette_relatio.text: An adult bilateral and oblique torso relation in which the central waist-abdomen region forms the widest or deepest torso zone and visibly tapers toward both the upper torso and pelvis. | 성인 중앙 허리와 복부가 몸통에서 가장 넓거나 깊게 보이고 상체와 골반 양쪽으로 가늘어지는 관계 | central-torso maximum with visible upward and downward taper | diamond relation distinguished from the more rounded gradual oval transition | adult bilateral and restrained oblique torso evidence | central width and depth remain comparable | 성인 몸통 양측 폭과 사선 깊이가 함께 보임 | waist-abdomen region forms the central maximum | central torso is widest or deepest | 허리 복부가 중앙 최대 폭 또는 깊이 | central volume tapers toward upper torso and shoulders | upper contour narrows away from the central maximum | 중앙에서 상체 방향으로 가늘어짐 | central volume tapers toward pelvis and outer hips | lower contour narrows away from the central maximum | 중앙에서 골반 방향으로 가늘어짐 | adult bilateral-oblique torso read | central waist-abdomen maximum | frontal width and sagittal depth | upward taper | downward taper | oval boundary

achievement_reward_smile.text: A context-bound positive display immediately after the same adult visibly completes or verifies a difficult task, combining a readable successful outcome with a mostly symmetric smile, attention to the result, and a post-success action consequence; it does not prove a hidden or genuine emotional state. | 성인 작업자가 고친 장치의 정상 작동을 확인한 직후 입꼬리와 볼이 함께 올라가는 장면 | a mostly symmetric lip-corner pull as the adult looks at the working result they just produced | task completion, visible success feedback, result-directed attention, and a restrained celebratory response in one frame | the same adult visibly completes or verifies the task | working device restored signal finished craft or passed test | 본인이 수행한 과업의 성공 결과가 화면에 보임 | both lip corners lift with cheek movement | mostly symmetric closed or slightly open smile | 양쪽 입꼬리와 볼의 상승이 함께 보임 | eyes remain on the successful result | gaze returns from the result to a collaborator | 성공 결과 또는 함께한 사람을 향한 시선 | hand releases the completed control or gives a small celebratory gesture | collaborator responds to the restored outcome | 완료 직후 손의 긴장이 풀리거나 작은 축하 동작이 이어짐 | visible authored success result | mostly symmetric lip-corner pull | cheek movement | off-camera result-directed irises | post-success timing | open hand separated from the completed control | small release or celebration action | no hidden-state claim

affiliative_reassurance_smile.text: A restrained relationship-directed smile used while one adult performs a concrete supportive action toward a visibly concerned adult peer, with mutual orientation and an observable easing or acceptance response; the cues show an interaction function, not sincerity, consent, trustworthiness, or personality. | 걱정하는 성인 동료에게 물건을 건네며 작게 닫힌 미소를 보이고 상대가 받아드는 장면 | a small lip-pressed smile paired with a practical helping action and mutual orientation | supportive handoff, restrained friendly mouth action, and visible peer response rather than a solo friendly portrait | a visibly concerned adult peer shares the frame | peer watches the uncertain damaged or missing item | 걱정하거나 긴장한 성인 동료가 같은 화면에 보임 | small closed or lip-pressed smile | soft bilateral lip-corner lift without a broad victory grin | 작고 절제된 양측 입꼬리 상승 | returns repairs steadies or offers the needed object | open handoff or shoulder-level supportive gesture | 필요한 물건을 돌려주거나 실제 도움을 수행함 | peer accepts the handoff or visibly eases posture | mutual gaze or shared target closes the interaction | 동료가 받아들이거나 자세의 긴장을 늦추는 결과 | concerned adult peer | small restrained bilateral smile | mutual orientation | practical supportive handoff | peer acceptance or easing | relationship-directed function | no sincerity inference

decision_uncertainty_display.text: A visible pre-decision display in which an adult compares at least two readable alternatives, the still-frame eyeline lands on one alternative while head or tool geometry keeps both in active comparison, slight brow or mouth tension accompanies a paused hand or tool, and the choice remains unresolved; no single face action is treated as proof of confusion. | 두 개의 실제 선택지를 번갈아 보던 중 한 선택지에 시선이 닿고 손은 둘 사이에서 멈춘 성인의 비교 장면 | irises landing on one labeled alternative while head angle and a paused reach preserve both options in the comparison | an unresolved choice shown by targets, still-frame comparison geometry, restrained facial tension, and interrupted action | two distinct physical options remain visible | two swatches samples routes or controls can be compared | 서로 다른 두 선택 대상이 동시에 보임 | irises land on one option while head or tool geometry remains between both | gaze lands on one visible alternative during a shift from the other | 시선은 한 선택지에 닿고 머리나 도구는 두 선택지 사이의 비교축을 유지함 | slight brow asymmetry or knit with mild lip tension | one brow lifts while the mouth remains lightly pressed | 한쪽 눈썹 변화와 약한 입술 긴장이 함께 보임 | hand tool or pen pauses midway between options | reach stops before touching either alternative | 손이나 도구가 선택 전 중간에서 멈춤 | neither option has yet been selected | both alternatives remain available and unchanged | 어느 선택도 아직 실행되지 않음 | two visible alternatives | still-frame comparison eyeline | head or tool axis spanning both options | slight brow asymmetry | mild lip tension | paused hand between options | unresolved choice | not face-only confusion

embarrassment_repair_display.text: A short social-repair sequence after an adult causes a minor, non-harmful, visible mishap: the adult briefly breaks gaze or lowers the head, shows a small closed smile or face-touch cue, performs concrete restitution, and receives an observable peer response; the display is not a moral or personality diagnosis. | 가벼운 공개 실수 직후 잠깐 시선을 떼고 작게 웃으며 흩어진 물건을 다시 정리하는 성인 | a brief gaze break and small closed smile while the adult immediately repairs a harmless social mishap | minor visible mistake, restrained face or hand-to-face cue, concrete restitution, and peer acceptance in one scene | spilled lightweight items dropped cards or a harmless mix-up remains visible | no injury threat or serious damage | 사소하고 무해한 실수의 결과가 보임 | head dips or gaze breaks then starts to return | small closed smile with a brief cheek or face touch | 고개나 시선을 잠깐 피한 뒤 작은 닫힌 미소 또는 얼굴 만짐 | gathers reorders wipes replaces or returns the affected items | hands actively restore the disrupted arrangement | 흩어진 것을 줍거나 원상태로 되돌리는 수습 행동 | adult peer helps accepts or gives an open-palm okay response | shared action visibly de-escalates the moment | 동료가 돕거나 받아들이는 관찰 가능한 반응 | minor harmless visible mishap | brief gaze break then return | small closed smile or face touch | immediate restitution action | peer help or acceptance | social repair sequence | no moral diagnosis

verified_safety_relief.text: A post-verification release display after an adult checks a previously uncertain but non-graphic safety condition and receives visible evidence that a person, system, or route is safe, combining the verification action with loosened shoulders, jaw or eyelids and an immediate practical consequence; face alone does not establish relief. | 경보 뒤 게이지와 동료의 안전 표시를 직접 확인하고 어깨와 턱의 긴장을 늦추는 성인 | an adult checks the safe reading before shoulders drop, jaw parts slightly, and the working hand releases | prior risk marker, explicit safety confirmation, tension release, and resumed safe action in one post-event frame | inactive alarm warning residue stopped machinery or blocked route shows what was uncertain | non-graphic risk context remains readable | 이전에 위험 가능성이 있었음을 보여주는 경보 또는 정지 단서 | adult reads a safe gauge indicator signal or colleague check | hand touches or points to the confirmed safe status | 게이지 신호 또는 동료 상태를 직접 확인함 | shoulders visibly drop while jaw loosens or lips part | eyelids soften and gripping hand releases | 어깨 턱 눈꺼풀 손의 긴장이 눈에 띄게 풀림 | the adult resumes the safe task or lowers the emergency tool | a colleague returns to work after confirmation | 확인 뒤 비상 도구를 내리거나 안전한 작업을 재개함 | prior non-graphic risk marker | explicit safe-status verification | shoulder and jaw release | softened eyelids or released grip | post-verification consequence | temporal after-safety relation | not face-only relief

self_possessed_sensual_presence.text: An unmistakably adult subject creates a self-directed sensual presence through visible agency, a grounded composed posture, controlled face and gaze actions, and a readable garment-material relationship; the display does not require invitation toward a viewer or partner and does not establish availability, consent, personality, or hidden desire. | 성인 인물이 자신의 작업과 선택을 계속 주도하면서 안정된 자세와 절제된 시선, 몸을 따라 흐르는 직물의 물성을 함께 보여주는 장면 | an adult remains occupied with a self-directed decision while a grounded stance, controlled expression, and tactile drape create sensory presence | the visual appeal survives removal of camera-directed invitation because agency posture and material response remain visible | unmistakably adult subject makes or completes her own visible choice | self-directed action remains the scene's causal center | 성인 인물이 자신의 선택과 행동을 직접 주도함 | stable support path with open but controlled posture | weight remains grounded while shoulders and neck stay composed | 지지 경로가 보이는 안정되고 침착한 자세 | alert engaged eyes and a restrained mouth action | gaze belongs to the subject's task or chosen focal point rather than proving invitation | 깨어 있는 시선과 절제된 입매가 자기 행동에 연결됨 | fabric drape specular flow or garment edge responds to posture and movement | selective coverage and material behavior remain physically readable | 직물의 드레이프와 반사가 자세 및 움직임에 따라 읽힘 | unmistakably adult self-directed subject | visible choice or authored task | grounded open posture | alert controlled gaze | restrained mouth action | bias-cut or body-skimming drape | opaque satin specular flow | selective coverage with readable garment edges | sensory material response without viewer invitation | no consent or availability inference

target_directed_seductive_display.text: An unmistakably adult subject directs a coordinated gaze, face action, body orientation, and concrete invitation or lure action toward one identifiable adult target or explicitly defined viewer role, with a visible target-side consequence when a partner is in frame; this is depicted behavior and never proof of consent, availability, or private intention. | 한 명의 성인 상대에게 시선과 몸 방향을 맞추고 반쯤 열린 문이나 내민 물건으로 다가오라는 행동을 하며 상대의 멈춤이나 접근 반응이 보이는 장면 | an adult aligns eyes face and torso toward the same adult target while a threshold or offered object makes the invitation concrete | viewer-directed address is explicit in the camera role and supported by an invitation action rather than direct gaze alone | one identifiable adult target or explicitly defined adult viewer role | eyes face action and body address the same adult counterpart | 한 명의 동일한 성인 상대를 향함 | irises head and torso converge toward the same target | engaged lowered lids remain awake and target-locked | 눈과 머리와 몸 방향이 같은 상대에게 수렴함 | holds a threshold open extends an object or clears a place for the target | a visible approach or invitation action changes the space between them | 문턱 물건 또는 자리를 이용한 구체적 초대 행동 | the adult target pauses steps closer or reaches toward the offered action | viewer role is named by the camera position and invitation geometry | 상대가 멈추거나 다가오거나 손을 내미는 반응 | one identifiable adult target | same-target iris head torso alignment | awake lowered-lid engagement | small controlled mouth action | threshold invitation | offered object or cleared place | target pause reach or approach response | viewer role defined by camera geometry | depicted behavior not hidden intent | no consent inference

playful_flirtation_interaction.text: A bounded interaction between unmistakably adult participants in which one adult performs a playful approach-withdrawal or offer-withdraw action toward the same adult target, a restrained playful face action accompanies that event, and the target visibly notices or responds; friendliness, service behavior, or a solo playful portrait is insufficient. | 성인 상대에게 물건을 건네려다 살짝 거두며 곁눈질하고 상대가 웃거나 손을 멈추는 장면 | an adult half-offers then lightly withdraws an object while returning a side glance to the same adult partner | the target's visible reach or amused pause distinguishes the teasing exchange from ordinary friendliness | two unmistakably adult participants or one adult plus an explicit adult viewer-recipient role | same adult target remains identifiable across the exchange | 성인 참여자와 동일한 성인 상대가 분명함 | half-offers then lightly withdraws an object | starts to leave then returns a glance and leaves the threshold open | 다가감과 물러남이 하나의 미완 행동으로 보임 | small asymmetric closed-lip smile with engaged eyes | one mouth corner lifts while the gaze returns to the same target | 깨어 있는 눈과 작은 비대칭 닫힌 미소 | the adult target pauses reaches or answers with a restrained amused reaction | recipient response stays tied to the same object or threshold | 상대가 같은 물건이나 문턱 행동에 반응함 | two unmistakably adult participants | same adult recipient | half-offer then light withdrawal | departure then returned glance | small asymmetric closed-lip smile | engaged target-directed eyes | recipient reach pause or restrained amusement | single unfinished teasing beat | not customer service | fashion coquette kept separate

controlled_languid_movement_display.text: An unmistakably adult subject is captured in one deliberate low-tempo transition whose start and destination remain spatially readable, while stable support, alert task-linked attention, and coherent fabric, hair, hand, or object lag distinguish controlled pacing from sleep, intoxication, illness, collapse, or a settled static pose; the movement is not sexual by default. | 성인 인물이 회전이나 걸음을 천천히 이어가는 중간 단계에서 지지 발과 도착 방향, 뒤따르는 직물의 지연이 함께 보이는 장면 | an adult pauses mid-turn with one planted support path, an unfinished destination, and fabric lag showing deliberate low tempo | alert eyes and a controlled hand trajectory keep the slow movement distinct from fatigue or intoxication | start position and unfinished destination remain visible | mid-turn mid-step or mid-reach transition has not settled | 시작점과 도착점 사이의 미완 동작 단계 | one planted support path carries the body through the transition | balance and joint continuity remain controlled | 지지 발과 관절 연속성이 안정적으로 보임 | awake eyes remain tied to the chosen destination or task | head and hand trajectory show deliberate control | 깨어 있는 시선이 동작의 목표와 연결됨 | fabric hair hand or carried object trails the same movement direction | small directional lag makes low tempo visible | 직물 머리카락 손 또는 물건의 지연이 같은 동작 방향을 따름 | unmistakably adult moving subject | unfinished turn step or reach | visible start and destination | one planted support path | awake task-linked gaze | controlled hand trajectory | fabric or hair directional lag | low-tempo transition | joint continuity | not sexual by default

decadent_languor_environment.text: An unmistakably adult subject remains alert and self-directed inside an environment that visibly carries both former luxury and material after-event decline, with an unfinished slow action linking the adult to the residue; dark color, red light, gothic styling, or a reclining pose alone does not establish decadence or sensuality. | 성인 인물이 행사가 끝난 낡은 호화 호텔에서 꺼진 촛농과 눌린 벨벳, 넘어진 잔을 정리하며 천천히 다음 행동으로 옮겨가는 장면 | an alert adult crosses a faded hotel salon after an event, touching worn velvet while wax and displaced objects show excess and aftermath | former luxury, physical decay, after-event residue, and one controlled unfinished action coexist | velvet marble gilding satin or crystal retains signs of former luxury | ornate material remains physically identifiable | 과거의 호화를 보여주는 벨벳 대리석 금박 또는 크리스털 | worn nap cracked finish tarnish dust or peeling edge interrupts the luxury | material decline belongs to the same surfaces | 같은 호화 표면에 마모 균열 변색 또는 먼지가 보임 | spent wax displaced glassware wilted flowers or compressed seating shows a recent event has ended | residue creates a before-now temporal relation | 꺼진 촛농 흐트러진 잔 시든 꽃 등 사건 이후의 흔적 | awake adult slowly gathers crosses adjusts or closes something without settling | self-directed action links the adult to the residue | 깨어 있는 성인이 잔해와 연결된 미완 행동을 주도함 | unmistakably adult alert subject | former luxury material | worn velvet or cracked finish | tarnish dust or peeling edge | spent wax or displaced glassware | wilted flowers or compressed seating | after-event temporal residue | slow unfinished self-directed action | material contact | dark color kept optional

oval_face_contour_relation.text: A complete face perimeter that is moderately longer than wide, with the lateral zygomatic region subtly widest, a smooth transition toward a somewhat narrower forehead and jaw, and a continuous soft taper into a narrow rounded chin. | 정면에서 얼굴 세로가 폭보다 적당히 길고 광대 부근이 살짝 가장 넓으며 턱끝으로 부드럽게 좁아지는 얼굴 | a moderately elongated face whose widest cheek region flows smoothly toward a narrower rounded chin | an egg-like full facial contour without a broad jaw corner or a sharply pointed lower face | hairline temples cheek edges jawlines and chin remain visible | complete bilateral face contour | 헤어라인부터 턱끝까지 양쪽 외곽이 보임 | face is moderately longer than wide | vertical span exceeds width without elongation | 세로 길이가 가로 폭보다 적당히 김 | zygomatic region is subtly widest | cheek width slightly exceeds forehead and jaw | 광대 부근이 이마와 하악보다 약간 넓음 | jaw narrows smoothly into a rounded chin | no abrupt gonial corner interrupts the taper | 턱선이 둥근 턱끝으로 매끄럽게 좁아짐 | hair lens expression light and makeup do not substitute for contour | neutral distortion-controlled face-shape read | 머리카락 표정 조명과 원근 효과를 분리함 | complete bilateral face perimeter | moderately longer than wide | subtly widest zygomatic region | somewhat narrower forehead | somewhat narrower jaw | smooth temple-to-cheek transition | continuous lower-face taper | narrow rounded chin | neutral expression | distortion-controlled portrait perspective

round_compact_face_relation.text: A complete compact face perimeter whose vertical length stays close to its transverse width, with broad cheek-to-cheek presence and a continuously curved jaw that ends in a short rounded chin. | 얼굴 세로와 가로가 비슷하고 볼 부근이 넓게 이어지며 턱선이 짧고 둥근 얼굴 | a compact face with near-equal length and width and no abrupt angular jaw corner | broad cheek width continuing through a curved lower contour into a short rounded chin | complete bilateral face contour remains visible | hairline cheek edges jawlines and chin are unobscured | 얼굴 양쪽 외곽 전체가 보임 | facial length stays close to width | compact vertical-to-transverse relation | 세로 길이와 가로 폭이 비슷함 | cheek-to-cheek region carries broad width | rounded lateral cheek presence | 볼 부근의 가로 폭이 넓게 이어짐 | soft curved jaw ends in a short rounded chin | no broad angular corner or pointed tip | 둥근 턱선이 짧은 둥근 턱끝으로 이어짐 | cheek fullness smile lens and hair do not substitute for the whole shape | neutral distortion-controlled contour read | 볼살 미소 원근과 헤어 효과를 분리함 | complete bilateral face perimeter | length close to width | compact facial span | broad cheek-to-cheek region | soft continuous side contour | curved lower jaw | short rounded chin | no isolated cheek-fullness substitute | neutral expression | controlled portrait perspective

oblong_elongated_face_relation.text: A complete face perimeter visibly longer than wide, with forehead, zygomatic, and bigonial widths remaining comparatively parallel and an elongated lower contour that ends softly rather than in a broad angular jaw. | 이마·광대·턱 폭이 크게 벌어지지 않은 채 얼굴 세로가 뚜렷이 긴 얼굴 | an elongated face with relatively parallel side widths and a softly ended lower contour | more vertical extension than an oval face without the broad jaw corners of a rectangle | complete bilateral hairline-to-chin contour | both sides of the facial perimeter stay visible | 얼굴 세로 외곽 전체가 보임 | face is visibly longer than wide | vertical facial span is clearly dominant | 얼굴 세로 길이가 가로 폭보다 뚜렷이 김 | forehead cheek and jaw widths remain comparatively parallel | no single transverse region dominates strongly | 이마 광대 하악 폭이 비교적 평행함 | elongated lower face ends softly | jaw lacks a broad square corner | 길어진 하안면이 넓은 각진 턱 없이 부드럽게 끝남 | crop head pitch hairstyle and lens stretch remain separate | neutral distortion-controlled vertical read | 크롭 고개 각도 헤어와 렌즈 늘림을 분리함 | complete hairline-to-chin perimeter | visibly longer than wide | vertical span dominant | comparatively parallel forehead width | comparatively parallel cheek width | comparatively parallel jaw width | elongated lower face | soft chin termination | neutral head pitch | distortion-controlled perspective

square_face_contour_relation.text: A complete face perimeter with length close to width, relatively comparable forehead, zygomatic, and bigonial breadths, and broad readable jaw corners continuing into a broad chin. | 얼굴 길이와 폭이 비슷하고 이마·광대·하악 폭이 크게 좁아지지 않으며 턱 모서리가 넓고 각진 얼굴 | a near-equal length-width face with relatively straight sides and broad jaw corners | a broad chin and gonial region completing the same square perimeter | complete bilateral face contour remains visible | hairline through both jaw corners to chin is readable | 양쪽 얼굴 외곽과 턱 모서리가 보임 | face length remains close to width | compact but not round vertical relation | 얼굴 길이와 폭이 비슷함 | forehead cheek and bigonial widths are relatively comparable | side contours remain broad through the jaw | 이마 광대 하악 폭이 비교적 비슷함 | broad gonial corners continue into a broad chin | angular jaw belongs to the full lower contour | 넓은 하악각이 넓은 턱끝으로 이어짐 | hard shadow square crop hairstyle and clenching do not substitute | neutral distortion-controlled jaw read | 강한 그림자 프레임과 악물기를 분리함 | complete bilateral face perimeter | length close to width | comparable forehead width | comparable zygomatic width | comparable bigonial width | broad side contours | readable gonial corners | broad chin | neutral expression | soft form light

rectangular_face_contour_relation.text: A complete face perimeter clearly longer than wide while forehead, zygomatic, and bigonial breadths remain comparatively parallel, with broad angular jaw corners and a broad chin preserving the square-like lower structure through the elongation. | 사각형 얼굴의 넓고 각진 턱과 비교적 평행한 옆선을 유지하면서 세로가 더 긴 얼굴 | an elongated face with broad jaw corners rather than a softly narrowed oblong lower end | parallel upper-to-lower widths and a broad chin surviving the greater vertical span | full bilateral hairline-to-chin perimeter | both elongated side contours and jaw corners stay visible | 세로로 긴 양쪽 외곽과 턱 모서리가 보임 | face is clearly longer than wide | vertical span exceeds the square relation | 세로 길이가 가로 폭보다 뚜렷이 김 | forehead cheek and bigonial widths remain comparatively parallel | broad side contours persist downward | 이마 광대 하악 폭이 비교적 평행함 | broad gonial corners connect to a broad chin | angular lower-face structure survives elongation | 넓고 각진 턱 모서리와 넓은 턱끝이 유지됨 | crop head pitch shadow and lens stretch do not substitute | neutral distortion-controlled rectangular read | 크롭 고개 각도 그림자와 원근을 분리함 | complete bilateral perimeter | clearly longer than wide | parallel forehead width | parallel cheek width | parallel bigonial width | broad side contours | broad gonial corners | broad chin | neutral head pitch | controlled portrait perspective

triangle_lower_face_dominant_relation.text: A complete face perimeter whose forehead and temples are narrower than the lower cheek and bigonial region, creating an outward upper-to-lower transition toward a broad jaw before the chin. | 이마와 관자 폭보다 아래 볼과 하악 폭이 넓어 아래 얼굴이 지배적으로 보이는 얼굴 | a face that widens from the upper temples toward broad jaw corners | lower-face breadth owns the triangle rather than one large chin or full cheek | complete bilateral forehead-to-chin contour | both temple and jaw widths remain visible | 이마부터 하악까지 양쪽 폭이 보임 | face length-to-width relation remains explicitly visible | vertical span is neither hidden nor inferred | 얼굴 세로와 가로 관계가 전체 외곽에서 보임 | bigonial region is wider than forehead and temples | contour expands toward the lower face | 하악 폭이 이마와 관자 폭보다 넓음 | broad jaw corners carry the lower-face width | chin terminates the broad lower contour without owning it alone | 넓은 하악각이 하안면 폭을 형성함 | pear fruit body silhouette hair and pose do not substitute | neutral front contour with controlled perspective | 배 모양 물체 몸매 헤어와 원근을 분리함 | complete forehead-to-chin perimeter | visible vertical relation | narrower forehead | narrower temples | outward temple-to-jaw transition | lower cheek breadth | dominant bigonial width | broad jaw corners | chin not sufficient alone | controlled front perspective

diamond_zygomatic_dominant_relation.text: A complete face perimeter whose lateral zygomatic region is clearly widest, with two-direction narrowing toward both the forehead-temple region and the jaw-chin region, ending in a small chin. | 광대 폭이 가장 넓고 이마·관자와 하악·턱끝으로 양쪽 방향에서 좁아지는 얼굴 | a face widest at the lateral zygomatic region and narrower above and below | high cheekbone projection does not count unless lateral width owns the full diamond perimeter | full hairline temple cheek jaw and chin perimeter | both upper and lower tapers remain visible | 이마 광대 하악 턱끝의 전체 외곽이 보임 | face length-to-width relation remains readable | vertical span stays explicit beside the widest cheek region | 세로 길이와 최대 광대 폭 관계가 보임 | lateral zygomatic region is clearly widest | cheekbone width exceeds forehead and jaw widths | 양쪽 광대 폭이 가장 넓음 | contour narrows toward both forehead and small chin | two-direction taper forms the full perimeter | 광대에서 이마와 작은 턱끝 양방향으로 좁아짐 | cheekbone projection highlight jewelry and hair do not substitute | front-view width stays separate from depth and styling | 광대 전방 돌출 하이라이트 보석과 헤어를 분리함 | complete bilateral face perimeter | declared length-width relation | lateral zygomatic width clearly widest | narrower temples | narrower forehead | narrower jaw | small chin | two-direction taper | width separate from projection | hair-cleared front view

upper_face_to_chin_taper_relation.text: A complete upper-face-dominant perimeter in which forehead and upper-temple breadth exceed jaw width and the contour narrows continuously through the lower cheeks toward a narrow chin; a central widow's peak may support the heart variant but is optional. | 넓은 이마와 상부 얼굴에서 하악 폭이 줄고 좁은 턱끝으로 계속 좁아지는 얼굴 | a wider forehead tapering continuously through the lower face toward a narrow chin | heart and inverted-triangle labels overlap in the upper-to-lower width relation while the hairline cue remains optional | complete forehead temple cheek jaw and chin perimeter | both upper breadth and lower taper remain visible | 넓은 상부와 좁아지는 하부 외곽 전체가 보임 | face length-to-width relation remains visible | vertical span is stated beside the upper breadth | 얼굴 세로와 상부 폭 관계가 보임 | forehead and upper temples are wider than the jaw | upper-face breadth owns the hierarchy | 이마와 상부 관자가 하악보다 넓음 | lower cheeks and jaw narrow continuously toward a narrow chin | widow's peak remains optional | 하안면이 좁은 턱끝까지 계속 좁아짐 | heart icon hairstyle pointed chin and contour makeup do not substitute | upper-to-lower widths stay anatomically readable | 하트 아이콘 헤어와 뾰족한 턱 하나를 분리함 | complete bilateral face perimeter | declared vertical relation | wider forehead | wider upper temples | narrower lower cheeks | narrower bigonial width | continuous upper-to-lower taper | narrow chin | optional widow's peak | controlled front perspective

v_tapered_lower_face_relation.text: A complete facial perimeter in which the lower face narrows coherently from the cheek region through distinctly reduced bigonial width into a compact narrow chin, producing a readable V-like lower contour rather than an isolated pointed tip. | 광대 아래에서 하악 폭이 분명히 줄고 좁은 턱끝까지 연속적으로 모이는 하안면 | a coherent cheek-to-jaw-to-chin narrowing across the entire lower face | a pointed chin is insufficient unless both jaw sides participate in the taper | complete bilateral face perimeter remains visible | both cheek-to-jaw contours and chin are unobscured | 양쪽 광대에서 턱끝까지 외곽이 보임 | global face length-to-width relation remains visible | upper and lower facial spans stay jointly readable | 전체 얼굴의 세로와 가로 관계가 보임 | both jaw sides narrow distinctly below the cheeks | bigonial width is clearly reduced from cheek width | 광대 아래 양쪽 하악 폭이 뚜렷이 줄어듦 | continuous lower taper terminates in a compact narrow chin | chin belongs to the full bilateral taper | 연속된 하안면 수렴이 작고 좁은 턱끝으로 끝남 | V neckline inguinal line pointed chin makeup and shadow do not substitute | lower-face anatomy stays separate from fashion and body geometry | 브이넥 사타구니 선 뾰족한 턱 하나와 메이크업을 분리함 | complete bilateral facial perimeter | declared global length-width relation | cheek region as upper lower-face reference | distinctly reduced bigonial width | both jaw sides participate | continuous bilateral taper | compact narrow chin | neutral expression | hair cleared from jaw | controlled portrait perspective

u_rounded_lower_face_relation.text: A complete facial perimeter whose lower jaw retains appreciable lateral width below the cheeks before turning through a broad rounded mandibular arc into the chin, creating a U-like lower contour without requiring the whole face to be round. | 광대 아래에서도 하악 폭이 어느 정도 유지되다가 넓고 둥근 호로 턱끝에 연결되는 하안면 | a lower jaw that stays laterally broad before rounding into the chin | whole-face roundness is not required when the U-shaped relation belongs specifically to the lower contour | complete bilateral face perimeter remains visible | both jaw sides and chin arc are unobscured | 양쪽 하악과 턱끝의 전체 외곽이 보임 | global face length-to-width relation remains visible | whole-face span remains separate from lower-contour shape | 전체 얼굴 비례와 하안면 모양을 분리해 보임 | jaw retains lateral breadth below the cheeks | bigonial width does not collapse abruptly | 광대 아래에서도 하악 폭이 유지됨 | broad rounded mandibular arc joins the chin | lower contour curves widely rather than converging to a point | 넓고 둥근 하악 호가 턱끝으로 이어짐 | U graphic broad chin cheek fullness and shadow do not substitute | lower jaw anatomy stays separate from whole-face roundness and styling | U자 그래픽 넓은 턱 하나 볼살과 그림자를 분리함 | complete bilateral facial perimeter | declared global length-width relation | appreciable lateral jaw width | bigonial width retained below cheeks | broad mandibular arc | rounded jaw-to-chin transition | chin integrated into the arc | not whole-face roundness by default | neutral expression | soft form light

cjk_seed_face_relation.text: A culture-scoped composite in which a moderately elongated oval upper and middle facial perimeter reaches its wider region around the cheeks, then narrows more strongly and smoothly through the jaw into a small rounded or softly pointed chin; no fixed ratio, ethnicity, attractiveness, or personality is implied. | 상·중안면은 길이가 적당한 타원형이고 광대 아래에서 턱끝까지 더 강하게 매끄럽게 좁아지는 씨앗형 얼굴 | a moderately elongated oval upper-mid face with stronger lower-face taper than an egg-shaped oval | a small softly pointed or rounded chin completes the smooth lower taper without becoming a surgery or beauty-value claim | complete hairline temple cheek jaw and chin perimeter | both oval upper and tapered lower contours remain visible | 타원형 상부와 좁아지는 하부 외곽 전체가 보임 | upper and middle face are moderately longer than wide | oval upper-mid vertical relation | 상중안면이 가로보다 적당히 긴 타원 관계 | cheek region is wider than the jaw | widest region sits around the lateral cheeks | 광대 부근이 하악보다 넓음 | jaw narrows more strongly and smoothly into a small chin | small rounded or softly pointed chin completes the taper | 하악이 더 강하게 좁아져 작고 둥글거나 부드럽게 뾰족한 턱으로 끝남 | egg oval V-line surgery ethnicity and beauty value do not substitute | culture-scoped label is replaced by literal contour evidence at runtime | 계란형 브이라인 수술 민족성과 미적 가치 추론을 분리함 | complete bilateral face perimeter | moderately elongated oval upper-mid face | cheek region wider than jaw | smooth side contour | stronger lower-face taper | narrow bigonial region | small rounded or softly pointed chin | no fixed ratio | neutral expression | controlled portrait perspective

graphic_negative_space_eyeliner.text: A deliberate eyeliner stroke or closed graphic segment positioned partly away from the natural lash line so that a clean band of unpainted skin remains visibly bounded between the cosmetic line and the eye or lid structure. | 속눈썹선과 떨어진 그래픽 라인 사이에 깨끗한 피부 여백이 남는 아이라이너 | a precise floating stroke has coherent endpoints and a readable unpainted gap beneath it | negative space belongs to the line geometry rather than an accidental missing segment | deliberate eyeliner stroke sits away from the natural lash line | graphic line follows a coherent designed path | 그래픽 라인이 속눈썹선과 떨어져 있음 | clean unpainted skin remains visible between line and lid | negative-space band is continuous and intentionally bounded | 라인과 눈꺼풀 사이 피부 여백이 이어짐 | line thickness and endpoints remain precise and intentional | both ends of the graphic stroke resolve cleanly | 라인 굵기와 양 끝이 의도적으로 정리됨 | accidental gaps crease shadow and eyeshadow shape do not substitute | negative space remains separate from missing eyeliner or image defects | 끊긴 아이라인 주름 그림자 아이섀도를 구분함 | floating eyeliner stroke | clean skin gap | bounded negative space | precise line thickness | coherent endpoints | graphic eye geometry | separate lash line | unpainted lid band | no accidental break | no crease-shadow substitute

glass_skin_specular_diffuse_balance.text: A complexion finish combining broad low-contrast diffuse radiance with controlled face-plane-following specular highlights while pores and natural microtexture remain visible, so luminosity reads as a cosmetic optical layer rather than oil, plastic retouching, or overexposure. | 얼굴 전반의 부드러운 광과 높은 면의 제한된 반사광이 함께 보이면서 모공은 남는 피부 표현 | diffuse radiance spans the complexion while sharper highlights stay localized to coherent facial planes | luminous cosmetics remain distinct from greasy hotspots and a poreless smoothing filter | broad low-contrast diffuse radiance covers the complexion | soft luminous base remains visible outside highlight zones | 얼굴 전반에 부드러운 확산광이 남음 | localized specular highlights follow coherent high facial planes | highlight shapes agree with the visible light direction | 제한된 반사광이 얼굴 높은 면과 조명 방향을 따름 | pores and natural skin microtexture remain visible | luminous finish does not erase surface detail | 광택 아래 모공과 피부 미세결이 보임 | oily hotspots plastic smoothing and overexposure do not substitute | surface finish remains separate from global lighting and filter effects | 유분 핫스팟 플라스틱 보정 과노출을 구분함 | broad diffuse skin radiance | localized specular highlights | face-plane highlight coherence | visible pores | natural microtexture | luminous cosmetic base | controlled highlight contrast | consistent light direction | no oily hotspots | no plastic retouching

sunburn_blush_cross_face_distribution.text: A warm cosmetic pigment distribution spanning both high cheeks and crossing the nose bridge as one coordinated band with soft controlled edges, explicitly separated from actual ultraviolet injury, inflammation, fever, white-balance shifts, and colored illumination. | 양쪽 높은 볼의 따뜻한 블러셔가 콧등을 지나 하나의 부드러운 가로 분포로 이어지는 화장 | warm blush remains bilaterally coordinated across high cheeks and nose rather than isolated red spots | the cross-face pigment is cosmetic and must not resemble peeling painful or inflamed skin | warm pigment occupies both high cheek regions | left and right cheek color remains coordinated | 양쪽 높은 볼에 따뜻한 색이 함께 놓임 | pigment crosses the nose bridge between both cheeks | one continuous cross-face blush distribution remains visible | 블러셔가 콧등을 지나 양 볼을 연결함 | blush boundaries remain softly blended and cosmetically controlled | warm pigment sits above readable normal skin texture | 부드러운 경계 아래 정상 피부 결이 남음 | actual sunburn rash fever injury and colored light do not substitute | no peeling swelling pain cue or global red cast supplies the effect | 실제 화상 발진 열감 부상 붉은 조명을 구분함 | bilateral high-cheek blush | nose-bridge connection | warm cross-face pigment | soft blended edges | normal skin texture | coordinated left-right placement | cosmetic layer evidence | no peeling | no inflammation | no global red light cast

contour_highlight_cosmetic_sculpting.text: A cosmetic plane treatment combining localized matte darker pigment on selected receding facial regions with localized lighter or reflective product on selected high planes, joined by blended transitions and remaining distinguishable from anatomy, global dodge-and-burn, and cast lighting. | 얼굴의 들어간 면에는 국소적인 매트 음영 색을, 높은 면에는 밝은 제품을 배치하고 경계를 블렌딩한 메이크업 | dark cosmetic placement and light cosmetic placement occupy opposing but coherent facial planes | one consistent illumination field proves that the dimension comes from product placement rather than moving shadows | matte darker cosmetic pigment occupies selected receding face planes | contour product remains localized rather than globally darkening skin | 들어간 얼굴 면에 국소적 매트 컨투어가 놓임 | lighter or reflective cosmetic product occupies selected high planes | highlight remains locally placed and distinct from overall exposure | 높은 얼굴 면에 국소적 하이라이트가 놓임 | dark and light placements align with opposing facial planes and blend at transitions | both product regions remain coherent under one light field | 어두운 면과 밝은 면의 경계가 블렌딩됨 | cast shadow anatomy surgery and global dodge burn do not substitute | cosmetic placement stays visible independently of face shape and lighting | 조명 그림자 타고난 골격 수술 전역 보정을 구분함 | localized matte contour pigment | localized cosmetic highlight | opposing facial planes | blended transitions | consistent light field | readable product placement | independent face anatomy | no cast-shadow substitute | no global dodge burn | no surgery inference

two_block_disconnected_cut.text: A disconnected haircut containing a visibly longer upper section and distinctly shorter side and back sections, separated by an abrupt readable boundary rather than a continuously blended fade. | 윗부분은 길게 남고 옆과 뒤는 짧으며 두 길이 영역 사이의 단절선이 보이는 헤어컷 | the top mass remains longer while the sides and nape form a separate short block | weight and volume change abruptly at the boundary between the upper and lower sections | the upper hair section remains visibly longer | a distinct longer top mass is readable | 윗부분의 긴 모발 영역이 분명함 | the side and back sections are distinctly shorter | short lower blocks follow the side and nape | 옆과 뒤의 짧은 영역이 별도로 보임 | an abrupt length boundary separates the two sections | the upper and lower blocks do not blend continuously | 두 길이 영역 사이 단절선이 보임 | the longer top carries visibly different weight and volume | upper volume remains legible above the short lower section | 상부 볼륨과 하부 밀착감의 차이가 읽힘 | a gradual fade taper or bowl outline does not substitute | the structure remains readable independently of styling product | 페이드 테이퍼 단순 보울 실루엣과 구분됨 | longer upper hair block | short side and back block | abrupt length disconnection | readable top weight | visible nape transition | two-section haircut geometry | non-gradual boundary | profile or three-quarter readability

hime_cut_structural.text: A long-hair cut structure with a retained rear length and paired blunt face-side panels ending around the cheek or jaw, joined by a clearly readable disconnected length step rather than ordinary blended framing layers. | 긴 뒷머리 위에 좌우 얼굴 옆의 뭉툭한 짧은 패널과 길이 단차가 보이는 스타일 | paired cheek-to-jaw side panels end bluntly in front of a longer rear mass | a full fringe may support the look but cannot replace the paired side panels and disconnection | a long rear hair mass continues below the side panels | the back length remains substantially longer | 옆 패널 뒤로 긴 뒷머리가 이어짐 | paired blunt cheek-to-jaw side panels frame the face | both face-side sections end in dense horizontal edges | 좌우 얼굴 옆 패널이 뭉툭한 끝선으로 종료됨 | a visible disconnected length step separates panels from rear hair | the short side sections meet the long rear mass without blending | 짧은 옆 패널과 긴 뒷머리 사이 단차가 분명함 | both side panels remain readable beside one face | bilateral panel placement is visible in the portrait | 한 얼굴 양쪽의 패널이 함께 보임 | ordinary feathered face-framing layers do not substitute | a bob over hidden extensions or two loose tendrils cannot carry the structure | 일반 레이어 잔머리 보브 겹침과 구분됨 | long rear hair mass | paired blunt side panels | cheek-to-jaw panel endpoints | disconnected length step | bilateral face framing | dense horizontal side edges | full fringe optional | three-quarter structural readability

cornrow_scalp_row_topology.text: A scalp-braided topology made of multiple narrow continuous braided rows attached closely along the scalp, separated by readable parting lanes and remaining distinct from large raised braids or free-hanging individual braids. | 두피에 밀착되어 경로를 따라 이어지는 여러 개의 좁은 브레이드와 가르마 통로 | many narrow braided ridges remain anchored to the scalp along repeated row paths | the row layout may be straight or patterned while scalp attachment and parting lanes remain invariant | multiple narrow braided ridges cover the scalp | many small braids remain separately readable | 여러 개의 좁은 브레이드 융기가 보임 | each row remains attached closely along the scalp | the braids originate and travel against the scalp | 브레이드가 두피 경로에 밀착됨 | clean scalp parting lanes separate adjacent rows | readable exposed divisions organize the braid paths | 행 사이의 두피 가르마 통로가 보임 | the braided ridges follow continuous deliberate row paths | row direction remains traceable from front toward back or side | 각 브레이드 행의 연속 경로가 추적됨 | two large Dutch braids and free box braids do not substitute | decorative scalp lines without woven ridges cannot carry the topology | 큰 두 갈래 브레이드와 자유 낙하 브레이드와 구분됨 | multiple narrow scalp braids | close scalp attachment | readable parting lanes | continuous row paths | traceable braid direction | patterned scalp topology | visible woven ridges | not free-hanging braids

locs_cord_structure.text: A hairstyle composed of multiple persistent cordlike locked sections that remain continuous from near the roots toward the ends, without the periodic strand crossings of braids and without the temporary adhesion pattern of wet clumps. | 뿌리 부근부터 끝까지 이어지는 여러 개의 지속적인 코드형 잠김 다발 | many rope-like hair cords remain individually continuous without repeating three-strand crossings | cord diameter and length may vary while persistent locked continuity remains visible | multiple separately readable cordlike hair sections | many rope-like hair cords form the style | 여러 개의 코드형 모발 다발이 구분됨 | the cords continue from near the roots toward the ends | each locked section follows a persistent root-to-end path | 각 잠김 다발이 뿌리부터 끝 방향으로 이어짐 | each cord has a compact interlocked hair surface | the sections read as persistent locked fibers rather than loose strands | 다발 표면이 지속적으로 얽혀 잠긴 구조로 보임 | the cords show no repeating three-strand braid crossings | braided over-under periodicity is absent from the locked sections | 반복적인 삼가닥 교차 패턴이 없음 | wet clumps two-strand twists and rope extensions do not substitute | temporary strand adhesion cannot carry the locked structure | 젖은 뭉침 트위스트 장식 연장과 구분됨 | multiple cordlike loc sections | persistent root-to-end continuity | compact interlocked fibers | separately readable hair cords | no braid crossing periodicity | natural cord variation | locked hair topology | culturally neutral person casting

bilateral_twin_tail_gather.text: A bilateral gathered hairstyle with two visible left and right scalp tie points, each feeding a separately trailing hair bundle, while root-to-tie continuity distinguishes the arrangement from loose side locks or face-framing strands. | 좌우 두피의 묶임점 두 개에서 각각 별도 머리 다발이 이어지는 양갈래 배열 | two independently gathered bundles descend from two bilateral attachment points | height length and curl may vary while two tie points and two trailing bundles remain invariant | two visible left and right scalp tie points | a separate tie point anchors each side | 좌우 두 개의 묶임점이 보임 | two separately trailing gathered hair bundles | each tie point feeds one distinct descending bundle | 각 묶임점에서 별도 다발이 이어짐 | the two gathered sides remain spatially distinct | left and right bundles are both readable around one head | 한 머리의 좌우 다발이 분리되어 보임 | scalp hair visibly converges into each tie point | root-to-tie continuity confirms actual gathering | 두피 모발이 각 묶임점으로 수렴함 | loose side locks and face-framing tendrils do not substitute | two accessories without gathered hair cannot carry the topology | 옆머리 잔머리 장식 두 개와 구분됨 | two bilateral tie points | two trailing gathered bundles | left-right separation | root-to-tie convergence | paired hair topology | readable scalp attachments | variable tail height | not loose side locks

balayage_ribbon_color_placement.text: A distributed hair-color placement built from irregular freehand lighter ribbons through the mid-lengths and ends, retaining a darker base and soft root transitions rather than forming one full-width root-to-end gradient. | 어두운 뿌리에서 부드럽게 이어지며 중간과 끝에 불규칙한 밝은 리본이 분산된 염색 | lighter ribbons appear at varied positions and widths across the hair surface | the base color remains visible between ribbons instead of becoming one continuous ombre field | irregular freehand lighter ribbons cross the hair surface | lightened sections vary in width and placement | 밝은 리본의 폭과 위치가 불규칙함 | the darker roots transition softly into lighter sections | no hard universal root line separates the colors | 어두운 뿌리에서 밝은 부분으로 부드럽게 전이됨 | lighter color concentrates through varied mid-lengths and ends | the distributed ribbons become more visible away from the roots | 중간 길이와 끝에 밝은 배치가 분산됨 | the darker base remains visible between lighter ribbons | base color threads continuously through the placement | 밝은 리본 사이로 기본색이 계속 보임 | a full-width ombre gradient and regular foil stripes do not substitute | dip-dye boundaries and uniform root-to-tip streaks cannot carry the placement | 옴브레 딥다이 규칙적 포일 줄무늬와 구분됨 | irregular freehand light ribbons | soft darker-root transition | varied mid-length placement | lighter ends | visible base color between ribbons | distributed surface highlights | nonuniform ribbon widths | not full-width ombre

wet_damp_clumped_hair_state.text: A visibly wet or damp temporary hair state combining reduced dry-hair volume, strand bundling and clumping, directional weight or local adherence, and coherent moisture evidence rather than relying on specular shine or sleek styling alone. | 마른 머리보다 부피가 줄고 여러 가닥이 젖은 다발로 뭉쳐 얼굴이나 목에 일부 붙은 상태 | moist strands group into weighted bundles and lose airy separation | shine may support the state but clumping volume collapse and local adhesion establish it | the wet hair carries less airy dry volume | the silhouette collapses relative to fluffy dry hair | 마른 머리보다 공기감과 부피가 줄어듦 | individual strands gather into visible damp bundles | multiple clumped strand groups remain separately readable | 가닥들이 여러 젖은 다발로 뭉침 | weighted damp sections adhere locally to the face neck or garment | moisture pulls selected bundles downward against nearby surfaces | 젖은 다발이 얼굴 목 의복에 국소적으로 붙음 | clumping reduced volume and local adherence agree as one moisture state | the moisture evidence remains spatially coherent across the hair | 뭉침 부피 감소 부착이 하나의 젖은 상태로 일치함 | dry specular shine and sleek gel styling alone do not substitute | bright highlights without bundling cannot establish wet hair | 광택 젤 스타일링 조명 하이라이트만으로 대체되지 않음 | reduced airy hair volume | visible damp strand bundles | weighted downward sections | localized face or neck adherence | spatially coherent moisture | supporting wet sheen | temporary finish state | not dry gloss alone

restrained_polished_natural_makeup_balan.text: A coherent applied makeup system whose readable sheer-to-light satin complexion leads the hierarchy while low-contrast brow, neutral eye, muted cheek, and centered soft lip treatments remain individually visible and mutually restrained. | 피부 결이 남는 얇은 새틴 베이스 위에 눈썹 눈 볼 입술의 대비가 서로 절제된 정돈형 내추럴 메이크업 | a polished cosmetic layer remains visibly applied while no eye cheek or lip region overpowers the complexion | neutral taupe eye definition muted rose cheeks and a softly centered rosy-coral lip coexist under a texture-preserving complexion | sheer-to-light satin complexion correction leaves fine skin texture and natural tonal variation readable | thin satin correction preserves pores and ordinary complexion variation | 얇은 새틴 보정 아래 피부 결과 자연스러운 색 변화가 남음 | softly groomed low-arch brows retain individual hairs | low-arch brow grooming keeps separate natural hair strands | 낮은 아치의 정돈된 눈썹에 개별 털 결이 남음 | a neutral taupe wash is deepest at the upper lash line and diffuses through the crease | neutral taupe-brown pigment decreases softly from lash roots through the crease | 뉴트럴 타우프 브라운이 위 속눈썹선에서 가장 진하고 크리즈로 퍼짐 | a slim interlash line ends in a very short tapered outer extension | fine upper interlash definition finishes in a micro outer taper | 얇은 인터래시 라인이 아주 짧은 바깥 꼬리로 가늘어짐 | lashes are clean and separated | individual upper lashes stay separated with restrained volume | 윗속눈썹 가닥이 뭉치지 않고 절제된 볼륨으로 분리됨 | a muted rose flush stays soft on the cheeks | low-saturation rose pigment remains bilateral with diffused cheek edges | 저채도 로즈 색이 양 볼에 부드러운 경계로 남음 | muted rosy-coral lip color is strongest near the inner center, fades toward a softly diffused vermilion edge, and carries a low satin-balm sheen | rosy-coral pigment peaks at the inner lip and fades to a soft edge under restrained satin sheen | 로지 코랄 색이 입술 안쪽에서 가장 진하고 부드러운 경계와 낮은 새틴 광택으로 이어짐 | Eye, cheek, and lip contrast remain mutually restrained so the complexion leads the hierarchy | applied brow eye cheek and lip treatments remain readable without any region dominating the complexion | 눈 볼 입술의 대비가 서로 절제되어 피부 표현이 시각적 위계를 주도함 | texture-preserving satin complexion | low-arch hair-readable brows | neutral taupe lashline-to-crease diffusion | micro tapered outer liner | clean separated lashes | muted bilateral rose cheeks | centered rosy-coral soft-edge lip | complexion-led low-contrast hierarchy

necromancer_dead_causality.text: A living operator deliberately establishes a causal relation to one specific dead person or their remains and receives a localized answer, manifestation, release, binding result, or commanded bodily response. Historical consultation and modern-fantasy reanimation are separate scene variants inside the same operator-to-dead causal contract. | 살아 있는 술자가 특정 망자의 유품을 통해 질문하고 그 망자만의 응답을 받는 장면 | a living practitioner questions one identified dead person through a memorial anchor and the scene visibly changes in reply | one inert fictional body changes into a commanded state only after the operator's deliberate act | a living operator deliberately questions summons binds releases or commands | living operator questions one specifically identified dead person | 살아 있는 술자의 의도적 질문 소환 결박 해방 명령 | one named dead person portrait remains memorial or former-life object | one specifically identified dead person through a memorial anchor | 특정 망자의 초상 유해 기념물 유품 | an original non-instructional boundary memorial ledger instrument or reflection links the two | 비지시적 경계 기념 기록물 도구 반사가 연결 매개가 됨 | the linked apparition remains or instrument changes locally in response | the linked apparition responds locally | 연결된 현현 유해 도구가 국소적으로 응답 | an answer command consequence release or binding result becomes visible | a brass instrument visibly changes | 답 명령 결과 해방 결박의 결과가 보임 | living necromancer operator | named-dead consultation | memorial anchor | apparition response | commanded reanimation | binding or release | changed instrument trace | operator-target-result composition

human_ghost_identity_breach.text: A disembodied presence continuous with one formerly living person, made legible by a former-identity anchor plus one coherent impossible presence or agency relation. Translucency, blur, fog, or double exposure alone is a capture convention rather than proof of a ghost. | 생전 초상과 같은 인물이 현실에는 없고 거울에만 나타나 이전 습관을 반복한다 | a former person appears only in a reflection while a memorial object confirms who they were | an identifiable dead person crosses one closed threshold and leaves one localized consequence | same face clothing memorial object portrait or former routine | one former person's portrait matches an apparition | 같은 얼굴 복장 유품 초상 생전 습관 | reflection-only presence threshold crossing occlusion mismatch or coherent translucency | apparition visible only in an aligned reflection | 거울에만 존재 문턱 통과 가림 순서 불일치 일관된 반투명 | one repeated action recognition gesture moved object depressed key or footprint | one key remains depressed | 반복 동작 인지 제스처 움직인 사물 눌린 건반 발자국 | physical scene geometry stays coherent and the breach is not generic blur fog hologram or exposure artifact | 장면 기하가 유지되고 단순 블러 안개 홀로그램 노출 효과가 아님 | former-person identity anchor | reflection-only apparition | former routine repetition | closed-threshold crossing | localized haunting consequence | coherent translucency | recognition of former identity

korean_afterlife_guide_escort.text: A Korean afterlife mediator whose role is visible through a deceased traveler, an escort or handoff action, and a passage boundary. Popular dark clothing or a gat may support a variant but cannot replace the guide-to-traveler relationship, and the role is not automatically the Western skeletal personification of Death. | 저승사자가 한 망자와 나란히 걸으며 문턱을 열어 다음 영역으로 인도한다 | a Korean afterlife guide checks a closed destination ledger and personally escorts one deceased traveler | the handoff becomes visible at a gate river crossing or transit threshold | a Korean afterlife mediator carries procedural responsibility | one afterlife mediator carries a closed destination ledger | 절차적 책임을 가진 한국 저승 인도자 | one identifiable deceased traveler accompanies the guide | the deceased traveler | 한 명의 식별 가능한 망자가 동행 | walking beside leading opening checking or handing over for the same traveler | walks beside the deceased traveler | 같은 망자를 향한 동행 인도 개문 확인 인계 | a gate river bridge station doorway or changed footprint marks passage | the same traveler's footprint changes across the boundary | 문 강 다리 역 출입구 변화한 발자국이 통과를 표시 | original contemporary Korean visual translation without copied ritual text | 살아 있는 의식 문구를 복제하지 않은 독창적 한국 시각화 | Korean afterlife mediator | deceased traveler | side-by-side escort | closed destination ledger | threshold handoff | gate or river passage | transformed footprint | culture-bounded original mechanism

western_death_personification.text: An anthropomorphic Western Death agent performing a mortality or terminal-transition action on a visible target. Skeleton, scythe, hourglass, wilted flowers, or extinguished flame are supporting iconography; at least the embodied agent, decisive action, and affected target or state change must be visible. | 해골 형상의 죽음이 마지막 모래시계를 뒤집자 시계의 최종 숫자가 꺼진다 | an embodied Death figure performs the terminal action while vanitas objects reinforce rather than replace it | the mortal witness and affected clock make the personification an active agent | anthropomorphic skeletal or death-coded agent | an anthropomorphic skeletal agent | 의인화된 해골 또는 죽음 표지 행위자 | turns final hourglass extinguishes terminal light severs final connection or closes passage | performs a mortality action | 마지막 모래시계를 뒤집고 종말 빛을 끄거나 최종 연결을 닫음 | a mortal figure clock flame flower or passage visibly changes | one mortal-linked clock changes | 필멸자 시계 불꽃 꽃 통로가 가시적으로 변화 | scythe skull hourglass wilted flower or extinguished candle supports the action | 낫 해골 모래시계 시든 꽃 꺼진 촛불이 행동을 보강 | embodied Western Death | skeletal mortality agent | final hourglass action | terminal clock extinguishing | mortal witness | vanitas support | agent-target-state change

fictional_human_remains_inert_dignity.text: A declared fictional human-remains state represented through complete external support, absence of self-support or agency, a readable human contour or mortuary context, and dignified non-graphic handling. A still image cannot medically confirm real death, infer cause, or establish identity; sleep, unconsciousness, mannequins, empty shrouds, and reanimated bodies remain separate. | 불투명한 깨끗한 시신보 아래 인체 윤곽이 운반대에 완전히 지지되고 기록 담당자가 존엄하게 이송을 문서화한다 | anonymous fictional human remains lie fully supported on a rigid gurney under an opaque shroud | a transfer tag and two-person dignified handling establish mortuary context without exposed injury | ground bier gurney stretcher or coffin supports the full body | the full covered inert body is externally supported | 바닥 관 운반대 들것이 신체 전체를 지지 | no self-support active gaze voluntary posture or commanded movement | the full covered inert body | 자립 시선 능동 자세 명령 동작이 없는 비활성 상태 | opaque shroud with human contour mortuary transfer tag or declared fictional remains context | an opaque clean shroud retains a human contour | 인체 윤곽의 불투명 시신보 이송 태그 허구 유해 맥락 | covered respectful transfer documentation or recovery procedure | two responders document the non-graphic transfer with dignity | 가려진 존엄한 이송 기록 수습 절차 | fictional declared state rather than medical diagnosis identity or cause inference | 의학적 진단 신원 사인 추론이 아닌 선언된 허구 상태 | shrouded fictional human remains | fully supported inert body | rigid gurney | human contour | fictional recovery tag | two-person dignified transfer | respectful documentary distance | non-graphic mortuary context

qipao_standing_collar_diagonal_closure_s.text: A qipao or cheongsam is a continuous dress system whose high standing collar connects to a curved or diagonal upper-front opening secured by knotted frog fastenings, with the fitted or straight body and coherent side construction remaining visible. kebaya_front_open_blouse_sarong_system.text: A kebaya system pairs a shaped front-opening upper garment, commonly made from fine embroidered, lace, or lightweight cloth, with a visible center fastening such as buttons or a kerongsang brooch set and a distinct wrapped lower garment such as a sarong. andean_poncho_central_opening_panel_syst.text: An Andean poncho is a rectangular or near-rectangular woven outer garment organized around a central head opening, with broad uninterrupted panels falling down the front and back and the sides remaining open enough to drape around the arms. west_african_grand_boubou_volume_system.text: A West African grand boubou is an expansive outer garment whose near-rectangular cloth body produces very broad sleeve openings and a continuous shoulder-to-body volume, often focused by embroidery around the neck or center front and worn with a coordinated inner garment or wrapper. biological_human_clone_provenance.text: A biological human clone is defined by copied genetic origin and a source-lineage relation, not by machine manufacture or a compulsory pixel-identical appearance. human_cellular_chimera_lineage.text: A human cellular chimera contains integrated cell populations derived from genetically distinct origins. heritage_travel_object_construction.text: Heritage travel-object craft is a brand-neutral protective construction system: a balanced rigid frame, fitted canvas or leather covering, reinforced corners and attached working hardware, plus compartments or other travel-protection function.
