high_jewelry_setting_integration.text: High-jewelry craft is a mechanically legible integration of matched gemstones and an original supporting metal design. Stone size or color matching, prong, bezel, pavé, or another setting contact, supporting gallery or structure, and bench placement or inspection must work together. Loose gems, generic sparkle, costume jewelry, and price or rarity claims are insufficient. | matched stones are secured by visible prongs into one original metal gallery | 크기와 색이 맞춰진 보석이 프롱·베젤 접점과 금속 지지구조에 통합됨 | stones matched by size and color | graduated gemstone layout | 크기와 색이 맞는 보석 | 그라데이션 보석 배열 | prongs visibly hold each stone | bezel or pavé contact | 프롱이 보석을 고정 | 베젤 또는 파베 접점 | metal gallery supports the stones | load-bearing setting frame | 금속 갤러리 지지 | 하중을 받는 세팅 프레임 | stones and metal share one original composition | setting follows the same original geometry | 보석과 금속의 오리지널 통합 구성 | 같은 기하를 따르는 세팅 | matched gemstone layout | prong bezel or pavé contact | supporting metal gallery | original integrated jewelry design | setting under magnification | controlled specular light

fine_watchmaking_mechanical_finishing.text: Fine-watchmaking craft joins a coherent mechanical movement and connected timekeeping function with differentiated finishing such as chamfering, polishing, brushing, engraving, or hand decoration, plus an assembly or adjustment context. Loose gears, a printed skeleton motif, a smartwatch display, or a status portrait cannot establish it. | connected bridges and gear train show brushed planes, polished chamfers and active adjustment | 연결된 기계식 무브먼트에 브러싱·폴리시·앵글라주 차등 마감과 조립 맥락이 함께 보임 | connected bridges gear train and escapement | coherent mechanical movement | 연결된 브리지 기어트레인 이스케이프먼트 | 일관된 기계식 무브먼트 | movement connects to a legible time display | winding or regulation function remains readable | 무브먼트와 시간 표시 연결 | 와인딩 또는 조정 기능 | brushed planes and polished chamfers | anglage polishing and engraving | 브러시 면과 폴리시 모서리 | 앵글라주와 인그레이빙 | watchmaker adjusts the bridge or regulator | assembly at the movement work point | 브리지 또는 레귤레이터 조정 | 무브먼트 조립 작업점 | connected gear train and escapement | legible time function | brushed planes | polished chamfers or anglage | assembly or regulation under a loupe

private_client_service_interaction.text: Private-client luxury is a responsive one-to-one service interaction: one advisor attends to one client's stated material, fit, function, or care need; presents a curated few; handles or fits them carefully; and leaves an aftercare, repair, or restoration continuation. An empty marble lobby, champagne, velvet rope, private room, or salesperson pose alone is insufficient. | one advisor compares a curated few materials against the client's fit need and records the chosen aftercare | 한 명의 상담자가 고객 요구에 맞춰 소수 선택지를 다루고 피팅·애프터케어까지 연결함 | one advisor responds to one client's stated need | advisor points to the requested material or fit difference | 한 상담자가 한 고객 요구에 반응 | 요청한 재료나 핏 차이에 응답 | two or three relevant options | limited curated selection | 관련된 두세 선택지 | 소수 큐레이션 | careful gloved handling at the object | live fit or function check | 오브제의 신중한 취급 | 실제 핏 또는 기능 확인 | repair restoration or aftercare record | follow-up care plan | 수리 복원 애프터케어 기록 | 후속 관리 계획 | one advisor and one client | response to a stated need | curated few options | careful handling | live fitting or function check | repair restoration or aftercare continuity

button_down_collar_fastening.text: A shirt topology with a complete center-front button placket and a point collar whose left and right collar tips are each visibly fastened to the shirt body by their own small buttons. The collar-point fastening, not the generic front opening, distinguishes it from an ordinary button-up shirt. | 앞 플래킷과 별도로 좌우 칼라 끝이 작은 단추로 몸판에 고정된 셔츠 | both pointed collar tips are separately buttoned down above a complete front placket | the collar remains readable as a point collar rather than a printed or button-like decoration | a complete center-front button placket remains visible | repeated front buttons define the shirt opening | 중앙 앞여밈 단추 플래킷이 완전하게 보임 | two pointed collar tips remain separately readable | a conventional point collar frames the neck | 좌우 포인트 칼라 끝이 각각 보임 | one small button fastens each collar point | two distinct collar-point buttons are visible | 각 칼라 끝을 고정하는 두 개의 작은 단추 | both collar tips visibly attach to the shirt body | the point buttons pass through collar-tip buttonholes | 칼라 끝과 셔츠 몸판의 실제 체결 관계 | a generic button-up placket does not substitute for collar fastening | decorative studs or hidden collar tips cannot carry the distinction | 일반 버튼업 앞여밈만으로 버튼다운을 판정하지 않음 | complete center-front button placket | paired point-collar tips | two small collar-point buttons | visible collar-tip buttonholes | collar points attached to shirt body | distinct from generic button-up shirt

cold_shoulder_cutout_topology.text: A top whose neckline or upper bodice remains continuous while one bounded opening exposes each shoulder top and the sleeve continues below each opening. Finished edges and fabric bridges preserve the garment route around the cutouts, distinguishing it from an off-shoulder neckline, a sleeveless top, or torn fabric. | 네크라인과 양쪽 소매가 유지된 채 어깨 윗부분에만 경계 있는 창이 열린 탑 | paired shoulder windows sit between a continuous neckline and attached sleeves | finished cutout seams and fabric bridges keep each sleeve connected | the neckline remains continuous across the upper torso | fabric still crosses above both shoulder openings | 양쪽 어깨 구멍 위로 네크라인이 이어짐 | two bounded shoulder-top cutouts are visible | one deliberate opening exposes each shoulder top | 좌우 어깨 윗부분의 두 개 경계 있는 컷아웃 | both sleeves remain attached below the cutouts | the sleeve route continues around the upper arms | 컷아웃 아래로 양쪽 소매가 계속 연결됨 | finished seams bound every cutout edge | fabric bridges connect neckline bodice and sleeves | 마감 봉제선과 원단 브리지가 컷아웃을 둘러쌈 | an off-shoulder neckline does not substitute for bounded windows | sleeveless armholes or torn openings cannot carry the topology | 오프숄더나 민소매 구조와 구분됨 | continuous neckline above cutouts | paired bounded shoulder windows | sleeves attached below openings | finished cutout seams | fabric bridges around shoulders | distinct from off-shoulder and sleeveless

wrap_front_overlap_closure.text: A functional wrap-front upper garment formed by two separately traceable front panels crossing diagonally, with one panel continuing beneath the other and a side tie, button, or fixed seam holding the overlap. The crossing creates a coherent wrap V neckline and edge path rather than a decorative diagonal print, faux seam, or loose scarf. | 두 앞판이 사선으로 실제 겹치고 한쪽이 아래로 이어져 옆에서 고정되는 블라우스 | two traceable front edges cross into a functional side fastening and wrap V neckline | the lower panel remains visible beneath the upper panel through fold depth and edge continuity | two separate front-panel edges remain traceable | left and right fronts cross as distinct fabric panels | 좌우 두 앞판 가장자리가 각각 추적 가능함 | one panel visibly continues beneath the other | fold depth proves a real diagonal overlap | 한 앞판이 다른 앞판 아래로 이어지는 겹침 깊이 | the crossing edges form a coherent wrap V neckline | neckline and diagonal overlap share the same edge path | 교차 가장자리가 하나의 랩 V 네크라인을 형성 | a side tie button or fixed seam holds the overlap | the fastening connects both wrap panels under tension | 옆 묶음 단추 또는 고정선이 겹침을 유지 | a printed diagonal line does not substitute for panel overlap | a decorative waist tie or loose scarf cannot carry the closure | 사선 프린트와 장식용 끈으로 랩 구조를 대체하지 않음 | two traceable front panels | real diagonal overlap depth | lower panel beneath upper panel | coherent wrap V neckline | functional side tie button or seam | distinct from faux-wrap decoration

bifurcated_one_piece_jumpsuit.text: One garment whose upper section continues through the waist into a real crotch and then bifurcates into two separate leg openings. A selected jumpsuit variant normally carries longer trouser legs, while a romper or playsuit carries short legs; the upper-to-crotch continuity, inseam, and two-leg topology distinguish every variant from a dress or coordinated separates. | 상체에서 허리와 가랑이까지 한 벌로 이어진 뒤 두 바지통으로 갈라지는 의복 | one upper garment continues through a real crotch before separating into two leg openings | the selected long or short leg variant remains legible without turning into a dress or two-piece set | the upper garment and waist remain one continuous unit | bodice seams continue into the lower garment | 상체와 허리선이 하나의 의복으로 연결됨 | the same garment continues through a visible crotch | waist shaping flows into the central rise | 같은 의복이 허리에서 실제 가랑이까지 이어짐 | a visible inseam separates two independent legs | two leg openings move separately during the stance | 인심과 두 개의 독립 바지통이 보임 | full-length trouser legs define the selected jumpsuit | short leg openings define the selected romper or playsuit | 선택한 점프수트 또는 롬퍼 길이가 일관됨 | a dress hem cannot substitute for the two-leg split | a matching top and trousers remain two garments and do not substitute | 드레스나 상하의 세트와 구분됨 | continuous upper garment and waist | waist-to-crotch continuity | visible central rise and inseam | two separate leg openings | long jumpsuit or short romper variant | distinct from dress and matching separates

culotte_cropped_wide_leg_topology.text: A cropped trouser topology with one waistband and a real crotch or center rise that separates into two independently moving, wide leg volumes ending around the calf. The inseam, separate hem openings, and stride evidence distinguish culottes or gaucho trousers from a midi skirt, while the cropped length distinguishes them from full-length palazzo trousers. | 허리밴드 아래 실제 가랑이와 인심이 있고 두 넓은 바지통이 종아리에서 따로 끝나는 하의 | two calf-length wide legs separate clearly during a natural stride | the center rise and two hem openings remain readable despite a skirt-like standing silhouette | one waistband feeds a central trouser rise | the waist construction continues into a crotch seam | 하나의 허리밴드에서 중앙 바지 밑위가 이어짐 | a visible crotch or inseam divides the lower garment | center separation remains traceable between the legs | 가랑이 또는 인심이 두 바지통을 분리함 | two wide legs move independently in the stride | left and right leg volumes have separate outer and inner edges | 좌우 넓은 바지통이 독립적으로 움직임 | two separate hems end around the calves | the wide legs stop clearly above the ankles | 두 개의 별도 밑단이 종아리 부근에서 끝남 | a continuous midi-skirt panel does not substitute for two legs | full-length palazzo hems cannot substitute for the cropped variant | 미디 스커트와 풀렝스 팔라초를 대체물로 인정하지 않음 | shared waistband and central rise | visible crotch or inseam | two independently moving wide legs | two calf-length hem openings | natural stride separation | distinct from midi skirt and palazzo trousers

gayageum_movable_bridge_pluck_press.text: A long Korean horizontal wooden zither whose multiple strings each pass over an individual movable anjok bridge. In active performance the right hand plucks on one side of the bridges while the left hand presses or bends strings on the other side; this bridge-and-finger system distinguishes it from a fretted geomungo played with a suldae. | 개별 안족 위의 여러 현을 오른손으로 뜯고 왼손으로 눌러 변음하는 가야금 | a seated performer plucking a long bridge zither while the other hand presses strings beyond the bridges | long horizontal wooden zither with multiple strings | 장방형 목재 공명통과 여러 현 | each string crosses its own movable anjok bridge | 각 현이 개별 이동식 안족을 지남 | the right hand plucks while the left hand presses strings beyond the bridges | 오른손 뜯기와 왼손 눌러 변음 | the instrument rests horizontally before the seated performer | 앉은 연주자 앞에 수평으로 놓임 | fixed frets and a suldae do not substitute for this bridge-and-finger system | 거문고의 고정 괘와 술대가 없음 | horizontal Korean bridge zither | individual movable anjok bridges | right-hand plucking | left-hand string pressing | seated support | not fretted suldae playing

geomungo_fretted_suldae_zither.text: A long Korean horizontal zither with a small set of strings, prominent fixed frets called gwae plus movable bridges, and a short suldae stick used by the right hand to strike or pluck. The fretted playing surface and suldae action distinguish it from a gayageum's many individual bridges and bare-finger pluck-press relation. | 고정 괘와 안족이 함께 있고 오른손 술대로 현을 타는 거문고 | a seated performer striking a long fretted Korean zither with a short suldae | long horizontal wooden zither with a small set of strings | 긴 장방형 목재 현악기 | prominent fixed gwae frets coexist with movable bridges | 고정 괘와 이동식 안족이 함께 보임 | the right hand uses a short suldae stick on the strings | 오른손 술대로 현을 타격하거나 뜯음 | the fretted zither rests horizontally before the seated performer | 앉은 연주자 앞 수평 지지 | bare-finger plucking across many individual bridges does not substitute | 가야금식 다수 안족과 맨손 뜯기로 대체하지 않음 | horizontal Korean fretted zither | fixed gwae frets | movable bridges | right-hand suldae | seated performance | not gayageum finger plucking

alto_tenor_saxophone_reed_conical_body.text: A curved alto or tenor saxophone with a single-reed mouthpiece and ligature, dense keyed metal body, conical tube, and flared bell. Lip contact at the reed mouthpiece and both hands on key clusters distinguish it from lip-reed brass instruments such as a trumpet. | 싱글 리드 마우스피스와 키가 달린 굽은 금속관 색소폰 | a curved keyed metal wind instrument played through a reed mouthpiece | curved conical metal body ends in a flared bell | 굽은 원추형 금속관과 벌어진 벨 | single reed and ligature sit on the mouthpiece | 마우스피스의 싱글 리드와 리가처 | dense keywork runs along the metal body | 금속 몸체를 따라 조밀한 키 장치 | the lips seal the reed mouthpiece while both hands operate keys | 입술은 리드 마우스피스에 닿고 양손은 키를 조작 | a cup mouthpiece and three piston valves do not substitute | 컵 마우스피스와 세 피스톤 밸브로 대체하지 않음 | curved alto or tenor saxophone | single reed and ligature | dense metal keywork | conical body and flared bell | reed embouchure | not piston trumpet

modern_piston_trumpet_three_valve.text: A modern piston trumpet with compact folded brass tubing, a cup mouthpiece, three aligned piston valves, tuning slides, and a forward flared bell. Lip buzz at the cup mouthpiece and valve-finger contact distinguish it from reed-driven keyed winds such as a saxophone. | 컵 마우스피스와 세 피스톤 밸브가 있는 현대 트럼펫 | a compact valved brass instrument played with lip buzz and three valve fingers | compact folded brass tubing leads to a forward flared bell | 접힌 황동관과 전방 플레어 벨 | a cup mouthpiece meets the player's lips | 입술에 닿는 컵 마우스피스 | three aligned piston valves sit beneath the right-hand fingers | 오른손 아래 나란한 세 피스톤 밸브 | lip buzz and valve presses visibly cooperate | 입술 버징과 밸브 누르기가 함께 보임 | a reed mouthpiece and dense side keywork do not substitute | 리드 마우스피스와 색소폰 키워크로 대체하지 않음 | modern piston trumpet | cup mouthpiece | three aligned valves | compact folded brass tubing | forward bell | not reed saxophone

cello_endpin_seated_bowed.text: A cello-sized bowed string instrument held upright between a seated player's knees, supported by an endpin on the floor. The right hand bows the strings while the left hand fingers the neck; the seated between-knees relation and medium floor-supported scale distinguish it from violin-family shoulder support and the much larger double bass. | 앉은 연주자의 무릎 사이에서 엔드핀으로 바닥 지지되는 첼로 | an upright bowed string body between the knees with its endpin on the floor | a cello-sized waisted wooden body stands upright | 중형의 잘록한 목재 공명통 | a visible endpin reaches from the body to the floor | 공명통 아래 엔드핀이 바닥에 닿음 | the body rests upright between the seated player's knees | 앉은 연주자의 무릎 사이에 세움 | the right-hand bow crosses the strings while the left hand fingers the neck | 오른손 활과 왼손 지판 운지 | human-height double-bass scale and standing support do not substitute | 사람 키의 더블베이스와 선 자세로 대체하지 않음 | cello-sized upright body | seated between knees | floor endpin | right-hand bow | left-hand fingering | not double bass scale

double_bass_human_scale_floor_supported.text: A human-scale upright double bass with a large waisted body, long neck rising near or above the player's head, and an endpin bearing weight on the floor. The performer stands or uses a high stool while bowing or plucking; this scale and support relation distinguish it from a cello held between the knees of a conventionally seated player. | 연주자 키에 가까운 대형 공명통과 긴 넥을 바닥 엔드핀으로 세운 더블베이스 | a standing performer beside a human-scale upright bass, bowing or plucking its strings | a human-scale waisted wooden body stands upright | 사람 키에 가까운 대형 목재 공명통 | the long neck rises near or above the player's head | 긴 넥이 연주자의 머리 높이까지 올라감 | a load-bearing endpin anchors the large body to the floor | 하중을 받는 엔드핀이 바닥에 닿음 | the standing or high-stool performer bows or plucks the strings | 서거나 높은 의자에서 활 또는 손가락으로 연주 | a medium cello held between conventionally seated knees does not substitute | 무릎 사이 중형 첼로로 대체하지 않음 | human-scale double bass | large upright waisted body | long neck above shoulder level | floor endpin | standing or high-stool playing | not cello

vibraphone_metal_bars_motor_pedal.text: A vibraphone with two rows of graduated metal bars, vertical resonator tubes containing visible rotating-fan assemblies, a damper pedal and frame, and mallets striking the bars. Metal bars plus motor-fan and pedal evidence distinguish it from wooden-bar xylophones and marimbas. | 금속 건반 아래 공명관과 회전 팬, 댐퍼 페달이 있는 비브라폰 | a standing player using mallets and a pedal on a metal-bar keyboard percussion instrument | two rows of graduated metal bars form the keyboard | 두 줄의 음정별 금속 바 | vertical resonator tubes show fan or rotor assemblies beneath the bars | 바 아래 공명관과 팬 또는 로터 | a damper pedal connects to the wheeled frame | 프레임 아래 댐퍼 페달 | mallets contact the metal bars while one foot controls the pedal | 말렛 타격과 발 페달 조작 | wooden bars without motor fans and a pedal do not substitute | 목재 바만 있는 실로폰이나 마림바로 대체하지 않음 | vibraphone metal bars | two-row keyboard layout | resonator fan assemblies | damper pedal | mallet-and-foot action | not wooden xylophone

xylophone_wooden_bar_resonator.text: An orchestral xylophone with two rows of graduated wooden bars on a frame, compact resonators beneath, and hard mallets striking the bars. Visible wood grain and the absence of a vibraphone's metal bars, motor fans, and damper pedal distinguish the instrument. | 두 줄의 목재 바를 단단한 말렛으로 치는 오케스트라 실로폰 | a wooden-bar keyboard percussion instrument with compact resonators | two rows of wooden bars show visible grain | 나뭇결이 보이는 두 줄의 목재 바 | the bars graduate from longer low notes to shorter high notes | 길이가 단계적으로 변하는 음정 바 | compact resonators sit directly beneath the wooden bars | 목재 바 바로 아래의 비교적 짧은 공명관 | hard mallets visibly strike the wooden bars | 단단한 말렛이 목재 바에 닿음 | metal bars, motor fans, and a damper pedal do not substitute | 금속 바와 모터 팬 및 댐퍼 페달이 없음 | orchestral xylophone | two rows of wooden bars | visible wood grain | compact resonators | hard mallet strike | not vibraphone

theremin_dual_antenna_noncontact.text: A powered theremin cabinet with one straight pitch antenna and one loop-shaped volume antenna. midi_controller_external_sound_source.text: A MIDI performance controller whose visible keys or pads, knobs and transport controls generate performance data for a separately visible computer, software instrument, or sound module. biaoju_guarded_cargo_departure.text: A guarded commercial departure from a biaoju loading yard or gate onto a continuous road. Sealed boxes or bundled cargo visibly load a cart, pack animal, or coherent transport unit; adult martial escorts distribute around that owned load and orient along its route. The cargo-protection relation, not readable signage or costume alone, separates the scene from an army convoy, merchant-only caravan, adventuring party, empty courtyard, or generic wagon. | 표국 문 또는 적재 마당에서 봉인된 상자와 짐을 실은 운송 수단이 도로로 이어지고 성인 무장 호송인이 화물 둘레에 배치된 출발 장면 | adult martial escorts distribute around sealed cargo loaded on a coherent transport unit departing a bureau yard through a gate onto one continuous road | one loading yard or bureau gate opens directly onto the departure road | 하나의 적재 마당 또는 표국 문이 출발 도로로 직접 연결 | sealed boxes or bundled cargo visibly load one cart pack animal or coherent transport unit | 봉인된 상자 또는 묶인 짐이 수레 짐승 또는 하나의 일관된 운송 수단에 적재 | adult martial escorts occupy front rear and flank positions around the same owned cargo | 성인 무장 호송인이 동일한 화물의 앞 뒤 측면에 분산 배치 | wheels hooves handles and body orientations continue from yard through gate onto one readable road | 바퀴 발굽 손잡이 신체 방향이 마당에서 문을 지나 하나의 판독 가능한 도로로 연속 | the scene remains a commercial armed cargo escort rather than an army convoy merchant-only caravan adventuring party empty courtyard or generic wagon | 군 수송대 상인만의 대상 모험가 파티 빈 마당 일반 수레가 아닌 상업적 무장 화물 호송 | biaoju guarded cargo departure | bureau loading gate | sealed owned cargo | coherent cart or pack transport | distributed adult martial escorts | continuous departure road

fantasy_portal_two_world_threshold.text: A bounded threshold that simultaneously connects two visibly distinct spaces and supports a coherent crossing relation. The boundary, near-side space, far-side space, occlusion continuity, and localized crossing consequence must coexist; a glowing ring, mirror, window, or decorative arch alone is not a portal. | 서로 다른 두 공간이 하나의 경계면을 통해 동시에 보이고 인물이나 사물이 그 경계를 실제로 통과하는 차원문 | a bounded interworld threshold with distinct near and far spaces, coherent crossing occlusion, and localized residue | one closed threshold boundary is anchored to the physical scene | 하나의 닫힌 경계가 실제 장면 표면에 고정 | the near side remains a complete readable local space | 가까운 쪽 공간이 완전하고 판독 가능 | a materially different far-side space is visible through the same boundary | 같은 경계 너머로 물질적으로 다른 공간이 노출 | one subject or object crosses the plane with coherent clipping and occlusion | 인물이나 사물 하나가 경계면에서 일관된 가림과 절단으로 통과 | light dust reflection or distortion changes locally at the threshold | 빛 먼지 반사 또는 왜곡이 경계에서만 국소적으로 변화 | two distinct spaces | bounded threshold | coherent crossing | occlusion continuity | localized portal residue | not a glowing ring alone

summoner_distinct_entity_arrival.text: A living operator causes one distinct entity to arrive from a bounded source or threshold. The operator, source, separate arriving entity, directional response, and local consequence must form one causal event; a companion portrait, empty magic circle, generic spell glow, or dead-body response does not establish summoning. | 살아 있는 시전자가 한정된 소환원에서 별개의 존재 하나를 불러내고 그 도착 반응과 흔적이 이어지는 장면 | a living operator, bounded source, separately arriving entity, directional response, and localized arrival consequence | one living operator performs a visible controlling action | 살아 있는 시전자 한 명이 판독 가능한 제어 동작 수행 | one bounded source or threshold anchors the arrival | 하나의 한정된 소환원 또는 경계가 도착점을 고정 | one separately embodied entity emerges rather than duplicating the operator | 시전자 복제가 아닌 별도 몸을 가진 존재 하나가 출현 | gesture gaze and entity orientation create a directional operator-to-arrival relation | 손짓 시선과 존재 방향이 시전자에서 도착체로 이어지는 관계 형성 | dust light shadow or displaced objects respond locally to the arrival | 먼지 빛 그림자 또는 밀린 사물이 도착에 국소 반응 | living summoner | bounded arrival source | distinct arriving entity | directional control relation | arrival consequence | not companion portrait

alchemist_material_transmutation_process.text: A practitioner uses connected workshop apparatus to transform a visible input material into a visibly different output state. Practitioner action, apparatus path, before-and-after material evidence, localized transition, and residue must coexist; costume, potion bottles, colored smoke, or a modern laboratory portrait alone is insufficient. | 연결된 증류·가열 장치에서 입력 재료와 다른 출력 상태가 동시에 비교되고 변환 경계와 잔류물이 보이는 연금술 작업 | an operator-driven apparatus path with paired material states, localized transformation, and physical residue | one practitioner actively controls heat flow or material contact | 연금술사 한 명이 열 흐름 또는 재료 접촉을 능동 제어 | retort crucible vessel and transfer path form one connected apparatus system | 레토르트 도가니 용기와 이동 경로가 하나의 연결 장치를 형성 | input and output material states remain simultaneously comparable | 입력과 출력 재료 상태가 동시에 비교 가능 | color texture phase or crystal structure changes at one bounded transition zone | 색 질감 상 또는 결정 구조가 한정된 변환 구역에서 변화 | condensate slag sediment vapor or heat discoloration traces the process | 응축액 슬래그 침전 증기 또는 열 변색이 공정을 추적 | working alchemist | connected apparatus | paired input and output | bounded material transition | process residue | not potion still life

golem_constructed_material_agency.text: One independently acting body is visibly assembled from clay, stone, earth, wood, or another nonliving material and remains materially continuous through its joints. Construction seams, activation response, grounded motion, and task consequence establish agency; a statue, costume, metal robot, rubble pile, or sacred inscription alone does not. | 점토나 돌 조각이 관절까지 재료적으로 이어진 한 몸을 이루고 활성화 반응과 실제 과업 흔적을 남기는 골렘 | one assembled nonliving-material body with coherent joints, activation response, grounded motion, and task consequence | one complete humanoid or creature body is assembled from nonliving material | 비생물 재료로 조립된 완전한 인물형 또는 생물형 몸 하나 | the same clay stone earth or wood continues across torso limbs and joints | 같은 점토 돌 흙 또는 목재가 몸통 팔다리와 관절을 연속 통과 | seams fitted blocks packed clay or bindings reveal deliberate construction | 이음선 맞물린 블록 다져진 점토 또는 결속이 의도적 제작을 드러냄 | posture contact shadow and displaced material show independent motion | 자세 접촉 그림자와 밀린 재료가 독립 움직임을 증명 | one handled load opened path or moved obstacle proves a completed task | 운반한 짐 열린 통로 또는 옮긴 장애물 하나가 과업 결과를 증명 | constructed material body | continuous joints | assembly seams | independent grounded motion | task consequence | not an inert statue

living_armor_hollow_articulated_agency.text: A complete articulated armor shell moves independently while a visible opening proves that no wearer fills it. Coherent plate articulation, hollow interior, grounded motion, and object consequence must coexist; an armored person, mannequin, robot, cropped suit, or floating helmet is not living armor. | 열린 바이저나 관절 틈 안쪽이 비어 있으면서 완전한 판금 껍질이 스스로 움직이고 주변 사물에 결과를 남기는 살아 있는 갑옷 | a complete articulated armor shell with a visibly hollow interior, coherent independent motion, and physical consequence | helmet torso arm and leg armor form one complete shell | 투구 몸통 팔과 다리 갑옷이 하나의 완전한 껍질 형성 | overlapping plates and joint gaps bend coherently at shoulders elbows hips and knees | 겹판과 관절 틈이 어깨 팔꿈치 엉덩이와 무릎에서 일관되게 굽힘 | an open visor neck gap or gauntlet opening reveals empty interior volume | 열린 바이저 목 틈 또는 건틀릿 입구가 빈 내부 부피를 노출 | balanced posture contact shadows and plate movement show unsupported agency | 균형 자세 접촉 그림자와 판 움직임이 독립 행동을 증명 | a grasped object opened door or displaced dust responds to the armor | 쥔 사물 열린 문 또는 밀린 먼지가 갑옷의 행동에 반응 | complete armor shell | articulated plates | visible hollow interior | independent motion | object consequence | not an armored wearer

wyvern_two_leg_wing_tail_topology.text: A narrow heraldic-fantasy wyvern topology with one head, one torso, two wings, exactly two hind legs, no separate forelegs, and one long tail. Because traditions vary, an explicit user definition overrides this default; a four-legged dragon, bird, wingless serpent, or extra-limbed chimera fails this profile. | 몸통 하나에 날개 두 장과 뒷다리 두 개만 연결되고 별도 앞다리 없이 긴 꼬리가 이어지는 와이번 | one coherent body with a single head, paired wings, exactly two hind legs, no separate forelegs, and a long tail | one head neck torso and pelvis form one coherent creature body | 머리 목 몸통과 골반이 하나의 일관된 생물 몸을 형성 | exactly two wings connect symmetrically near the shoulders | 정확히 두 날개가 어깨 부근에 대칭 연결 | exactly two weight-bearing hind legs descend from the pelvis | 정확히 두 개의 체중 지지 뒷다리가 골반에서 내려옴 | the shoulder wings occupy the forelimb positions as the only front appendage pair on the chest | 어깨 날개가 가슴의 앞쪽 부속지 한 쌍 전체를 차지함 | one long tail continues from the pelvis without branching | 긴 꼬리 하나가 골반에서 갈라짐 없이 이어짐 | wyvern topology | paired wings | two hind legs | no separate forelegs | long tail | user definition overrides

griffin_eagle_lion_topology.text: A coherent hybrid whose eagle head, hooked beak, paired wings, and avian forequarters transition into a lion torso, hindquarters, hind legs, and tail. The junctions must read as one anatomy; a hippogriff's horse rear, winged lion, eagle, or collage-like chimera does not substitute. | 독수리 머리·부리·날개·앞부분이 사자 몸통·뒷다리·꼬리로 자연스럽게 이어지는 그리핀 | an eagle-headed winged forebody joined coherently to lion torso, hindquarters, legs, and tail | one eagle head with a hooked beak and forward-facing neck anchors the creature | 갈고리 부리의 독수리 머리 하나와 목이 생물 앞부분을 고정 | two feathered wings attach coherently behind the eagle shoulders | 깃털 날개 두 장이 독수리 어깨 뒤에 일관되게 연결 | the chest and forelimbs retain avian structure or taloned forefeet | 가슴과 앞다리가 조류 구조 또는 발톱 달린 앞발을 유지 | lion torso hind legs paws and tail define the rear half | 사자 몸통 뒷다리 발과 꼬리가 뒤 절반을 정의 | feather fur skeleton and limb junctions transition as one viable anatomy | 깃털 털 골격과 팔다리 접합이 하나의 가능한 해부로 전환 | eagle head | paired feathered wings | avian forequarters | lion hindquarters and tail | coherent hybrid junction | not hippogriff

hippogriff_eagle_horse_topology.text: A coherent hybrid whose eagle head, hooked beak, paired wings, and avian forequarters transition into a horse torso, hindquarters, hind legs, and tail. The horse rear distinguishes it from a griffin, while the eagle head and forequarters distinguish it from a pegasus. | 독수리 머리·부리·날개·앞부분이 말 몸통·뒷다리·꼬리로 자연스럽게 이어지는 히포그리프 | an eagle-headed winged forebody joined coherently to horse torso, hindquarters, hooves, and tail | one eagle head with a hooked beak anchors the front of the creature | 갈고리 부리의 독수리 머리 하나가 생물 앞부분을 고정 | two feathered wings attach behind the avian shoulders | 깃털 날개 두 장이 조류형 어깨 뒤에 연결 | the chest and forelimbs retain avian or taloned structure | 가슴과 앞다리가 조류형 또는 발톱 구조를 유지 | horse barrel hind legs hooves and horse tail define the rear half | 말 몸통 뒷다리 발굽과 말꼬리가 뒤 절반을 정의 | feather and horse anatomy meet through continuous scale-coherent junctions | 깃털과 말 해부가 연속되고 규모가 맞는 접합으로 이어짐 | eagle head | paired feathered wings | avian forequarters | horse hindquarters and tail | coherent hybrid junction | not griffin or pegasus

hydra_multi_neck_single_body.text: One creature body supports three or more separately rooted, spatially readable necks and heads. Every neck must connect to the same shoulder or upper-torso system, with distinct head silhouettes, non-merged junctions, and grounded body scale; a three-headed dog, snake bundle, duplicated bodies, or decorative head halo is not a hydra. | 한 몸통의 어깨·상부 몸통에서 세 개 이상의 목이 각각 뿌리를 두고 갈라져 머리 실루엣이 분리되는 히드라 | one grounded creature body supporting three or more separately rooted readable necks and heads | one torso pelvis and limb system anchors every neck | 하나의 몸통 골반과 팔다리 체계가 모든 목을 고정 | three or more complete neck paths remain visible from torso to head | 세 개 이상의 완전한 목 경로가 몸통에서 머리까지 노출 | each neck has a distinct non-merged root on the same shoulder system | 각 목이 같은 어깨 체계에 분리되고 합쳐지지 않은 뿌리를 가짐 | each head retains a separate silhouette jaw and orientation | 각 머리가 분리된 실루엣 턱과 방향을 유지 | feet body shadow and nearby objects preserve one coherent creature scale | 발 몸 그림자와 주변 사물이 하나의 일관된 생물 규모를 유지 | one body | three or more necks | separate neck roots | distinct head silhouettes | grounded scale | not a snake bundle

phoenix_rebirth_causal_cycle.text: A single still compresses the phoenix rebirth cycle into connected evidence: an exhausted former body or ash nest, one emerging renewed bird, a contiguous ash-to-feather transition zone, directional rise, and localized heat or displacement. A generic flaming bird, fire wings, two unrelated birds, or ashes alone does not show rebirth. | 소진된 이전 몸이나 재 둥지에서 새 몸 하나가 솟고 재에서 깃털로 이어지는 전환부와 상승 흔적이 보이는 불사조 재생 | one renewed bird rising from a former-body or ash anchor through a contiguous ash-to-feather transition | one ash nest charred remnant or exhausted former body anchors the prior state | 재 둥지 탄 흔적 또는 소진된 이전 몸 하나가 전 상태를 고정 | one coherent renewed bird emerges from the same anchor | 새로워진 새 한 마리가 같은 앵커에서 출현 | ash ember filament and feather structures connect through one contiguous transition zone | 재 불씨 섬유와 깃털 구조가 하나의 연속 전환 구역으로 연결 | wing posture falling ash and rising sparks establish upward emergence | 날개 자세 떨어지는 재와 솟는 불티가 상승 출현을 확립 | heat shimmer scorched surface and displaced ash remain localized around the rebirth | 열 아지랑이 그을린 표면과 밀린 재가 재생 주변에 국소 유지 | former-state ash anchor | one renewed bird | ash-to-feather transition | upward emergence | localized heat consequence | not a flaming bird alone

familiar_practitioner_reciprocal_bond.text: A practitioner and one distinct animal-like or spirit helper visibly coordinate through reciprocal attention, a shared signal or medium, and one joint task consequence. The relation, not species stereotype, establishes the familiar; a pet portrait, decorative animal, coincidental eye contact, generic companion, or historical demonization does not. | 시전자와 동물형 또는 영체 조력자가 서로 주의를 주고받고 공유 신호를 통해 같은 과업 결과에 기여하는 사역마 관계 | a practitioner and distinct helper exchanging attention through a shared signal and contributing to one task consequence | one practitioner performs a clear task-directed gesture or handling action | 시전자 한 명이 과업을 향한 분명한 손짓 또는 조작 수행 | one separately embodied animal-like or spirit helper remains spatially distinct | 별도 몸을 가진 동물형 또는 영체 조력자 하나가 공간적으로 분리 | gaze posture or movement forms a two-way attention loop | 시선 자세 또는 움직임이 양방향 주의 고리를 형성 | one shared token thread reflection sound cue or light path links both participants | 공유 토큰 실 반사 소리 단서 또는 빛 경로 하나가 양쪽을 연결 | an opened latch found object carried sample or ward response proves one joint task | 열린 걸쇠 찾은 사물 운반 샘플 또는 결계 반응이 공동 과업 하나를 증명 | practitioner | distinct helper | reciprocal attention | shared signal | joint task consequence | not a pet portrait

magic_circle_local_rule_boundary.text: A closed, surface-anchored boundary visibly governs one local fictional effect: the inside and outside differ, the effect stops or changes at the line, and contact or residue proves the boundary. Original non-readable markings may decorate it, but copied ritual instructions, a portal ring, decorative floor pattern, halo, or free-floating glyph cloud do not establish the contract. | 실제 바닥이나 벽에 닫힌 경계가 고정되고 안팎의 효과가 다르며 빛·먼지·물체 반응이 선에서 멈추는 마법진 | a closed surface boundary whose fictional effect differs inside and outside and terminates visibly at the line | one complete closed boundary remains visible without cropped gaps | 하나의 완전한 닫힌 경계가 잘림이나 틈 없이 노출 | the boundary conforms to a real floor wall table or object surface | 경계가 실제 바닥 벽 테이블 또는 사물 표면을 따름 | light material motion or state differs visibly inside versus outside | 빛 재료 움직임 또는 상태가 안쪽과 바깥쪽에서 다르게 보임 | the fictional effect terminates bends or changes exactly at the boundary line | 허구 효과가 경계선에서 정확히 멈추거나 굽거나 변화 | dust liquid shadow scorch or object contact records the local rule | 먼지 액체 그림자 그을림 또는 사물 접촉이 국소 규칙을 기록 | closed boundary | real surface anchor | inside-outside difference | effect stops at line | contact residue | original unreadable markings

racerback_sports_bra_strap_convergence.text: A sports-bra back topology in which two separate shoulder straps converge between the shoulder blades into one narrow central Y-shaped yoke that remains connected to the lower band. The convergence and attachment distinguish it from parallel straps, a single X crossing, or a halter neck. | two shoulder straps converging into one central racerback yoke between the shoulder blades | 양쪽 어깨 스트랩이 견갑 사이 중앙 Y형 등판으로 수렴하는 레이서백 구조 | The photograph must preserve all five visible garment-owned relations for racerback sports bra in one frame. | two separate shoulder straps leave the left and right shoulders | both shoulder straps remain independently traceable before convergence | 좌우 어깨에서 두 스트랩이 각각 시작됨 | both straps visibly converge between the shoulder blades | left and right strap paths meet at the central upper back | 두 스트랩이 견갑 사이 중앙에서 수렴함 | one narrow Y-shaped racerback yoke continues below the convergence | the merged strap path forms one central back yoke | 수렴점 아래로 하나의 좁은 Y형 등판이 이어짐 | the central yoke remains visibly attached to the lower bra band | the back strap system connects continuously into the underband | 중앙 등판이 하부 브라 밴드에 연속 연결됨 | parallel straps, an X crossing, and a halter neck remain visibly excluded by the topology | the back structure cannot be replaced by parallel, crossed, or neck-tied straps | 평행 스트랩과 X자 교차 및 홀터넥을 대체물로 인정하지 않음

longline_sports_bra_extended_underband.text: A sports bra whose front or cup body continues into one broad fitted underband extending over the lower ribcage.
