private_security_access_control.text: An adult private-security worker whose role is visible through a site-specific non-police uniform, credential-to-reader verification, a logged authorize or deny decision, and a controlled-entry consequence at one facility boundary. | 방문자 신분증과 출입 권한을 리더기 및 기록과 대조한 뒤 승인된 출입구를 여는 성인 민간 보안요원 | an adult access-control guard whose credential reader log decision and doorway state remain linked | adult private guard in a coherent non-police site uniform | radio badge and access station belong to one facility system | 경찰이 아닌 시설 보안 근무복과 출입대의 일관성 | compares one visitor credential with the access reader and log | scans the badge while checking the approved entry list | 방문자 신분증을 리더기와 승인 목록에 대조 | green reader state opens one controlled gate | denied status keeps the restricted door closed and prompts assistance | 승인 상태에 따라 한 출입문이 열리거나 통제 상태를 유지 | authority remains limited to the named facility boundary | site badge differs clearly from public police insignia | 권한이 특정 시설 출입 경계에 한정 | adult private access-control guard | coherent site-specific non-police uniform | visitor credential verification | reader and entry-log relation | authorize or deny decision | controlled-door consequence

old_growth_forest_multilayer_deadwood_st.text: An old-growth forest is rendered as a structural relation among differently sized live trees, multiple canopy layers, standing dead trees, and large fallen wood. Age, ecological continuity, habitat quality, or protection status cannot be certified from appearance alone. | 여러 크기의 살아 있는 나무와 층상 수관, 선 채로 죽은 나무, 굵은 쓰러진 목재가 같은 숲 구조로 연결됨 | large live trees and smaller cohorts show visibly different trunk diameters and heights | overstory midstory and understory foliage remain separately readable at multiple depths | at least one standing dead snag is structurally distinct from the live trunks | one or more large fallen logs lie on the forest floor with convincing scale and contact | uneven tree cohorts | layered canopy | standing snag | coarse fallen log

wetland_hydrology_soil_vegetation_mosaic.text: A wetland is rendered through shallow inundation or saturated ground, water-shaped soil evidence, hydrophytic vegetation, and a readable mosaic between wetter and less-wet patches. Legal delineation, hydroperiod duration, or soil chemistry cannot be certified from one image. | 얕은 물과 포화 토양, 수생·습생 식생, 상대적으로 덜 젖은 미세 지형이 하나의 수문 모자이크를 이룸 | shallow standing water or visibly saturated ground occupies connected low areas | exposed mud dark saturated soil or a soft waterlogged margin remains visible | emergent or water-tolerant plants grow from the saturated substrate rather than beside a dry pond prop | wetter pools channels or hollows alternate visibly with slightly raised vegetated patches | shallow inundation | saturated mud | emergent hydrophytes | wet-dry microtopography

intertidal_high_low_exposure_zonation.text: Intertidal vertical zonation is shown as a continuous shore profile from a mostly dry spray or high zone through alternately wetted middle bands to a mostly wet low zone beside the current waterline. Species identity and exact tidal height cannot be inferred from pixels alone. | 현재 수면에서 위쪽 마른 비말대까지 젖음 정도와 생물 피복이 단계적으로 달라지는 연속 해안 단면 | an upper shore band remains comparatively dry and only spray exposed | middle shore bands show alternating wet rock pools and patchy marine cover | the lowest visible band beside the waterline remains wet with denser marine cover | all exposure bands occupy one continuous elevation sequence between sea and upper shore | upper spray fringe | alternating middle shore | wet low shore | continuous elevation sequence

karst_closed_depression_losing_stream_re.text: A karst drainage landscape is shown through soluble-rock terrain, a closed depression, surface water visibly disappearing into an opening, and a separate spring or resurgence outlet. The unseen underground connection, rock chemistry, and aquifer boundary remain contextual claims rather than pixel proof. | 용식 암반의 폐쇄 함몰지에서 하천이 사라지고 다른 지점의 샘 출구가 함께 보이는 카르스트 배수 장면 | exposed pale jointed solution-weathered rock anchors the drainage landform | a bowl or sink-shaped closed depression lacks an ordinary surface outlet | a surface stream visibly narrows and enters a sink opening or swallow hole | a distinct spring or cave-mouth outlet releases water elsewhere in the same landscape | solution-weathered rock | closed depression | losing stream | resurgence outlet

active_glacier_flow_valley_moraine_syste.text: An active valley-glacier landform is shown as a continuous ice body descending through a broad U-shaped trough, with directional surface structure, moraine debris at the margins, and a distinct terminus feeding meltwater. A still image cannot measure current flow rate, ice age, or mass balance. | 넓은 U자 계곡을 따라 내려오는 연속 빙체와 표면 유동선, 가장자리 퇴석, 말단 융빙수가 한 체계로 읽힘 | one continuous glacier body descends through a broad steep-sided U-shaped valley | crevasses flow bands or debris stripes follow the glacier down-valley direction | unsorted dark debris forms a lateral or terminal moraine directly against the ice margin | a readable glacier terminus releases meltwater into a proglacial channel or pool | valley-filling ice | down-valley crevasses | lateral moraine | terminus meltwater

aeolian_dune_stoss_crest_slipface_transp.text: An aeolian dune is rendered through one connected asymmetric sand body with a broad gentle stoss slope, a sharp crest, a steep lee slip face, and smaller wind ripples or grain-transport traces aligned across the stoss side. Exact wind speed and migration rate cannot be inferred from a still image. | 완만한 바람받이 사면에서 날카로운 마루를 넘어 급한 미끄럼면으로 이어지고 잔물결이 같은 방향을 지시하는 비대칭 사구 | a broad gently rising windward stoss slope forms one side of the dune | a narrow continuous crest separates the gentle stoss side from the lee side | a visibly steeper smooth slip face descends immediately behind the crest | fine sand ripples or short saltation traces align coherently across the stoss surface | gentle stoss slope | sharp crest | steep slip face | aligned sand ripples

cumulonimbus_tower_anvil_precipitation_o.text: A mature cumulonimbus is rendered as one vertically connected storm body with a dark low base, a deep cauliflower-like convective tower, a fibrous or flattened anvil top, and a precipitation or virga shaft descending from the cloud. Lightning is optional, and storm severity cannot be certified from appearance alone. | 어두운 낮은 구름 밑면에서 솟은 깊은 대류 탑이 섬유상 모루 꼭대기로 퍼지고 강수 기둥이 같은 구름에서 내려옴 | a broad dark cloud base sits low above the landscape or horizon | a massive cauliflower-textured tower rises continuously from the same cloud base | the upper cloud spreads into a flattened fibrous or striated anvil | a rain hail or virga shaft visibly descends from beneath the storm body | dark storm base | deep convective tower | fibrous anvil | precipitation shaft

alpine_treeline_forest_krummholz_tundra_.text: An alpine treeline ecotone is rendered as an ordered upslope transition from closed lower forest through shorter and more widely spaced trees, into wind-shaped krummholz, and finally treeless alpine tundra. Climate cause, elevation, species, and long-term shift cannot be inferred from a single image. | 아래쪽 닫힌 숲에서 키 작고 듬성한 나무, 편향된 왜성 관목형 수목, 위쪽 무수목 툰드라로 연속 전이됨 | a dense continuous lower-slope forest forms the base of the elevation sequence | trees become visibly shorter and more widely spaced farther upslope | a distinct band of low wind-shaped flagged or mat-like woody growth occupies the upper transition | treeless alpine meadow tundra or exposed ground continues above the krummholz band | closed lower forest | short sparse trees | krummholz band | treeless alpine tundra

oneiric_dream_logic_discontinuity.text: A familiar photographic scene whose orientation, scale, adjacency, or continuity breaks at one localized seam, made falsifiable by a repeated anchor and preserved subject or object continuity. Soft focus, pastel color, sleep, or floating props alone describe mood rather than dream logic. | 같은 의자와 인물이 문턱 양쪽에 이어지지만 문턱 너머 방의 중력 방향만 바뀐다 | one familiar corridor repeats a lamp across a seam where the destination reconnects at an impossible scale | a continuous walker crosses one bounded join while the same room changes orientation only beyond it | ordinary recognizable room route furniture or routine | 익숙한 방 통로 가구 일상 행동 | one bounded change of orientation scale adjacency or continuity | 한 경계에 국한된 방향 규모 인접 연속성 변화 | the same distinctive object pattern or threshold appears on both sides | 같은 사물 무늬 문턱이 양쪽에 반복됨 | one person or object remains identifiable across the impossible join | 동일 인물 또는 사물이 불가능 접합을 가로질러 이어짐 | light perspective contact or shadow localizes the break to one seam | 빛 원근 접촉 그림자가 위반을 한 이음새에 국소화함 | familiar scene anchor | localized dream discontinuity | repeated orientation object | single seam physics change | preserved traveler continuity | oneiric incongruity | bounded scale or adjacency break

ambiguous_figure_ground_dual_read.text: One unchanged depicted stimulus supports two complete and mutually exclusive figure-ground readings through the same precisely shared contour. A pair of separate pictures, transparent overlay, hidden object, or double exposure does not establish reversible perception. | 하나의 흰 윤곽은 두 얼굴의 옆모습이면서 중앙의 잔 경계로도 완전하게 읽힌다 | one unchanged coastline edge alternately belongs to an animal silhouette and the surrounding sky figure | the same negative-space border supports two complete readings without adding another outline | one unchanged physical image or arrangement | 변하지 않는 하나의 물리 자극 또는 배열 | one exact border belongs to either perceptual organization | 하나의 정확한 경계가 두 판독에 공유됨 | the first figure reads as a complete recognizable form | 첫 도형이 완전한 인식 가능 형태로 읽힘 | the second figure reads as a complete recognizable form | 두 번째 도형이 완전한 인식 가능 형태로 읽힘 | when one region becomes figure the competing region becomes ground | 한 영역이 도형이면 다른 영역이 배경이 되는 관계 | shared figure-ground contour | two complete perceptual readings | unchanged visual stimulus | mutually exclusive silhouette organization | balanced negative space | bistable perception | thumbnail dual readability

impossible_object_global_connection.text: A connected object or architectural path whose individual segments and nearby joins are plausible in perspective, yet whose complete depth, elevation, or closure relation is globally impossible from one fixed viewpoint. Random stairs, floating buildings, or generalized spatial distortion do not meet this topology. | 각 계단참은 자연스럽지만 전체를 따라가면 계속 올라가 제자리로 돌아오는 한 계단 구조 | a locally coherent beam turns through every visible joint and closes into a globally contradictory depth loop | one fixed camera reveals a channel whose complete connected path occupies incompatible elevations | each nearby stair beam channel or rail segment follows plausible perspective | 각 국소 계단 보 수로 난간이 자연스러운 원근을 따름 | the entire path and every necessary join remain inside one frame | 전체 경로와 모든 필수 접합이 한 프레임에 보임 | tracing the full connection produces incompatible depth elevation or closure | 전체 연결을 추적하면 깊이 높이 폐합이 모순됨 | one locked camera position carries the complete illusion | 하나의 고정 시점이 전체 불가능 관계를 성립시킴 | material texture light and occlusion remain continuous across local joints | 국소 접합에서 재질 빛 가림이 연속됨 | locally plausible segments | complete impossible connection | global elevation contradiction | fixed-view topology | continuous material joints | traceable closed path | local perspective global impossibility

liminal_transition_use_gap.text: A maintained familiar place suspended between expected passage and destination use: route or service cues remain, yet occupancy, active function, and temporal context are conspicuously missing or slightly displaced. Emptiness, darkness, decay, yellow corridors, or horror imagery alone do not establish liminality. | 운영 조명과 대기 의자는 켜져 있지만 도착편과 승객이 없는 환승 대합실 | a maintained pool passage still carries route and changing-area cues after every expected use has paused | repeating doors and ceiling bays lead toward an unresolved destination in a clean between-use concourse | corridor concourse waiting room pool passage or service threshold | 통로 대합실 수영장 통행부 서비스 문턱의 전이 기능 | working lights clean surfaces furniture signs or route markers imply normal use | 작동 조명 깨끗한 표면 가구 안내 경로 표식이 정상 용도를 암시함 | the people destination activity or service expected from those cues is absent | 표식이 예상시키는 인구 목적 활동 서비스가 비어 있음 | small traces imply just-before just-after or suspended operation | 사용 직전 직후 또는 유예된 운영을 암시하는 작은 흔적 | depth cues continue toward a route or threshold whose endpoint stays unresolved | 깊이 단서가 도착 기능이 해소되지 않은 경로 또는 문턱으로 이어짐 | between-use transition space | maintained vacancy | familiar route cues | expected occupancy gap | suspended operating time | unresolved destination depth | uncanny structural deviation

magical_realism_matter_of_fact_anomaly.text: An otherwise concrete everyday reality contains one impossible occurrence that characters treat as an ordinary fact while continuing practical activity, and the occurrence shares the scene's material light, contact, occlusion, and consequence. It is a narrative relation, not a prescribed regional aesthetic, costume, palette, or spectacle. | 세탁소 직원이 천장에서 내리는 작은 물고기를 피하지 않고 같은 다림질을 계속한다 | commuters calmly queue while one impossible rain cloud waters only a ticket machine and leaves a real puddle | an ordinary baker adjusts a tray beside a loaf that slowly floats yet still casts one coherent workbench shadow | specific ordinary home street workplace transport or service activity | 구체적인 평범한 집 거리 작업장 교통 서비스 활동 | one bounded physically impossible event occupies the ordinary setting | 하나의 국소적 물리 불가능 사건이 일상 공간에 존재함 | people respond with restrained practical acceptance rather than theatrical awe | 인물이 과장된 경악 대신 절제된 실용적 수용을 보임 | the same everyday task continues through or around the anomaly | 같은 일상 과업이 이상 사건 중에도 계속됨 | contact shadow occlusion displaced material or residue binds the anomaly to ordinary reality | 접촉 그림자 가림 이동 재료 잔류물이 사건을 일상 물리에 결합함 | specific ordinary workplace | one impossible occurrence | restrained practical acceptance | routine continues through anomaly | shared contact and shadow | localized material consequence | naturalized supernatural event

mirror_reflection_action_mismatch.text: A physical subject and the corresponding geometrically aligned mirror image appear in the same frame with matching identity, scale, clothing, and room markers, while one action, gaze, or temporal phase differs. Ordinary reflection, twins, montage, optical warping, and double exposure do not establish independent reflection agency. | 실물은 컵을 내려놓았지만 같은 옷과 방에 정렬된 거울상은 아직 컵을 들고 있다 | the physical subject looks down while the matching aligned reflection independently meets the camera | one clear hand gesture differs across the mirror while every room edge and clothing marker still corresponds | the physical subject mirror edge and reflected subject appear together | 실물 인물 거울 경계 반사 인물이 한 프레임에 함께 보임 | face clothing scale room lines and position establish one corresponding subject | 얼굴 의복 크기 방 선 위치가 같은 대응 인물임을 확정함 | one hand pose gaze task or action phase differs clearly | 하나의 손 자세 시선 과업 행동 단계가 분명히 다름 | all unrelated reflection geometry illumination and occlusion remain coherent | 무관한 반사 기하 조명 가림은 정상적으로 일치함 | one shared prop contact or room event ties both sides to the same moment | 공유 소품 접촉 방 사건이 양쪽을 같은 순간에 결속함 | physical subject and reflection comparison | mirror-edge alignment markers | same identity and clothing | single independent gesture | delayed action phase | otherwise normal room reflection | shared moment anchor

face_pareidolia_embedded_nonface_pattern.text: Ordinary components of a clearly nonface substrate such as wood, rock, cloud, stains, architecture, or an appliance align into a face-like configuration while their original material identity remains fully legible. An actual face, mask, sculpture, painting, sticker, or inserted eyes does not count as face pareidolia. | 나무의 두 옹이와 갈라진 틈이 눈과 입처럼 보이지만 목재 결은 끝까지 이어진다 | two facade windows and a vent form a face-like arrangement while every element remains functional architecture | cloud cavities create a fleeting face reading without adding eyes paint or sculpted features | wood rock cloud stain facade appliance or landscape is clearly the source | 목재 암석 구름 얼룩 건물 가전 풍경이 원천으로 분명함 | two eye-like marks and a mouth-like interval form a face relation | 두 눈 같은 흔적과 입 같은 간격이 얼굴 관계를 만듦 | grain texture construction or atmospheric form continues through every apparent feature | 결 질감 구조 대기 형태가 모든 얼굴 같은 요소를 관통해 이어짐 | viewers can read both the face-like arrangement and the original nonface source | 얼굴 같은 배열과 원래 비얼굴 원천이 동시에 읽힘 | ordinary substrate parts carry the reading through viewpoint and spacing | 보통의 바탕 구성요소가 시점과 간격으로 얼굴 읽기를 만듦 | clear nonface substrate | eye-like ordinary components | mouth-like interval | continuous material texture | simultaneous face and source reading | viewpoint-dependent arrangement | unmodified substrate parts

continuous_metamorphosis_source_target_b.text: One identifiable subject simultaneously shows a readable source form, a readable target form, and an unbroken anatomical, material, or topological transition zone connecting them, with residue or directional evidence indicating one change path. Separate before-after figures, costume changes, overlays, attached decorations, or a completed target alone do not prove metamorphosis. | 한 팔의 인간 피부와 손가락이 비늘과 날개 뼈로 점진 연결되어 같은 몸의 도착 형태로 이어진다 | one wooden figure keeps its carved torso while a continuous grain-to-feather bridge becomes a living bird wing | source fibers, intermediate membrane, and target scales occupy connected regions of one moving subject | one body mass pose and identity carry all transformation regions | 한 몸의 질량 자세 정체성이 모든 변신 영역을 연결함 | a substantial region retains recognizable source anatomy material or structure | 충분한 영역이 출발 해부 재질 구조를 인식 가능하게 유지함 | a substantial region establishes recognizable emerging target anatomy material or structure | 충분한 영역이 도착 해부 재질 구조의 출현을 분명히 함 | joints surface and topology change progressively through one unbroken intermediate zone | 관절 표면 위상이 하나의 끊김 없는 중간 영역에서 점진 변화함 | source residue tension contact or motion marks establish the direction of change | 출발 잔류물 장력 접촉 움직임 흔적이 변화 방향을 확정함 | single-subject identity continuity | readable source form | readable target form | contiguous intermediate topology | material gradient | directional source residue | mid-transformation body framing

phantasmagoria_projected_spectral_sequen.text: A staged spectral sequence produced by visible lantern or projector apparatus, a traceable light path, and a wall, smoke, or translucent receiving surface, with image replacement or scale change tied to operator or apparatus movement. A real ghost, hologram, fog silhouette, projector alone, or generic horror collage is not phantasmagoria in this historical projection sense. | 이동식 환등기의 광추가 연무 스크린에 닿고 운영자가 거리를 바꾸자 해골상이 커진다 | two lanterns switch a succession of spectral figures across one translucent screen while the apparatus remains visible | projected apparitions change scale and position along a bounded light cone inside a dark performance chamber | lantern lens movable projector operator or switching mechanism is visible | 환등기 렌즈 이동식 투사기 운영자 전환 장치가 보임 | a bounded cone connects the apparatus to the receiving surface | 경계가 분명한 광추가 장치와 투사면을 연결함 | spectral edges and brightness visibly land on wall smoke or translucent screen | 유령상 경계와 밝기가 벽 연기 반투명 스크린에 맺힘 | successive images replacement or projector-distance scale change is legible | 연속 영상 교체 또는 투사기 거리 변화에 따른 크기 변화가 읽힘 | operator apparatus audience side and projected apparition occupy distinct coherent depth layers | 운영자 장치 관객 쪽 투사 환영이 서로 다른 일관된 깊이 층에 있음 | visible lantern apparatus | bounded projection light cone | smoke or translucent screen | successive spectral images | projector-distance scale shift | operator-driven image switching | separated performance depth

earth_diver_first_land_creation.text: A landless primordial water field contains one diver who retrieves a small amount of earth, returns it to the surface, and visibly initiates the first land from that same material. Swimming wildlife, ordinary mud, or an already completed island does not establish the creation chain. | 원초의 물속으로 내려간 한 존재가 흙 한 줌을 회수해 수면으로 돌아오고 그 흙에서 최초의 땅이 퍼져 나간다 | one diving agent brings sediment from beneath a shoreless ocean and the same clod begins expanding into land | shoreless primordial water fills the scene before land exists | one coherent diver travels below and back toward the surface | a small distinct clod of retrieved sediment remains with the diver | the diver and recovered earth meet the water surface in one readable return path | new land visibly spreads from that same recovered sediment rather than preexisting nearby | shoreless primordial water | single diver agent | retrieved sediment clod | surface return path | same-material first-land expansion

cosmic_egg_world_emergence.text: One bounded primordial egg is shown before and during a causal rupture in which its interior, shell, or contained matter becomes an ordered world. A decorative egg, ordinary hatching animal, or unrelated planet behind a cracked shell does not demonstrate cosmic creation. | 원초의 알 하나가 갈라지는 경계에서 내부 물질과 껍질이 하늘과 땅의 질서로 이어진다 | a single cosmic egg ruptures and its own shell and interior visibly organize into world layers | one dominant intact-to-opening egg anchors the primordial state | the egg encloses visibly distinct luminous or material world potential | one readable rupture line and outward opening connect before and after states | shell and interior matter continue directly into emerging cosmic structures | newly separated sky earth or world layers emerge from the egg rather than as background decoration | single primordial egg | bounded world potential | causal shell rupture | egg-to-cosmos material continuity | newly ordered world layers

world_parent_separation_creation.text: A compressed sky-parent and earth-parent begin in contact, an active separating force opens a growing vertical interval between them, and light or habitable world space appears as the consequence. Two unrelated giants or an already open landscape does not show world-parent separation. | 맞닿아 있던 하늘 부모와 땅 부모 사이를 한 분리자가 밀어 벌리고 그 틈에서 빛과 세계 공간이 생긴다 | an active separator forces the contacting sky and earth parents apart until first light occupies the new interval | sky-parent and earth-parent begin as two distinct but contacting bodies or planes | the initial state visibly lacks open space between upper and lower parents | one readable agent or force actively pushes the upper and lower parents apart | a continuous vertical gap opens between the same two formerly contacting parents | first light and habitable world space visibly occupy the newly opened interval | contacting sky and earth parents | compressed primordial interval | active separating force | same-pair vertical gap | first-light world consequence

axis_mundi_three_realm_connection.text: One centered vertical axis physically and compositionally connects distinct lower, middle, and upper realms through readable boundary crossings. A giant tree, tower, or mountain that merely occupies the background without realm-specific transitions is not sufficient. | 하나의 중심축이 지하·지상·천상 세 영역을 관통하며 각 경계에서 물질과 방향이 바뀐다 | a single centered world axis crosses lower middle and upper realms with traceable passage through both boundaries | one dominant centered vertical structure serves as the world axis | lower middle and upper realms remain visually distinct around the same axis | the axis visibly penetrates the boundary between lower and middle realms | the axis visibly penetrates the boundary between middle and upper realms | one uninterrupted route or energy flow connects all three realms along the axis | single centered world axis | distinct lower middle upper realms | lower boundary crossing | upper boundary crossing | continuous three-realm route

moirai_fate_thread_life_allocation.text: Three distinct Moirai perform complementary actions on one continuous mortal life thread: Clotho spins its origin, Lachesis measures its allotted length, and Atropos cuts its endpoint. Three women with yarn or a severed thread without role continuity does not express the allocation of a life. | 클로토가 뽑고 라케시스가 재며 아트로포스가 자르는 하나의 생명실이 세 역할을 연속적으로 연결한다 | three fate figures occupy distinct spin measure and cut stations along one uninterrupted human life thread | three distinct fate figures occupy separate readable work roles | the first figure visibly spins or draws the beginning of the thread | the second figure visibly measures an allotted section of that same thread | the third figure visibly cuts the endpoint of that same thread | one continuous mortal life thread physically connects the spin measure and cut roles | three distinct Moirai roles | Clotho spinning origin | Lachesis measured allotment | Atropos cut endpoint | one continuous mortal life thread

mythic_apotheosis_mortal_divine_transiti.text: The same mortal remains identifiable across a staged transition into divine status through a retained mortal token, explicit reception or investiture by a divine order, and newly granted regalia or elevated placement. Mere levitation, glow, worship, or a deity replacing the mortal does not show apotheosis. | 필멸자 시절의 표식을 지닌 같은 인물이 신적 존재들의 영접과 수여를 거쳐 새로운 신적 표지와 자리로 올라간다 | one continuous mortal identity crosses a threshold where an established divine assembly receives and invests that person | one continuous person remains identifiable before and during divine elevation | a retained mortal garment tool wound or worldly token anchors the former status | the person visibly crosses from mortal ground toward a distinct divine level | an established divine assembly visibly receives crowns or invests the arriving mortal | new regalia radiance or seat is visibly conferred rather than merely possessed | same mortal identity | retained mortal-status token | mortal-divine threshold crossing | divine reception and investiture | newly conferred divine status

katabasis_living_underworld_descent.text: A demonstrably living traveler crosses a one-way downward threshold from the human world into a distinct underworld while carrying a visible objective, guide token, or retrieval purpose. Cave exploration, burial of a corpse, a dead soul being escorted, or directionless dark travel does not establish katabasis. | 살아 있음을 보여 주는 여행자가 지상 경계를 뒤로하고 목적물을 든 채 저승의 문 아래로 내려간다 | one living hero moves from daylight through a guarded downward gate toward an underworld objective | one traveler shows breath warm color active grip or another explicit sign of living agency | daylight vegetation settlement or another human-world cue remains behind the traveler | stairs slope gate or river crossing establishes a directional descent across a boundary | a distinct chthonic realm lies below or beyond the crossed threshold | a named objective guide token retrieval object or mission cue travels with the living visitor | explicitly living visitor | human-world origin behind | directional downward threshold | distinct underworld destination | visible descent objective

egyptian_heart_weighing_judgment.text: An ancient Egyptian judgment scene shows the deceased before a two-pan balance where a heart is weighed against the feather of Ma'at, Anubis attends the weighing, Thoth records the result, and Ammit or Osiris establishes the consequence. Generic scales, Anubis alone, or mixed-pantheon judgment imagery is not equivalent. | 죽은 이 앞의 양팔 저울 한쪽에는 심장, 다른 쪽에는 마아트의 깃털이 있고 아누비스가 저울을 다루며 토트가 결과를 적는다 | the deceased faces a heart-versus-feather balance attended by Anubis while Thoth records and judgment awaits | one deceased person stands or kneels as the explicit subject of judgment | one two-pan balance holds a human heart opposite the feather of Ma'at | Anubis visibly adjusts attends or verifies the central balance | Thoth visibly writes or records the weighing result beside the scale | Ammit waits near the balance or Osiris receives the outcome as a visible consequence | deceased judgment subject | heart versus Ma'at feather balance | Anubis attending scale | Thoth recording result | Ammit or Osiris consequence

mythic_flood_preservation_vessel.text: A deliberately prepared and sealed vessel preserves a bounded lineage of people, animals, seeds, or provisions through a world-covering deluge, with both catastrophic water and post-flood recession, grounding, or release evidence visible. A storm boat, crowded ferry, or animals beside a ship does not establish mythic preservation. | 봉인된 생존선 안에 사람·동물·씨앗의 계보가 질서 있게 보존되고 세계를 덮은 물 밖에는 물러남이나 착지의 흔적이 보인다 | one prepared vessel carries bounded living cargo through a world flood toward visible grounding or released-bird evidence | one purpose-built vessel shows organized compartments provisions or flood preparation | a deliberately selected lineage of people animals seeds or provisions occupies the vessel | closed hatches sealed seams tied stores or sheltered decks visibly protect the cargo | floodwater overwhelms ordinary land markers at a world-scale rather than forming one local storm | receding water grounding exposed peak or released bird marks survival beyond the flood | purpose-built sealed vessel | bounded lineage cargo | organized preservation provisions | world-covering deluge | recession grounding or release consequence

chaoskampf_cosmogonic_ordering.text: A named champion and a distinct primordial chaos adversary engage in traceable combat whose defeat directly produces or stabilizes cosmic order through partition, boundary, world matter, or sovereign placement. A dragon fight, monster slaying, or battle with no ordering consequence is not sufficient; named traditions must keep their own variant-specific lineage. | 질서의 챔피언이 원초 혼돈의 적과 싸워 쓰러뜨리고 그 결과 생긴 경계·분할·세계 물질이 새 우주 질서를 구성한다 | one mythic combat moves from champion versus primordial adversary to a visibly ordered world made from the defeat consequence | one tradition-bound champion remains distinct from the adversary and leads the ordering side | one primordial sea storm serpent or chaos adversary is visually distinct and tradition-bound | weapon force counterforce and contact geometry make the central combat readable | the adversary visibly passes from active resistance into a defeated or partitioned state | new boundaries world matter stable realms or sovereign placement visibly result from that defeat | tradition-bound ordering champion | primordial chaos adversary | traceable combat geometry | adversary defeat transition | defeat-caused cosmic order

active_comet_coma_tail_system.text: An active comet is read through a compact head embedded in a diffuse coma and one or more continuous tails directed away from the Sun; a bare asteroid, atmospheric meteor, or rocket plume is not equivalent. | a condensed comet head blooms into a hazy coma and a continuous tail whose vector points away from the illuminating Sun | 태양 쪽의 응축된 머리를 코마가 감싸고 반대 방향으로 먼지나 이온 꼬리가 연속해서 뻗는다 | one compact bright comet head remains embedded at the origin of the visible activity | a broad diffuse coma surrounds the compact head rather than forming a hard solid outline | at least one dust or ion tail grows continuously outward from the coma | the tail vector points away from the clearly established direction of solar illumination | compact comet head | diffuse coma | continuous dust or ion tail | anti-solar tail direction

barred_spiral_galaxy_structure.text: A barred spiral galaxy requires a central bulge crossed by an elongated stellar bar, with spiral arms beginning near the bar ends inside a common disk; a normal spiral, edge-on galaxy, or lens flare does not satisfy the morphology. | an oblique face-on disk shows a bright bulge, a straight central stellar bar, and two arms curling from the bar tips | 밝은 중심팽대부를 가로지르는 막대의 양 끝에서 나선팔이 이어지고 하나의 원반 안에 놓인다 | one luminous central bulge remains centered inside the galactic disk | an elongated stellar bar visibly crosses the central bulge | spiral arms begin near both ends of the central bar | the bulge bar and arms remain embedded in one coherent galactic disk | luminous bulge | elongated stellar bar | arms from bar ends | single galactic disk

interacting_galaxies_tidal_structure.text: Interacting galaxies require at least two distinct galactic nuclei or bodies plus tidal tails, a bridge, shells, or asymmetric distortion that is visibly connected to their mutual encounter; unrelated neighboring galaxies are insufficient. | two resolved galactic cores pull a luminous bridge between them while long tidal tails peel from their outer disks | 서로 구별되는 두 은하핵 사이로 조석 다리가 이어지고 바깥 원반이 긴 꼬리로 휘어진다 | at least two distinct galactic nuclei or bodies remain separately identifiable | a luminous tidal bridge or continuous tail physically links the encounter geometry | one or both outer disks show asymmetric stretching shells or pulled material | the distortions converge on the same close galactic interaction rather than unrelated overlap | two resolved galaxy cores | tidal bridge | outer-disk tails | shared encounter geometry

einstein_ring_lens_alignment.text: An Einstein ring visualization requires a foreground lens mass centered within one nearly circular ring or matched arcs made from a more distant source, with tangential curvature and lens-source alignment; a halo, portal, black-hole ring, or planetary ring is not sufficient. | a foreground elliptical galaxy sits at the center of a thin tangential arc that nearly closes into a ring from a lensed background source | 전경 렌즈 은하를 중심으로 배경 광원이 얇은 접선 방향 호나 거의 완전한 고리로 늘어난다 | one foreground lens galaxy or mass remains visible at the geometric center | a thin ring or matched arcs from a background source surround the lens | the elongated source images curve tangentially around the foreground lens | lens center ring center and background-source images share one coherent alignment | foreground lens galaxy | thin lensed ring | tangential arcs | shared optical alignment

black_hole_shadow_reconstruction.text: A black-hole shadow reconstruction is a measurement-derived image with a central brightness depression enclosed by an uneven emission ring at event-horizon scale; it must not claim a direct photograph of a solid black sphere, eclipse, or portal. | a sparse interferometric reconstruction shows a dark central shadow enclosed by a thick asymmetric millimeter-emission ring | 측정 재구성 특유의 제한된 해상도 안에서 어두운 중심 그림자와 밝기가 비대칭인 방출 고리가 보인다 | one roughly circular central brightness depression forms the black-hole shadow | a thick surrounding emission ring encloses the central depression | one side of the emission ring is visibly brighter than the opposite side | limited-resolution measurement reconstruction texture remains visible instead of a crisp direct-photo sphere | central brightness depression | thick emission ring | asymmetric brightness | interferometric reconstruction texture

relativistic_accretion_disk_visualizatio.text: A relativistic black-hole accretion-disk visualization requires a luminous disk, a dark central shadow, the far side gravitationally lensed above and below the shadow, and Doppler-like brightness asymmetry; a planetary ring or generic fire vortex is not equivalent. | the far rim of a luminous accretion disk bends into upper and lower arcs around a dark shadow while the approaching side burns brighter | 빛나는 원반의 먼 쪽이 블랙홀 그림자 위아래로 휘어 보이고 한쪽 가장자리가 상대적으로 밝다 | one luminous flattened accretion disk surrounds the compact central region | a dark central shadow interrupts the luminous disk geometry | the far side of the disk appears gravitationally warped above and below the shadow | one orbital side is visibly brighter than the receding opposite side | luminous accretion disk | central shadow | lensed far-side arcs | orbital brightness asymmetry

protostar_disk_bipolar_outflow.text: A protostellar system requires an embedded young central source, a flattened circumstellar dust disk, and two opposed jets or outflow cavities approximately perpendicular to the disk, all within a surrounding envelope; a mature ringed star or hourglass nebula is insufficient. | an obscured young stellar source sits in a dark flattened disk while paired jets pierce the envelope along the perpendicular axis | 먼지 포락층 속 원시별과 납작한 원반을 가로질러 수직축 양쪽으로 제트 공동이 뚫린다 | one embedded young central source remains partly obscured by surrounding dust | a flattened circumstellar dust disk crosses the central source | two opposed jets or outflow cavities extend from the same central source | the bipolar outflow axis remains approximately perpendicular to the flattened disk | embedded young source | flattened dust disk | paired outflows | disk-jet perpendicularity

supernova_remnant_shock_shell.text: A supernova remnant is an expanding shell or filament network whose outer shock boundary sweeps surrounding material and encloses an evolved interior; a live stellar explosion, planetary nebula, or generic colorful cloud is not enough. | a broken spherical web of shock-heated filaments marks an expanding front with compressed gas just outside and diffuse ejecta within | 끊어진 필라멘트 껍질의 바깥 경계가 주변 가스를 밀어내고 내부에는 더 희박한 잔해가 남는다 | an incomplete but coherent expanding shell encloses the remnant interior | thin shock-heated filaments trace much of the shell boundary | one outer shock front remains distinguishable from the diffuse inner ejecta | compressed or displaced surrounding gas visibly records outward expansion | evolved shell | shock-heated filaments | outer shock front | swept surrounding gas

auroral_arc_curtain_atmosphere.text: An aurora scene requires emission above a planetary horizon or atmospheric context, organized as long arcs or folded curtains with field-aligned vertical rays; green clouds, a nebula, or light pollution do not establish auroral structure. | a long luminous arc folds into a curtain above the dark horizon while narrow rays rise vertically through the curtain | 행성 지평선 위 긴 발광 호가 접힌 커튼으로 이어지고 그 안에서 가느다란 수직 광선이 솟는다 | a planetary horizon or atmospheric layer anchors the emission above the surface | one long luminous auroral arc extends across the sky | the arc develops folded curtain-like sheets rather than cloud masses | narrow vertical rays remain embedded within the auroral curtain | planetary horizon | long auroral arc | folded curtains | field-aligned rays

solar_prominence_magnetic_loop.text: A solar prominence visualization requires a visible solar limb and a coherent plasma arch whose two footpoints are anchored to the chromosphere, with loop-scale continuity; a detached flame, terrestrial fire, or generic coronal glow is insufficient. | a vast arc of glowing plasma rises beyond the solar limb and returns to two separated footpoints on the chromosphere | 태양 가장자리 밖으로 솟은 플라스마 고리가 두 발점으로 채층에 다시 연결된다 | the curved solar limb remains visible beneath the prominence | one large arch of luminous plasma rises above the limb | both ends of the plasma arch attach to separated chromospheric footpoints | the luminous material follows one coherent magnetic loop from footpoint to footpoint | curved solar limb | plasma arch | paired footpoints | magnetic-loop continuity

solar_flare_active_region_burst.text: A solar flare image requires a localized active region on the visible Sun with a compact, intense brightening or paired ribbons and immediate coronal response; a prominence loop, whole-disk glow, or detached CME front is a different structure. | a magnetically complex sunspot region contains a compact saturated flash with paired bright ribbons and short coronal loops | 복잡한 흑점 활동영역 안에서 국소적인 강한 섬광과 두 밝은 리본, 짧은 코로나 고리가 함께 나타난다 | the solar disk or limb establishes the burst on the Sun | a localized magnetically complex active region anchors the event | an intense compact brightening or paired flare ribbons occur inside that region | short bright coronal loops or nearby plasma response remain connected to the burst | solar disk context | magnetic active region | compact flare ribbons | connected coronal response

cme_coronagraph_snapshot.text: A coronal mass ejection coronagraph snapshot requires an occulting disk masking the bright Sun, a known solar-center marker or scale, and a broad outward-expanding plasma front in the surrounding corona; a solar flare, comet, or decorative halo is not equivalent. | a coronagraph's dark occulting disk hides the photosphere while a broad asymmetric plasma front expands through the outer corona | 검은 차폐 원반이 태양광구를 가리고 그 바깥 코로나에서 넓은 비대칭 플라스마 전면이 바깥으로 팽창한다 | one opaque coronagraph occulting disk masks the bright solar photosphere | a solar-center marker or inner scale remains registered behind the occulting disk | a broad asymmetric plasma front expands radially away from the masked Sun | the ejected front remains embedded in the fainter surrounding outer corona | coronagraph occulting disk | registered solar center | broad radial plasma front | faint outer corona

eva_spacewalk_work_system.text: An EVA work scene requires a suited crew member outside a spacecraft, a visible life-support backpack, a restraint system such as tether, handrail, or foot restraint, and direct task contact with exterior hardware; an indoor costume portrait or free-floating pose is insufficient. | a fully suited crew member outside the station braces on a handrail, safety tether clipped, life-support pack visible, and a gloved tool engaged with exterior hardware | 우주선 외부에서 생명유지 배낭과 안전줄이 보이는 승무원이 손잡이에 몸을 고정하고 장갑 낀 도구로 외부 장치를 작업한다 | the suited worker remains unmistakably outside a spacecraft or orbital station | the pressure suit helmet and visible life-support backpack form a complete EVA system | a safety tether handrail or foot restraint visibly secures the worker to the vehicle | a gloved hand or tool makes direct contact with specific exterior hardware | vehicle exterior | complete EVA suit and PLSS | tether or handrail restraint | gloved hardware contact

microgravity_orbital_interior.text: A microgravity station interior requires recognizable orbital-habitat hardware, multiple unsupported free-floating bodies or objects, differing local orientations without a shared down direction, and handrails or restraints used for control; jumping, levitation, or lying on a rotated set is insufficient. | inside a station module, a crew member and loose objects float unsupported at different orientations while fingertips use a handrail to arrest motion | 정거장 모듈 안에서 사람과 물체가 서로 다른 방향으로 떠 있고 손끝은 손잡이로 이동을 멈춘다 | station-module racks handrails and stowage establish a real orbital interior | multiple bodies or loose objects float without visible support or ballistic jumping cues | subjects and objects occupy different orientations with no shared downward direction | hands feet or restraints engage rails and loops to control motion | station-module interior | unsupported floating objects | multiple orientations | handrail motion control

spacecraft_docking_capture_alignment.text: A docking scene requires two opposed spacecraft or modules with compatible interfaces on a shared approach axis, close alignment, and visible soft-capture or hard-mate contact evidence; a flyby, formation flight, collision, or unrelated rings is insufficient. | two opposed docking rings share one centerline as guide petals meet and capture latches begin engaging | 마주 보는 두 도킹 인터페이스가 하나의 중심축에 놓이고 가이드 구조가 맞닿으며 포획 래치가 걸리기 시작한다 | two distinct spacecraft or modules remain visible on opposite sides of the approach | compatible docking interfaces face each other rather than the camera | both interface centers share one coherent approach and alignment axis | guide petals latches seals or contact indicators show active capture or mating | two opposed modules | compatible docking rings | shared centerline | capture hardware engagement

planetary_rover_surface_operation.text: A planetary rover operation requires a mobile surface vehicle with grounded mobility hardware, a visible science instrument or sampling mechanism interacting with a specific target, and an immediate trace or collected result; wheel count is mission-specific and must not be universalized. | a grounded rover braces beside an outcrop while its articulated instrument contacts one rock target and a fresh drill trace or sample tube records the operation | 지면에 닿은 이동형 로버가 노두 옆에 정지해 관절식 장비로 한 암석을 접촉하고 새 천공 흔적이나 시료관이 결과를 보여준다 | one mission-coherent mobile rover body and mobility system remain identifiable | wheels tracks legs or other mobility hardware visibly contact the planetary surface | a science instrument drill scoop camera or sampler engages one specific surface target | a fresh track drill mark displaced soil measured target or collected sample records the task | mission-coherent rover | surface contact | instrument-target interaction | fresh operation result

interpersonal_credible_threat_relation.text: An interpersonal threat scene shows one identifiable actor directing a credible threat of harm at one specific adult target, a coercive communication or gesture, and an immediate target response tied to that threat. General hostility, ominous styling, weapons without a directed target, and abstract danger indicators are insufficient. | 한 성인이 다른 특정 성인의 퇴로를 막고 위해를 예고하는 손짓과 요구를 하며 대상이 그 행위자에게서 물러선다 | one adult directs an imminent-harm gesture and coercive demand at a named target whose guarded retreat answers that same threat | one identifiable adult initiates the threatening communication or gesture | one specific adult target is visibly addressed rather than a generic crowd | the actor's posture gesture object or words clearly point the promised harm toward that target | guarded retreat raised protection or coerced compliance responds to the same directed threat | actor-to-target threat axis | credible harm gesture | coercive demand | targeted guarded response

interpersonal_physical_assault_event.text: A physical assault scene shows an adult assailant applying unwanted bodily force to a specific adult target, direct contact or immediate impact, and a localized bodily or environmental consequence at that same contact. Sport, mutual sparring, staged choreography, accidental collision, and aftermath without causality are separate. | 한 성인의 가격 동작이 특정 성인의 방어 자세와 같은 접점의 즉각적인 균형 붕괴로 이어진다 | the assailant's force reaches one target at a visible contact point and produces an immediate defensive or balance response | one adult assailant visibly initiates unwanted physical force | one specific adult target receives or actively shields from that force | limb body or held object reaches a coherent contact or near-contact point on the target | deflection loss of balance displaced clothing or nearby object movement occurs at that same interaction | adult assailant | specific adult target | unwanted force contact | same-point consequence

robbery_forced_property_transfer.text: A robbery scene requires an adult offender using force or a credible threat against a specific adult victim to obtain property, with the property visibly transferring from victim control toward offender control. Theft without confrontation, assault without property, consensual payment, and found property do not satisfy the relation. | 가해자가 특정 피해자에게 위해를 가하며 피해자의 지갑이 피해자 손에서 가해자 쪽으로 넘어간다 | an offender coerces one victim while a wallet visibly crosses from the victim's possession into the offender's control | one adult offender initiates the taking and controls the coercive action | one specific adult victim visibly owns holds or guards the targeted property | force or a credible directed threat compels the victim during the taking | cash bag phone wallet or other property visibly moves from victim control toward offender control | coercive taking | victim-held property | offender control | visible transfer path

forced_relocation_abduction_event.text: An adult abduction scene shows one or more abductors depriving a specific adult target of freedom and forcing that target from one place toward another, with a visible control method and a directional relocation path. Arrest, rescue, consensual travel, and restraint without relocation are not equivalent. | 성인 가해자가 특정 성인의 퇴로를 막고 차량 문 쪽으로 강제로 이동시키며 대상은 반대 방향으로 버틴다 | an abductor controls one adult captive and forces them along a visible path toward a vehicle or enclosed destination | one or more adult abductors visibly direct and control the movement | one specific adult captive is prevented from leaving or choosing the route | grip restraint blocked exit surrounding formation or directed threat removes freedom of movement | the captive is pulled carried or compelled along a readable path from origin toward vehicle room or secondary place | adult abductor | specific captive | freedom-removing control | origin-to-destination path

hostage_third_party_compulsion.text: A hostage-taking scene requires an adult captor controlling a specific adult hostage, a communicated threat tied to that hostage, and a demand directed at a distinct third party such as authorities or an organization. Captivity or kidnapping without third-party compulsion is not a hostage relation. | 성인 억류자가 특정 성인 인질을 통제하며 통신 장치로 외부 당국에 요구를 전달한다 | a captor visibly controls one adult hostage while directing a conditional demand to authorities outside the captive pair | one adult captor visibly maintains control over the scene | one specific adult hostage is confined or physically controlled | harm to the hostage is made conditional on compliance with a demand | a radio phone message sign or negotiation line directs the demand to authorities organization or another distinct party | adult captor | specific adult hostage | conditional harm | external negotiation target

fictional_intentional_homicide_causality.text: A declared fictional intentional-homicide scene shows an adult perpetrator deliberately applying a fatal action to one specific adult victim and a localized terminal consequence tied to that action. A still image cannot medically verify real death, legal culpability, identity, or exact cause; accident, self-harm, combat, and aftermath without a causal actor remain separate. | 허구 장면에서 성인 가해자의 의도적 치명 행위가 특정 성인 피해자에게 직접 이어지고 같은 접점에 비가역적 결과가 남는다 | a declared fictional perpetrator's deliberate fatal action reaches one adult victim and produces a same-location terminal consequence | one declared fictional adult perpetrator visibly initiates the fatal action | one specific declared fictional adult victim receives that action | the action path and controlled follow-through make deliberate lethal causality readable | an immediate localized collapse loss of agency or terminal scene trace occurs at the same target | declared fictional perpetrator | specific fictional victim | deliberate fatal path | localized terminal consequence

fictional_organized_crime_operation.text: A declared fictional organized-crime operation shows a continuing adult group with differentiated roles coordinating one serious illegal objective for material benefit, plus a shared operational trace connecting those roles. Gang styling, matching clothes, a meeting, or lawful logistics alone do not establish the organization or crime. | 허구의 성인 조직이 지휘·감시·운반·장물 처리 역할을 나눠 하나의 불법 물류 흐름과 수익 기록을 공유한다 | a fictional continuing group divides command surveillance transport and resale roles around one serious illegal operation and common proceeds trail | three or more fictional adult members show stable coordination beyond a chance encounter | command lookout transport enforcement or disposal roles are visibly differentiated | all roles converge on one explicitly declared serious illegal operation | shared ledger proceeds contraband route or handoff chain links the operation to material benefit | continuing fictional criminal group | differentiated operational roles | shared serious crime objective | proceeds or handoff trace

deliberate_arson_causality.text: A deliberate arson scene shows an adult fire-setter intentionally initiating fire at a specific property target, a coherent ignition point or introduced fuel path, and new flame or smoke growth beginning from that same point. A building already burning, wildfire, accident, firefighting, and ceremonial flame are insufficient. | 성인 방화범의 점화 동작이 특정 건물 출입구의 한 발화점에 닿고 그 지점에서 새 불꽃과 연기가 퍼진다 | a fire-setter's deliberate ignition reaches one property target and a fresh flame front grows from the same introduced point | one adult fire-setter visibly initiates the deliberate ignition | one specific structure vehicle or property surface is the selected target | a coherent contact path joins ignition source introduced fuel or fuse to the target point | new flame smoke scorching or spreading heat begins at that exact ignition point | adult fire-setter | specific property target | deliberate ignition point | same-point flame growth

burglary_forced_entry_crime_event.text: A burglary scene shows an adult intruder crossing a secured building boundary without authorization, fresh entry defeat at that exact boundary, and a linked criminal objective inside such as targeted property or evidence of search. Mere trespass, lawful locksmith work, rescue entry, and theft outdoors are different. | 성인 침입자가 갓 파손한 잠금장치를 통과해 실내의 특정 보관함을 탐색하며 파편이 같은 문턱에 남는다 | an intruder crosses a freshly defeated lock and the same path leads toward a specific interior property target | one adult intruder visibly crosses the boundary without ordinary authorization cues | a door window gate or other secured building boundary separates outside from inside | broken lock pried frame cut screen displaced pane or tool contact marks the same crossing point | a specific interior safe drawer inventory or search path makes the intended crime legible | adult intruder | secured building boundary | fresh defeat trace | interior property objective

retaliatory_violence_prior_harm_relation.text: Retaliatory violence requires a declared prior harm or debt, an adult retaliator who connects that earlier event to a specific adult target, a new violent reprisal, and a visible continuity token or mirrored consequence linking the two events. Anger, a single attack, competition, and abstract revenge styling are insufficient. | 선행 피해를 보여주는 부서진 표식과 사진을 든 성인이 같은 상대에게 새 보복 행위를 가하며 동일 문양이 두 사건을 잇는다 | a retaliator carries a prior-harm token into a new attack against the identified responsible target and a repeated trace links both events | a photo damaged token memorial mark or split-scene record establishes an earlier injury or loss | one adult retaliator visibly identifies one specific adult target as connected to that earlier harm | a new directed violent action is presented as repayment or reprisal for the prior event | a repeated object mark wound pattern location or timeline connects the prior harm to the new consequence | prior-harm evidence | responsible target link | new reprisal action | cross-event continuity trace

forensic_scene_documentation_process.text: Forensic scene documentation is a preservation process, not yellow-tape styling: an undisturbed scene is recorded through linked overall, midrange, and close-up views, stable evidence identifiers and measurement scales, and a location or sequence log that preserves where each item was found. A detective portrait or scattered markers without spatial continuity is insufficient. | 전체 현장과 증거의 위치 관계를 먼저 기록한 뒤 동일 번호표를 중경과 눈금 포함 근접 촬영에서 이어 간다 | linked overall midrange and scale-bearing close-up records preserve one item's identifier and location before collection | access control clean path and gloved handling preserve the scene before collection | overall midrange and close-up documentation views refer to the same evidence location | one evidence marker identifier and measurement scale stay consistent across the documentation set | scene sketch photo log or coordinate reference preserves where the item sits relative to fixed landmarks | preserved scene | overall-midrange-close-up sequence | stable evidence identifier | measurement and location log

bloodstain_observation_documentation.text: Bloodstain observation documentation records a declared fictional or controlled stain field before interpretation: the substrate and full pattern boundary, stain distribution and orientation, scale-bearing close-ups, and a location record remain visible. Color alone does not prove blood, and a still pattern does not by itself establish weapon, assailant, sequence, or cause. | 허구 현장의 벽과 바닥에 걸친 전체 혈흔 경계를 먼저 보존하고 방향 표식·눈금·번호가 같은 근접 기록으로 이어진다 | an overall declared fictional stain field, substrate boundary, orientation marker, and scale-bearing close-up are recorded before causal interpretation | the authorial core declares a fictional or controlled bloodstain field rather than identifying blood from color alone | the full distribution and its wall floor fabric or object substrate boundaries remain visible | measurement scale orientation marker and consistent evidence number accompany representative close-ups | documentation records observable form and location without claiming a unique weapon actor sequence or cause | declared fictional stain field | full substrate boundary | scale and orientation | observation before interpretation

custodial_torture_purpose_relation.text: A custodial-torture scene requires a declared fictional adult detainee under the physical control of an official or officially acquiesced controller, intentional infliction of severe physical or mental suffering, and a stated purpose such as obtaining information, punishment, intimidation, coercion, or discrimination. Restraint, questioning, injury, or cruelty without all relations is not enough; pixels cannot independently prove official authority or legal classification. | 허구의 구금실에서 공적 통제자가 특정 성인 수감자를 움직이지 못하게 통제하고 정보 요구와 연동된 의도적 고통을 가한다 | a declared fictional official controller holds one adult detainee in custody while intentional severe suffering is tied to a visible interrogation or punishment demand | a declared fictional official or officially tolerated controller has physical custody or control | one specific adult detainee cannot freely leave or end the encounter | the controller intentionally causes severe physical or mental suffering rather than incidental discomfort | information confession punishment intimidation coercion or discrimination is visibly stated as the purpose | declared fictional official control | specific adult detainee | intentional severe suffering | information punishment intimidation or coercion purpose

genocidal_group_destruction_campaign.text: A genocide profile applies only when the authorial core explicitly declares intent to destroy, in whole or in part, a protected group and one or more qualifying acts against members of that group. The visual scene must show a coordinated campaign, repeated group-targeting evidence, and a group-destruction consequence; pixels alone cannot prove special intent or infer real nationality, ethnicity, race, or religion from appearance. | 허구의 보호 집단이 사용자 서사에서 명시되고 동일 작전 표식의 여러 부대가 집단 구성원과 생존 기반을 반복 표적화한다 | a fictional protected group is explicitly declared while repeated units, records, and coordinated attacks show a campaign aimed at destroying that group in part | the requester declares a fictional or contextual protected group without deriving membership from appearance | orders records repeated targeting or campaign design explicitly states intent to destroy that group in whole or part | multiple linked agents or units carry out repeated killing serious harm destructive living conditions birth prevention or child transfer acts | the same group-specific campaign produces repeated member loss displacement survival-system destruction or forced child removal | request-declared protected group | explicit group-destruction intent | coordinated qualifying acts | repeated group-specific consequence

armed_conflict_protected_status_breach.text: A war-crime profile requires an explicitly declared armed-conflict nexus, a person or object whose protected status is supplied by the authorial core and visible context, a prohibited act directed at that protected target, and a localized consequence. Combat imagery, destruction, uniforms, or civilian presence alone cannot establish the legal classification. | 허구의 무력충돌 중 명확히 표시된 의료 구호소를 식별한 전투원이 그 보호 시설에 의도적으로 공격을 가하고 같은 지점에 결과가 남는다 | in a declared fictional armed conflict, a clearly identified protected medical site or detained person is intentionally subjected to a prohibited act with same-target consequence | the scene is explicitly situated within a declared international or non-international armed conflict | the authorial core identifies a civilian detainee wounded person medical site aid object or other protected target and context supports it | one identifiable actor or unit directs the declared prohibited act at that same protected person or object | damage deprivation forced transfer mistreatment or injury occurs specifically at the protected target | declared armed-conflict nexus | authorial-core protected status | directed prohibited act | same protected-target consequence

controlled_execution_custody_causality.text: An execution scene shows a specific adult captive already under complete control, one or more executioners arranged in an ordered killing procedure, a command or synchronized action, and an immediate consequence on that captive without reciprocal combat. The scene alone does not determine whether the execution is lawful, unlawful, judicial, summary, or extrajudicial unless the authorial core states it. | 완전히 제압된 특정 성인 포로가 지정 위치에 놓이고 집행자의 명령 신호와 동시 동작이 그 포로에게만 향한다 | a controlled adult captive occupies a fixed execution position while an authority signal triggers a synchronized lethal action directed only at that captive | one specific adult captive is restrained guarded or otherwise under complete control before the action | an executioner commander or authority role organizes the killing rather than an impulsive fight | fixed placement prepared method command signal or synchronized action makes the procedure controlled and deliberate | the action and immediate consequence affect the captive without return fire or mutual combat | specific controlled adult captive | execution authority | ordered lethal procedure | nonreciprocal immediate consequence

adult_nonconsensual_sexual_violence_rela.text: An adult sexual-violence scene requires the authorial core to declare an unwanted sexual act, attempt, contact, or sexualized communication involving a specific adult target, lack of valid consent or consent produced by force, intimidation, fraud, coercion, threat, deception, incapacitation, abuse of power, or vulnerability, and a visible actor-to-target control relation. Clothing, affect, location, or intimacy alone never establishes consent or its absence. | 허구의 두 성인 장면에서 대상이 접촉을 명확히 거부하고 물러나려 하지만 행위자가 퇴로와 손목을 통제하며 원치 않는 성적 접촉을 지속한다 | a declared fictional adult target withdraws and rejects unwanted sexual contact while the actor blocks exit and uses coercive control to continue the attempt | one adult actor and one specific adult target remain clearly differentiated | the authorial core explicitly declares the sexual act attempt contact or communication as unwanted | lack of valid consent or force intimidation fraud coercion threat deception incapacitation power abuse or vulnerability is explicitly present | target refusal withdrawal protection or freeze response and the actor's blocking or controlling action refer to the same encounter | specific adult target | declared unwanted sexual act or attempt | invalid consent or coercion | same-encounter refusal and control

declared_minor_targeted_crime_relation.text: A requester-declared minor is the specific target of a named criminal act. The scene shows one offender-to-target relation, a concrete act or coercive mechanism, and an immediate consequence or intervention trace belonging to that same event. | 사용자 서사에서 미성년자로 명시된 피해자에게 성인 가해자가 구체적 범죄 행위를 가하고 보호자의 개입 흔적이 같은 사건을 잇는다 | a requester-declared minor is specifically targeted by an adult offender's named crime and a same-event escape protection or consequence trace remains visible | the requester explicitly declares the targeted character under eighteen | 사용자가 범죄의 대상 인물을 미성년자로 명시함 | one identifiable adult offender or organized actor specifically targets that declared minor | a named assault abduction forced labor trafficking theft coercion confinement or other concrete crime is visibly underway | escape attempt protective intervention displaced possession confinement or immediate harm trace belongs to the same minor-targeted event | request-declared under-eighteen victim | specific adult offender | named concrete crime | same-event consequence or intervention

adult_human_trafficking_exploitation_cha.text: Adult trafficking in persons requires an adult victim, an action such as recruitment, transportation, transfer, harboring, or receipt, a means such as force, threat, coercion, abduction, fraud, deception, abuse of power or vulnerability, and a linked purpose of exploitation. Movement alone, smuggling, voluntary work, kidnapping without exploitation, and exploitative labor without the trafficking chain are distinct. | 성인 피해자가 허위 취업 문서로 모집되어 이동 중 통제되고 여권 압수와 채무 기록이 강제노동 장소의 착취 목적을 잇는다 | an adult victim is recruited by deception, controlled during transfer, deprived of documents, and delivered into a visibly exploitative labor arrangement | one specific adult victim remains identifiable across recruitment transfer harboring or receipt | recruitment transportation transfer harboring or receipt is visibly part of one linked chain | force threat coercion abduction fraud deception power abuse vulnerability abuse or controlling payment removes meaningful choice | forced labor servitude slavery-like service sexual exploitation or organ-removal purpose is linked to the destination or controller | specific adult victim | recruitment-to-receipt chain | coercive or deceptive means | linked exploitation purpose

terrorism_civilian_coercion_purpose_rela.text: A terrorism scene requires a declared violent act or threat intended to cause death or serious bodily injury to civilians or noncombatants, a public or population-facing target, and an explicit purpose to intimidate a population or compel a government or international organization. Destruction, ideology, armed actors, protest, or combat alone does not establish terrorism, and pixels cannot independently prove political purpose. | 허구의 공공 교통 허브에서 민간인을 겨냥한 폭력 위협이 외부 방송 요구와 연결되어 정부의 특정 행동을 강요하려는 목적을 드러낸다 | a declared fictional threat against civilians at a public hub is linked through a broadcast demand to population intimidation or government compulsion | specific civilians noncombatants or a civilian public place are the declared target | one identifiable actor or group directs a declared deadly or seriously injurious act or threat at that target | broadcast crowd-facing message public venue or mass notification extends fear beyond one private victim | an explicit demand or authorial-core statement ties the act to intimidating a population or compelling government or international organization action | declared civilian target | violent act or threat | public intimidation reach | population or government compulsion purpose

critical_threshold_pretransition_accumul.text: A bounded system remains intact while a readable pressure, heat, tension, charge, or load accumulates toward a system-owned threshold reference. A localized precursor and a still-visible remaining margin must coexist before the transition; suspense, a gauge alone, a peak, an aura, or post-rupture aftermath is insufficient. | 압력 용기의 물리 기준선 가까이 막이 불룩해지고 국소 응력이 보이지만 안전 여유와 봉쇄가 아직 남아 있는 전이 직전 | an intact load-bearing system with a rising driver, owned threshold datum, localized precursor strain, and a visibly remaining margin before failure | one bounded physical system remains intact and owns the approaching transition | pressure heat tension charge or load visibly accumulates through that same system | a system-owned safety line rating mark clearance datum or mechanical indicator defines the threshold | localized bulging strain heat discoloration vibration or instability appears at the most stressed region | an intact boundary and visible remaining gap prove the transition or rupture has not yet occurred | bounded intact system | accumulating driver | owned threshold reference | localized precursor | remaining margin before transition

barrier_breakthrough_causal_event.text: One aligned subject or force meets a previously resisting finite-thickness barrier, initiates rupture at a localized contact point, opens a new aperture, and crosses the former boundary with displaced material or another consequence at that same point. A barrierless explosion, preexisting opening, beam through fog, rubble-only aftermath, or victory pose is insufficient. | 두께가 있는 장벽의 한 접촉점에 힘이 집중되어 균열이 번지고 새 구멍을 통해 동일 주체가 통과하며 잔해가 같은 점에서 밀려나는 순간 | one continuous force vector joins resistant barrier, contact rupture, fresh aperture, passage, and localized displaced material | a finite-thickness barrier retains intact resistant material around one fresh breach | one subject object or force vector aligns directly with the same barrier contact point | fresh cracks tearing shear or plastic deformation radiates from that localized contact point | a newly opened aperture carries the same subject object or displaced material across the former boundary | debris dust fluid fragments or deformation traces remain localized along the contact-to-passage path | resisting finite barrier | aligned force | contact-point rupture | fresh aperture crossing | localized displacement trace

dormant_capacity_limiter_release.text: The same subject or system contains a functional limiter that visibly blocks motion, pressure, flow, or output. An active disengagement opens that limiter, and previously contained output emerges from the same source with an old-bound comparison and localized consequence. Waking, glow alone, an ordinary lock, costume change, possession, or external power donation is insufficient. | 기계식 조속기와 클램프가 engaged 위치에서 풀리며 같은 장치 안에 갇혀 있던 압력과 움직임이 한 경로로 방출되는 순간 | one continuous source, functional restraint, disengagement action, same-source output path, and localized release consequence | one continuous subject machine vessel or mechanism owns both the restrained and released states | a connected clamp seal valve lock collar governor or restraint visibly blocks motion pressure flow or output | a hand control linkage break retraction or opening actively changes the limiter from engaged to disengaged | previously contained motion pressure material light or energy emerges through the opened path from that same source | the former restraint position and a localized displacement pressure heat or material consequence remain comparable | same restrained source | functional limiter | active disengagement | same-source output | localized old-bound consequence

technical_overload_progressive_failure.text: A technical system with a readable normal rating receives sustained excess load, develops a localized heat, insulation, deformation, or strain failure at one owned component, and propagates that failure through connected dependencies toward a protection response or functional loss. A short circuit alone, external explosion, isolated spark, single broken part, or post-collapse aftermath is insufficient. | 정격 표식과 현재 부하가 같은 전기 패널에 보이고 한 단자에서 시작한 열 변색과 절연 손상이 버스 경로를 따라 퍼져 차단기가 동작하는 과정 | a rated system under sustained excess input with a localized failure origin, dependency propagation, and protective trip or functional loss | one coherent technical system displays or physically implies a normal rating and connected load path | input demand remains visibly above that rating long enough to create dangerous heating strain or deformation | heat discoloration sag insulation damage deformation or leakage begins at one identifiable owned component | failure evidence advances through a connected electrical thermal fluid or mechanical dependency path | a breaker relay shutdown relief action stalled output or other functional consequence completes the cascade | rated technical system | sustained excess load | localized failure origin | dependency propagation | protection or functional loss

phase_transition_nucleation_growth.text: One bounded material specimen remains continuous while a readable temperature, pressure, field, or concentration gradient drives multiple new-phase nuclei and a growing interface through the parent phase. Both phases must coexist in the same material system; lighting gradients, smoke, aura, unrelated materials, a completed product, or fantasy costume transformation is insufficient. | 투명 관찰 용기 안의 한 시료에서 기존 상 속에 복수의 새 결정 핵이 생기고 온도 구배 방향으로 계면이 성장하며 두 상이 동시에 남아 있는 장면 | one bounded specimen under a readable driver with parent phase, multiple nuclei, a propagating interface, and simultaneous phase coexistence | one material specimen has a complete readable boundary that owns every phase region | a temperature pressure field or concentration gradient acts coherently across that same specimen | the original parent phase remains materially legible around the emerging regions | multiple distinct nuclei of a new phase form inside the parent material rather than as surface decoration | a continuous advancing interface keeps parent and new phases simultaneously visible inside one specimen | one bounded specimen | driving physical gradient | parent phase | multiple new-phase nuclei | growing coexistence interface

irreversible_threshold_crossing_conseque.text: The same subject or process crosses a defined one-way threshold while its return route visibly closes, collapses, floods, burns, severs, or is consumed, and a committed downstream consequence begins beyond it. An ordinary doorway, reversible portal, sign alone, subject merely beyond a line, or black-hole icon is insufficient. | 같은 인물이 경계를 막 통과한 뒤 뒤의 다리가 붕괴해 귀환 경로가 사라지고 앞쪽의 새로운 조건이 이미 시작되는 장면 | one continuous subject intersecting a one-way threshold as the route behind becomes unavailable and a downstream committed state begins | one identifiable subject object or process remains continuous from approach through crossing into the downstream state | a concrete bridge hatch airlock edge line or boundary owns the one-way transition | the subject intersects or has just cleared that threshold along one readable direction of travel | the route behind visibly closes collapses floods burns severs or is consumed so return is physically unavailable | a concrete new condition or irreversible downstream process has already begun beyond the threshold | continuous crossing subject | defined one-way threshold | directed crossing | lost return path | committed downstream consequence

inaccessible_target_longing_relation.text: One adult makes an incomplete approach toward one identifiable target while a physical or procedural barrier or unbridgeable distance keeps the target inaccessible. The adult, target, barrier, directed action, and immediate contact or entry gap must coexist; a sad expression, window portrait, targetless waiting, distant-view appreciation, nostalgia, grief, or generic separation is insufficient. | 닫히는 투명 게이트 너머의 한 대상을 향해 같은 성인이 손과 몸을 뻗지만 접촉하지 못하고 손끝과 경계 사이 간극이 남는 순간 | one identifiable target beyond a closing boundary, the same adult's incomplete target-directed reach, continued separation, and a visible failed-contact gap | one identifiable target remains visible beyond the separating barrier | a closing physical barrier clearly blocks contact or passage | the same adult reaches toward that target without making contact | adult target and barrier share one readable relationship axis | a visible gap proves the approach remains incomplete | identifiable inaccessible target | closing access barrier | same-adult incomplete approach | readable actor-barrier-target axis | visible failed-contact gap

temptation_goal_conflict_choice.text: The same adult faces one concrete immediate reward that conflicts with a marked longer-term goal, makes one visible resistance or enactment choice, and leaves an immediate outcome on the untouched reward or interrupted goal path. A menu choice, ordinary comparison, reward close-up, seductive pose, or hesitation without a goal marker is insufficient. | 진행 중인 목표 도구 옆의 즉시 보상에 손을 뻗다 멈추고, 같은 성인의 선택 때문에 보상이 그대로 남거나 진척이 중단된 순간 | one adult connecting a ready reward, active long-term goal, mutually exclusive hand action, and a same-frame resistance or enactment consequence | a concrete immediate reward is ready within the adult's reach | the same adult's long-term goal tool and progress remain visible | the same adult's hand makes one choice between reward and goal task | the setting makes the two actions mutually exclusive in this moment | untouched reward or interrupted progress shows the choice outcome | concrete immediate reward | visible long-term goal | same-adult choice action | mutually exclusive paths | resistance or enactment outcome

repeated_acquisition_without_use_cycle.text: The same adult acquires another item from one category while several prior matching acquisitions remain visibly sealed or unused and already press on personal storage or attention. This is an observable acquisition event, not a diagnosis of addiction, obsession, compulsion, greed, or personality; retail inventory, warehouse work, emergency preparation, shared bulk purchase, or an actively used collection is insufficient. | 개인 보관 공간의 미개봉 동일 제품 여러 개 앞에서 같은 성인이 같은 계열의 새 물건을 수령하고 보관 압박이 이어지는 순간 | one adult linking multiple sealed matching prior items to a new same-category receipt with visible nonuse and storage pressure | the same adult owns the prior and current acquisitions | several matching prior items remain sealed and unused | intact packaging and absent use traces prove prior nonuse | the same adult receives another item from that same category | storage pressure or continued nonuse remains visible | same adult owner | matching prior acquisitions | sealed visible nonuse | new same-category acquisition | storage or attention imbalance

excess_accumulation_overflow_event.text: An adult continues adding matching resources after one visible storage or use capacity is already full, causing physical overflow, displacement, blockage, or the loss of space for another needed item in the same frame. other_owned_object_covetous_approach.text: One adult makes an overt claim, exchange bid, or boundary-crossing reach toward one primary object still visibly held or worn by another adult, and the current owner responds by protecting, refusing, considering, or withholding it. public_recognition_bid_audience_response.text: An adult publicly presents one specific work, achievement, or role marker to an identifiable audience whose several independent attention or access responses produce an immediate recognition result. resource_control_acquisition_event.text: An adult visibly seeks or obtains control over one valued resource or access right, and the resulting grant, withholding, blockage, or rerouting changes an identifiable affected person's practical access.
