legendary_rock_trace_evidence.text: One distinctive rock or outcrop remains fixed to a precise site and carries an anomalous imprint, body hollow, grip groove, hoof mark, or cleft that is continuous with the rock surface. A human, tool, or body-scale comparison makes the trace legible and separates it from ordinary weathering, painted symbols, loose props, and generic monoliths. | 지면에 박힌 특이 바위의 손가락 홈을 성인 손과 도구로 함께 재어 비범한 크기와 표면 연속성을 보인다 | a fixed boulder carries a five-finger grip trace whose scale and surface continuity are read beside a witness hand | one distinctive rock or outcrop is visibly rooted in its precise terrain site | one imprint hollow groove or cleft is materially continuous with the rock surface | a hand body tool or nearby structure makes the anomalous trace scale readable | trace contour depth and weathering show a contact-shaped event rather than painted decoration | a witness measurement gesture or site landmark frames the rock as evidence | fixed distinctive rock | embedded anomalous trace | human scale relation | contact-shaped contour | site landmark | evidence reading

guarded_hidden_treasure_attempt_failure.text: A clearly adult seeker is caught in an active digging, opening, reaching, or lifting attempt toward one fixed hidden cache while an identifiable guardian interrupts that same access path. ghost_ship_former_vessel_breach.text: One identifiable former working vessel remains physically readable through hull, rigging, deck, and service residue while a bounded connected part of that same structure breaks into translucency, absence, or spectral displacement. The event does not establish private feelings, consent, an ongoing relationship, or a narrative ending. | 한 명의 중심 성인 앞에서 세 명 이상의 성인 후보가 같은 시간과 동행 기회를 두고 양립 불가능한 초대를 내밀며 서로 반응하는 미결 장면 | three adult rivals compete for the same central adult and one limited invitation slot while the decision remains visibly unresolved | 질투 표정이 아니라 단일 선택점과 여러 제안선, 후보 간 반응, 중심 인물의 보류 행동으로 읽히는 연애 경쟁 | one clearly adult person is the common decision target at a single physical choice point | 한 명의 분명한 성인이 하나의 물리적 선택점에서 공통 결정 대상임 | at least three separate clearly adult rivals remain individually visible around the same target | 세 명 이상의 분리된 분명한 성인 후보가 같은 대상 주위에서 각각 보임 | each rival presents an invitation tied to the same limited time entrance seat or companion opportunity | 각 후보가 같은 제한된 시간 입장 좌석 또는 동행 기회에 묶인 초대를 제시함 | lateral gestures eyelines or blocked hands show that the adult rivals react to one another's bids | 옆방향 제스처 시선 또는 막힌 손이 성인 후보들이 서로의 제안에 반응함을 보임 | the central adult visibly holds or postpones the choice while all competing bids remain active | 중심 성인이 선택을 보류하고 모든 경쟁 제안이 활성 상태로 남음 | one clearly adult decision target | at least three clearly adult rivals | same limited opportunity | mutually incompatible invitations | cross-rival reactions | unresolved same-frame result

wide_angle_near_field_perspective.text: A camera placed close to a foreground anchor uses a wide field of view so near forms read disproportionately large, distant forms recede quickly, parallel spatial cues converge strongly, and several depth layers remain visible in one coherent scene. The relation is geometric and does not follow from a wide crop, a lens label, or arbitrary edge stretching alone. | a nearby handrail or prop dominates while the same corridor narrows rapidly toward small distant figures | 카메라 가까운 전경 물체가 크게 읽히고 반복 구조가 빠르게 작아지는 다층 공간 | close camera placement makes near-to-far scale change unmistakable without turning the frame into a fisheye caricature | one foreground anchor sits very close to the camera and reads conspicuously larger than its real-world peers | 카메라 바로 앞 전경 기준물이 같은 종류의 먼 대상보다 두드러지게 크게 보임 | repeated forms shrink rapidly toward a clearly distant background anchor | 반복 형태가 분명한 원경 기준점을 향해 빠르게 작아짐 | parallel edges or spatial lines converge strongly through the frame | 평행한 경계나 공간 선이 화면 안에서 강하게 수렴함 | foreground middle distance and background remain visibly connected in one continuous space | 전경 중경 원경이 하나의 연속된 공간으로 보이게 연결됨 | the exaggerated depth follows camera-to-subject distance rather than a crop fisheye filter or isolated edge warp | 과장된 깊이가 크롭 어안 필터나 가장자리 왜곡이 아니라 카메라와 피사체 거리에서 생김 | close foreground scale anchor | rapid near-to-far scale recession | strong converging spatial lines | connected foreground middle and background | camera-distance geometry rather than edge warp

telephoto_distance_compression_relation.text: A distant camera viewpoint and narrow field of view make separated depth planes appear closer together, enlarge background structures relative to the subject, reduce visible convergence, and preserve readable layer identities. The relation is not proven by blur, a narrow crop, or the mere mention of a focal length. | a distant subject appears backed closely by a mountain or building that is physically much farther away | 멀리 떨어진 인물과 원경 구조물이 화면에서는 가까이 포개져 보이는 망원 원근 | large background forms and weak line convergence flatten visible depth while distinct planes remain readable | the camera observes the main subject from a visibly distant position | 카메라가 주 피사체를 분명히 먼 위치에서 관찰함 | physically separated foreground subject and background planes appear unusually close together | 실제로 떨어진 전경 피사체와 배경 면이 화면에서 비정상적으로 가까워 보임 | a distant background structure remains large relative to the main subject | 먼 배경 구조물이 주 피사체에 비해 크게 유지됨 | parallel spatial cues show weak convergence and a flatter layer spacing | 평행 공간 단서가 약하게 수렴하며 층 간 간격이 평평하게 보임 | compression is proven by relative scale and plane spacing rather than digital cropping or background blur alone | 압축은 디지털 크롭이나 배경 흐림만이 아니라 상대 크기와 면 간격으로 증명됨 | distant camera viewpoint | crowded separated depth planes | large distant background scale | weak perspective convergence | compression beyond crop or blur

shallow_depth_focus_falloff_relation.text: One narrow depth plane is crisp while recognizable forms in front of and behind it leave focus progressively according to distance. Defocus morphology remains optical and continuous around occluding edges, so global softness, motion blur, or a synthetic cutout mask cannot substitute. | a sharp eye or object plane transitions through softer near and far layers rather than floating over a uniformly blurred background | 하나의 얇은 선명면 앞뒤로 거리에 따라 점진적으로 흐려지는 전경과 배경 | recognizable highlights expand into defocus circles with a continuous depth-dependent transition | one narrow primary depth plane retains crisp high-frequency detail | 하나의 좁은 주 초점면이 선명한 고주파 디테일을 유지함 | a recognizable foreground form becomes progressively softer before the sharp plane | 인식 가능한 전경 형태가 선명면 앞에서 점진적으로 부드러워짐 | recognizable background forms lose focus progressively behind the sharp plane | 인식 가능한 배경 형태가 선명면 뒤에서 점진적으로 초점을 잃음 | defocus crosses object edges continuously without a cutout halo or pasted-mask boundary | 디포커스가 오려낸 헤일로나 붙인 마스크 경계 없이 물체 가장자리를 연속적으로 통과함 | the sharp-to-soft pattern follows scene depth rather than global blur motion smear or skin smoothing | 선명도 변화가 전역 흐림 움직임 번짐이나 피부 보정이 아니라 장면 깊이를 따름 | narrow crisp focus plane | foreground focus falloff | background focus falloff | continuous optical edge transition | depth-driven rather than global softness

focus_stacked_extended_depth_composite.text: Multiple aligned captures with different focus distances are blended so near, middle, and far subject details are all crisp while framing, perspective, exposure, and scene state remain continuous. Natural transitions and clean occlusion edges distinguish the composite from a single-plane photograph, global sharpening, or HDR tone mapping. | the nearest texture, middle subject, and distant detail are all sharply resolved in one aligned still frame | 고정된 구도에서 전경 중경 후경의 서로 다른 초점 구간이 하나의 자연스러운 선명 이미지로 합쳐짐 | extended depth remains clean at occlusion boundaries without sharpening halos or perspective jumps | the nearest foreground detail is sharply resolved with local texture | 가장 가까운 전경 디테일이 국소 질감까지 선명하게 해상됨 | a separate middle-distance subject plane remains critically sharp | 분리된 중거리 피사체 면이 임계 선명도를 유지함 | a recognizably distant background detail is also sharply resolved | 인식 가능한 먼 배경 디테일도 선명하게 해상됨 | framing perspective illumination and scene state remain continuous across every sharp plane | 모든 선명면에서 프레이밍 원근 조명 장면 상태가 연속적으로 유지됨 | occlusion edges blend cleanly without doubled outlines sharpening halos or patch seams | 가림 경계가 이중 윤곽 과도한 샤픈 헤일로나 패치 이음선 없이 깨끗하게 합쳐짐 | sharp nearest texture | sharp middle subject plane | sharp distant detail | aligned framing and exposure continuity | clean occlusion blend boundaries

split_diopter_dual_focus_planes.text: A split-field visual arrangement holds one very near plane and one much farther plane sharp at the same time while an intervening depth band or optical transition remains softer. Shared lighting, perspective, and occlusion make the selective two-zone arrangement read as one continuous scene. | a close foreground object and a distant person are simultaneously crisp while the middle distance stays visibly softer | 아주 가까운 전경과 먼 배경 두 초점 구역 사이에 부드러운 중간 심도 띠가 남는 연속된 장면 | two separated sharp zones share one frame with a restrained split-field transition | one very near foreground anchor is critically sharp | 하나의 매우 가까운 전경 기준물이 임계 선명도를 가짐 | a critically sharp very-near foreground anchor | one clearly distant subject or background anchor is simultaneously critically sharp | 분명히 먼 피사체나 배경 기준물이 동시에 임계 선명도를 가짐 | a distant anchor stays critically sharp at the same time | an intervening middle-depth band or restrained optical transition remains visibly softer | 그 사이의 중간 깊이 띠나 절제된 광학 전환이 눈에 띄게 더 부드러움 | a softer middle-depth band separates the sharp anchors | lighting perspective and occlusion remain visually continuous across both focus zones | 조명 원근과 가림 관계가 두 초점 구역을 가로질러 시각적으로 연속됨 | consistent light perspective and occlusion across the focus zones | two separated sharp zones with a softer intervening band | 분리된 두 선명 구역 사이에 더 부드러운 깊이 띠가 남음 | critically sharp very-near anchor | simultaneously sharp distant anchor | softer intervening depth band | continuous light and perspective across both zones | two-zone split-field signature

panning_subject_tracking_motion_relation.text: The camera tracks a laterally moving subject during a slow exposure so the subject's identity-bearing core remains comparatively sharp, the environment streaks directionally, secondary moving parts retain plausible relative blur, and every streak agrees with the travel vector. Uniform shake, radial zoom blur, or a frozen subject pasted over a blurred background cannot substitute. | a moving cyclist stays readable while the street becomes horizontal streaks and the wheels retain rotational blur | 달리는 성인 피사체 핵심은 읽히고 배경은 이동 방향과 평행하게 흐르는 추적 패닝 | directional environment smear and comparatively sharp tracked features share one coherent motion vector | the moving subject's identity-bearing core remains comparatively sharp and readable | 움직이는 피사체의 정체성 핵심 부분이 상대적으로 선명하고 읽히게 유지됨 | environmental detail stretches into predominantly parallel directional streaks | 환경 디테일이 주로 서로 평행한 방향성 스트리크로 늘어남 | secondary moving parts retain plausible local motion or rotational blur | 보조 움직임 부위가 그럴듯한 국소 움직임 또는 회전 블러를 유지함 | background streaks subject travel and local motion cues agree on one lateral movement vector | 배경 스트리크 피사체 이동과 국소 움직임 단서가 하나의 측면 이동 벡터에 일치함 | comparative subject sharpness proves active tracking rather than uniform camera shake radial zoom or composited blur | 상대적인 피사체 선명도가 전역 카메라 흔들림 방사형 줌 또는 합성 블러가 아닌 능동 추적을 증명함 | comparatively sharp tracked subject core | parallel directional environment streaks | plausible secondary-part motion blur | single lateral travel vector | tracking rather than global shake

rear_curtain_flash_motion_trace.text: A slow ambient exposure records a moving light or subject trail first, then a rear-curtain flash freezes a crisp endpoint at the end of that trail. Ambient context remains visible, the trace leads naturally into the endpoint, and one coherent movement direction separates the result from front-curtain streaks, light painting, double exposure, or generic ghosting. | a dancer's ambient trail flows behind her into one crisp flash-frozen final position | 느린 주변광 노출로 남은 이동 궤적 끝에 후막 플래시로 선명한 종점이 고정됨 | the sharp endpoint arrives after the luminous trace rather than leaving a streak unnaturally in front | a continuous ambient-motion trace occupies the path immediately before the final position | 연속적인 주변광 모션 트레이스가 최종 위치 직전의 경로를 차지함 | one flash-frozen endpoint is crisp at the terminal end of the trace | 하나의 플래시 고정 종점이 트레이스의 마지막 끝에서 선명함 | slow-exposure ambient light keeps recognizable environmental context visible | 느린 노출의 주변광이 인식 가능한 환경 맥락을 보이게 유지함 | the trace direction leads naturally into the sharp endpoint as an arrival | 트레이스 방향이 도착 동작처럼 선명한 종점으로 자연스럽게 이어짐 | the image contains one temporal arrival relation rather than a streak ahead of the endpoint disconnected light painting or separate double exposure | 이미지는 종점 앞 스트리크 분리된 라이트 페인팅이나 별도 이중 노출이 아니라 하나의 시간적 도착 관계를 담음 | ambient trace before endpoint | single crisp flash-frozen endpoint | recognizable slow-exposure context | trace arrives into final position | rear-curtain relation not double exposure

rolling_shutter_readout_skew.text: Sequential sensor readout records different rows at different instants, so fast lateral motion or rapid camera movement produces a coherent direction-dependent shear: straight structures lean or bend consistently, moving forms skew across their height, and some local detail can remain crisp. A Dutch angle, wide-angle convergence, global warp, or ordinary motion blur cannot substitute. | vertical posts lean consistently while a fast moving vehicle shears across its height yet retains crisp local texture | 빠른 측면 움직임에서 수직 구조와 이동 물체가 같은 판독 방향으로 기울고 전단됨 | row-timed distortion changes geometry without simply smearing every edge | geometric displacement changes progressively across the sensor readout direction | 기하학적 변위가 센서 판독 방향을 따라 점진적으로 변함 | normally vertical repeated structures lean or bend consistently in one direction | 일반적으로 수직인 반복 구조가 한 방향으로 일관되게 기울거나 휨 | the fast-moving subject shears across its height or width instead of remaining rigid | 빠르게 움직이는 피사체가 강체로 유지되지 않고 높이나 너비를 가로질러 전단됨 | some local edges remain crisp enough to distinguish skew from ordinary motion blur | 일부 국소 경계가 일반 움직임 블러와 스큐를 구분할 만큼 선명하게 남음 | the shared readout-direction deformation cannot be explained by a tilted camera wide-angle convergence lens warp or uniform smear | 공유된 판독 방향 변형은 기울어진 카메라 광각 수렴 렌즈 왜곡 또는 균일 번짐으로 설명되지 않음 | progressive readout-direction displacement | consistent lean in vertical structures | moving-form shear across height | crisp local edges inside skew | sensor-readout distortion not camera angle

rembrandt_face_light_pattern.text: An elevated off-axis key joins the nose shadow to the shadow-side cheek, leaving one contained triangle of light beneath the shadow-side eye. The key-facing side is illuminated and the shadow-side eye remains readable. Camera-near and camera-far orientation are independent of this pattern, so broad or short orientation can be chosen separately. | one adult face carries a small illuminated triangle under the shadow-side eye where the nose and cheek shadows meet | 성인 얼굴의 그림자 쪽 눈 아래에 코 그림자와 볼 그림자 사이 삼각광이 남는 조명 | an elevated off-axis key produces the characteristic cheek triangle while preserving a readable shadow-side eye | one elevated off-axis key illuminates the key-facing side of the adult face | 하나의 높은 비축 키라이트가 성인 얼굴의 키라이트를 향한 쪽을 비춤 | an elevated off-axis key models the light-facing side | the nose shadow connects into the shadow-side cheek mass | 코 그림자가 그림자 쪽 볼의 큰 그림자와 연결됨 | nose and shadow-side cheek shadows visibly join | one contained inverted triangle of light remains beneath the shadow-side eye | 그림자 쪽 눈 아래에 하나의 제한된 역삼각형 빛이 남음 | a contained light triangle beneath the shadow-side eye | the shadow-side eye and facial structure remain readable without flattening the shadows | 그림자 쪽 눈과 얼굴 구조가 그림자를 평평하게 만들지 않고 읽히게 남음 | readable shadow-side eye within retained facial shadows | joined nose-cheek shadows enclose the cheek triangle | 연결된 코와 볼 그림자가 볼의 삼각광을 둘러쌈 | elevated off-axis key | joined nose and cheek shadow | contained light triangle under shadow-side eye | readable modeled shadow-side eye | independent camera-side face orientation

clamshell_dual_source_portrait_light.text: A large frontal source above an adult face and a weaker frontal source or reflector below it form a vertical clamshell. Lower fill lifts chin and eye-socket shadows while preserving dimensional facial modeling. When the eyes are visible, high and low catchlights can provide supporting evidence of the arrangement. | an upper frontal soft source and weaker lower fill gently open the eye and chin shadows while preserving facial dimension | 성인 얼굴 위 큰 소프트 키와 아래 약한 필이 세로로 마주 보며 눈 밑과 턱 그림자를 부드럽게 엶 | even beauty illumination retains dimensional nose and cheek modeling with a weaker lower frontal return | one large frontal source above the adult face provides the dominant soft key | 성인 얼굴 위의 큰 정면 광원이 지배적인 소프트 키를 제공함 | a dominant large soft key above the face | a weaker frontal source or reflector below the face returns controlled upward fill | 얼굴 아래의 약한 정면 광원이나 반사판이 절제된 상향 필을 되돌림 | weaker lower frontal fill returns light beneath the face | upper and lower catchlight evidence aligns vertically within the eyes | 눈 안에 위아래 캐치라이트 증거가 수직으로 정렬됨 | a vertical pair of high and low catchlights | eye-socket nose and chin shadows are lifted without disappearing completely | 눈구멍 코와 턱 그림자가 완전히 사라지지 않은 채 완화됨 | lifted eye-socket nose and chin shadows retain visible shape | cheek nose and jaw modeling retains visible dimension | 볼 코 턱의 모델링이 뚜렷한 입체감을 유지함 | large upper frontal soft key | weaker lower frontal return | vertical high-low catchlights when eyes are visible | lifted eye and chin shadows | dimensional facial modeling

negative_fill_shadow_deepening_relation.text: A dark flag or unlit surface near the shadow side removes ambient bounce so that side becomes deeper and more sculpted while the key-lit side and overall exposure remain stable. Localized contrast increase, readable shadow structure, and visible relation to a nearby absorber distinguish negative fill from underexposure, black styling, split lighting, or global contrast grading. | a black flag close to the shadow cheek subtracts room bounce while the key side keeps the same exposure | 그림자 쪽 가까운 검은 면이 반사광을 흡수해 볼과 턱의 음영만 더 깊어짐 | localized shadow density increases without crushing the entire frame or changing the key source | a dark flag wall or unlit surface sits close to the intended shadow side | 어두운 플래그 벽 또는 비조명 표면이 의도한 그림자 쪽 가까이에 놓임 | ambient reflected fill is visibly reduced on the side facing the dark surface | 어두운 표면을 향한 쪽에서 주변 반사 필이 눈에 띄게 줄어듦 | cheek jaw object or material shadows deepen locally while retaining internal detail | 볼 턱 물체 또는 재질 그림자가 내부 디테일을 유지하며 국소적으로 깊어짐 | the key-lit side and overall exposure remain stable and correctly exposed | 키라이트 쪽과 전체 노출이 안정적으로 올바른 노출을 유지함 | localized bounce subtraction rather than global underexposure black styling split light or contrast grading explains the shadow change | 전역 노출 부족 검은 스타일링 분할광 또는 대비 그레이딩이 아니라 국소 반사광 감산이 그림자 변화를 설명함 | nearby dark absorption surface | suppressed ambient bounce | localized deeper modeled shadow | stable correctly exposed key side | subtractive light control not underexposure

diffusion_filter_highlight_halation.text: An optical diffusion filter spreads practical and specular highlights into restrained local halos, gently lowers nearby contrast, and keeps focal-plane eyes, hair, edges, or material texture apparently sharp. The effect is spatially tied to bright sources and does not become film-base red halation, atmospheric fog, global blur, or flare ghosts. | small practical lamps carry soft clean halos while the subject's eyes and hair remain apparently sharp | 밝은 실광원 주변에 국소적 부드러운 광륜이 생기지만 눈과 머리카락의 초점 디테일은 유지됨 | highlight bloom gently rolls into adjacent shadows without washing the whole image | one or more practical or specular highlights provide identifiable bright source anchors | 하나 이상의 실광원 또는 정반사 하이라이트가 식별 가능한 밝은 광원 기준점을 제공함 | a restrained soft halo spreads locally around each bright source | 절제된 부드러운 광륜이 각 밝은 광원 주변에 국소적으로 퍼짐 | contrast softens gently near the halos and rolls into adjacent shadow values | 광륜 근처 대비가 부드럽게 낮아지고 인접 그림자 값으로 이어짐 | focal-plane eyes hair edges or material texture retain apparent sharpness | 초점면의 눈 머리카락 경계 또는 재질 질감이 겉보기 선명도를 유지함 | halos stay tied to bright sources rather than becoming red film-base fringes atmospheric fog global blur or repeated flare ghosts | 광륜은 붉은 필름 베이스 경계 대기 안개 전역 흐림 또는 반복 플레어 고스트가 아니라 밝은 광원에 묶임 | identifiable practical highlight anchors | restrained local soft halos | gentle nearby contrast spread | apparently sharp focal-plane detail | source-tied diffusion not fog or film halation

mixed_illuminant_white_balance_relation.text: Two or more identifiable light sources with different spectral or color-temperature tendencies illuminate different spatial regions, while one neutral or familiar surface anchors the chosen white balance. Warm-cool transitions follow source direction and occlusion, and material colors remain coherent, distinguishing mixed illumination from split toning, gradient maps, arbitrary gels, or a global color grade. | warm window light and cool overhead light occupy different sides of a room while a white page stays plausibly neutral | 따뜻한 창광과 차가운 천장광이 서로 다른 공간 영역을 비추고 중성 표면이 화이트밸런스를 고정함 | color-temperature boundaries follow actual light falloff and occlusion instead of a screen-space gradient | at least two identifiable light sources carry visibly different color-temperature tendencies | 적어도 두 개의 식별 가능한 광원이 눈에 띄게 다른 색온도 경향을 가짐 | warm and cool illumination occupy spatial regions consistent with source direction falloff and occlusion | 따뜻하고 차가운 조명이 광원 방향 감쇠와 가림에 맞는 공간 영역을 차지함 | one neutral or familiar surface anchors the chosen white-balance interpretation | 하나의 중성 또는 익숙한 표면이 선택된 화이트밸런스 해석을 고정함 | the same material changes plausibly under each source without losing its underlying identity | 같은 재질이 각 광원 아래에서 기본 정체성을 잃지 않고 그럴듯하게 변함 | the color boundary follows physical lighting rather than split toning a gradient map arbitrary gel wash or global grade | 색 경계가 스플릿 토닝 그라디언트 맵 임의 젤 워시나 전역 그레이드가 아니라 물리적 조명을 따름 | two identifiable color-temperature sources | source-consistent warm-cool regions | neutral white-balance anchor surface | coherent material response under both lights | physical illumination boundary not color grade

highlight_rolloff_tone_response.text: Bright diffuse surfaces and specular highlights approach white through a gradual luminance shoulder: a small core may clip, surrounding bright texture and hue survive, midtones remain separated, and the transition lacks abrupt contouring or HDR halos. The response is tonal and does not follow from flat contrast, underexposure, glow, or uniformly gray highlights. | a bright window reflection reaches a small white core through several visible highlight steps while nearby texture survives | 밝은 피부나 금속 반사가 작은 흰 중심까지 점진적으로 올라가며 주변 밝은 질감과 색이 남음 | highlights compress smoothly without turning the image flat or creating local HDR outlines | one bright diffuse surface or specular highlight provides a clear near-white anchor | 하나의 밝은 확산 표면 또는 정반사 하이라이트가 분명한 거의 흰색 기준점을 제공함 | luminance approaches white through a gradual shoulder with several distinguishable bright steps | 휘도가 구분 가능한 여러 밝은 단계를 가진 점진적 숄더를 통해 흰색에 접근함 | any fully clipped white area stays confined to a small specular or source core | 완전히 클리핑된 흰 영역이 작은 정반사 또는 광원 중심에만 제한됨 | surrounding highlight texture subtle hue and midtone separation remain visible | 주변 하이라이트 질감 미묘한 색상과 중간톤 분리가 보이게 남음 | the smooth highlight shoulder is not replaced by flat low contrast underexposure glow gray highlights or local HDR halos | 부드러운 하이라이트 숄더가 평면 저대비 노출 부족 글로우 회색 하이라이트나 국소 HDR 헤일로로 대체되지 않음 | clear near-white highlight anchor | gradual luminance shoulder | small confined clip core | surviving bright texture hue and midtones | smooth rolloff not flat contrast or HDR

hard_light_shadow_edge_relation.text: A relatively small acting source creates one coherent direction, crisp cast-shadow boundaries, short penumbrae, decisive form shadows, and localized specular response without requiring darkness or clipping. | one coherent source direction links highlights form shadows and cast shadows | cast-shadow edges remain crisp with a short visible penumbra | shadow shapes correspond to the occluding subject or object geometry | specular highlights are comparatively compact and directionally owned | lit surfaces and shadow structure remain exposed rather than clipped or crushed

soft_light_shadow_edge_relation.text: A relatively large acting source keeps one readable direction while producing broad shadow-edge transitions, gradual form modeling, broad specular response, and open but still shaped shadows. | one readable source direction survives instead of becoming flat ambient wash | cast and form shadow edges cross a broad gradual transition | curved forms move progressively from light through midtone into shadow | specular response spreads broadly across compatible glossy surfaces | shadow detail remains open while contours and volume stay legible

loop_face_light_pattern.text: An elevated off-axis key creates a short nose shadow that falls down and slightly sideways but remains visibly separated from the cheek shadow, preserving modeled cheeks and a readable far eye. | one elevated off-axis key owns the face lighting | the nose shadow falls downward and slightly toward the shadow side | the nose shadow remains clearly separated from the cheek shadow mass | both cheeks retain modeled light-to-shadow structure and the far eye remains readable | the geometry excludes a Rembrandt triangle split midline and centered butterfly shadow

butterfly_face_light_pattern.text: A high near-frontal key creates a compact centered shadow directly beneath the nose with largely symmetrical cheek illumination and upper catchlights, without the lower-return evidence that defines clamshell light. | one dominant key sits high and close to the camera axis | a compact shadow falls directly beneath the nose near the facial centerline | left and right cheek illumination remains broadly symmetrical | upper catchlights and gentle cheek-jaw modeling remain visible | the dominant upper single-key geometry remains distinct from lower-return or high-low catchlight-pair patterns

split_face_light_pattern.text: A near-side key produces a clear face-center division so one half is illuminated and the other half remains modeled shadow, while the head contour and shadow-side structure stay readable enough to distinguish the pattern from silhouette. | one side key approaches a lateral ninety-degree relation to the face | the principal light-shadow boundary tracks the nose and face center region | one face half is decisively illuminated while the other is decisively shadowed | the shadow half preserves eye contour cheek and jaw structure | the face remains a two-sided modeled subject rather than a solid silhouette or broad-light turn

broad_face_light_orientation_relation.text: A turned face presents one visibly broader cheek plane to the camera and that broader visible plane receives the dominant light, while the narrower far plane carries the primary shadow. | the head turn makes one cheek plane visibly broader to the camera | the camera-broad cheek plane receives the dominant key illumination | the narrower far plane carries the primary modeled shadow | nose cheek eye and jaw cues preserve both face orientation and light ownership | the relation is defined by camera-facing area rather than fixed left or right side

short_face_light_orientation_relation.text: A turned face presents one narrow far cheek plane to the camera and that narrow plane receives the dominant light, leaving the broader camera-facing cheek in modeled shadow. | the head turn makes one cheek plane narrow and the opposite cheek broad to the camera | the camera-narrow cheek plane receives the dominant key illumination | the broad near cheek carries the primary modeled shadow | face contour eye line and nose direction remain readable through the shadow | the relation is defined by camera-facing area rather than fixed left or right side

key_fill_separation_background_roles.text: A primary key models the subject, a subordinate fill opens the key-owned shadows without a second opposing shadow, a rear or side edge separates the subject, and background illumination supports rather than erases that hierarchy. | one primary key direction owns the subject form and principal shadow | a weaker broad fill opens that same shadow without creating an opposing double shadow | a controlled rear or side edge separates at least one subject contour from the background | background light supplies texture color or directional support without flattening the subject | the four roles remain hierarchically distinct rather than becoming even omnidirectional illumination

backlit_rim_edge_separation_relation.text: A rear or rear-side source creates a narrow coherent luminous contour along selected subject edges while front or side modeling remains readable and the contour visibly separates the subject from the background. | a rear or rear-side source direction is consistent across illuminated edges | a narrow rim follows actual hair shoulder object or material contours | the front or side of the subject retains readable form and detail | the bright edge creates local separation from a darker or similar-toned background | the contour remains selective and plausible rather than a uniform cutout halo

backlit_silhouette_mass_relation.text: A bright field behind the subject leaves the subject as a predominantly dark connected mass whose outer contour and pose are immediately readable while internal front detail is intentionally minimal. | a bright background or source field clearly sits behind the subject | the subject reads as one predominantly dark connected mass | the outer contour pose and major negative spaces remain immediately legible | internal front-facing texture and facial detail stay intentionally minimal | a thin rim or merely dark exposure does not substitute for the mass-background relation

high_key_tonal_distribution.text: Most of the frame occupies light tonal regions with open shallow shadows, preserved white and highlight detail, a low-to-moderate key-fill difference, and enough edge or color separation to keep the subject distinct. | light tones occupy most of the frame without erasing the principal subject | shadows remain shallow open and visibly shaped rather than absent | white surfaces and bright highlights preserve texture below clipping | key and fill differ modestly while one modeling direction remains readable | subject edges stay separated by contour tone or color within the bright field

low_key_selective_illumination.text: Dark tonal regions dominate, but selected subject planes receive deliberate readable illumination, shadow structure remains differentiated, highlights retain detail, and the frame hierarchy cannot be explained by global underexposure. | dark tonal regions dominate the frame by deliberate spatial design | selected face object or material planes receive coherent directional light | shadow regions retain more than one density and preserve structural clues | small highlights remain controlled and detailed rather than clipped | correctly exposed lit regions prove selective illumination rather than global underexposure

chiaroscuro_form_modeling_relation.text: Directional light and connected shadow masses model three-dimensional volume through diffused values, specular accents, form shadows, and transitional midtones, making contrast serve shape rather than darkness alone. | one dominant direction organizes illuminated and shadowed planes | light-dark boundaries follow three-dimensional face object or drapery form | diffuse value specular accent and form shadow remain distinguishable | midtone transitions connect selected highlights to deep but structured shadows | the composition uses alternating light and dark masses to guide form and attention

tenebrist_dark_field_isolation.text: A predominantly dark field contains one or a few abruptly isolated coherent pools of illumination whose protected local detail and sparse peripheral clues create a concentrated hierarchy more extreme than ordinary low-key light. | a continuous dark field dominates the background and much of the subject environment | one or a few coherent light pools isolate the principal action or form | light-to-dark transition is abrupt enough to create a concentrated hierarchy | the isolated lit area preserves color texture and highlight detail | sparse peripheral clues maintain spatial context without filling the dark field

direct_on_camera_flash_snapshot_signatur.text: A small near-camera-axis flash makes the near subject abruptly bright with compact specular hotspots and a hard shadow close behind, while ambient distance falls darker or remains separately exposed. | the dominant flash direction stays close to the camera viewing axis | a crisp cast shadow falls close behind the near subject on available surfaces | skin glossy fabric or objects show compact frontal specular hotspots | the near subject is much brighter than a more distant ambient background | some ambient or spatial background evidence remains instead of a white clipped void

motivated_practical_mixed_interior_relat.text: A visible practical source owns a nearby pool whose direction and color continue onto the subject, while a distinct ambient zone remains spatially coherent and all major shadows can be assigned without contradiction. | at least one plausible practical source is visible within the scene | a nearby brightness and color pool falls off outward from that source | light reaching the subject matches the practical's plausible direction and color family | a second ambient zone remains spatially distinct in color brightness or direction | cast and form shadows have coherent source ownership without teal-orange grade substitution

volumetric_occluded_light_shafts.text: A coherent source direction passes through or around identifiable occluders into a scattering medium, forming separated shafts that continue to visible receiving surfaces and shadow gaps. | one coherent source direction anchors every visible shaft | a window cloud foliage architecture or gobo provides identifiable occlusion gaps | haze dust mist or atmosphere makes the light path visible within volume | separate bright shafts and darker gaps preserve the occluder's pattern | at least one shaft lands plausibly on a subject floor wall or atmospheric layer

golden_hour_low_sun_relation.text: A low horizon-side warm direct source creates long shadows and grazing or rim highlights while cooler or neutral open-sky fill preserves the shadow side; color alone does not establish the relation. | the dominant direct source arrives from a visibly low horizon-side direction | cast shadows extend long across readable ground or architecture | warm grazing backlight or rim light traces selected contours and textures | cooler or neutral open-sky fill preserves readable shadow-side information | spatial direction and shadow length distinguish the look from a global warm grade

blue_hour_ambient_practical_balance.text: Cool twilight sky ambient remains bright enough to reveal environment and subject contours while localized warm practical pools are visible and balanced, with no direct sun and no substitution by a cyan night grade. | a cool twilight sky or open ambient field remains visibly luminous | no direct sun disk or hard high-sun shadow owns the scene | warm practical sources create localized pools on streets windows or subjects | cool twilight ambient and localized warm practicals own the scene instead of a direct sun disk or hard high-sun shadow | ambient and practical exposure remain balanced so neither becomes a blank field | architecture and subject contours preserve cool-warm spatial separation

lens_ghosting_flare_alignment.text: A strong source near or inside the frame generates one or more secondary translucent ghost shapes whose positions, scale changes, and optical repetition align coherently with the source and lens axis. | one strong source near or inside the frame anchors the optical effect | one or more secondary translucent ghost shapes are spatially displaced from the source | the ghost sequence follows a coherent source-to-frame-center or lens-axis alignment | ghost scale color and opacity vary as related internal-reflection images rather than random stickers | scene detail outside the ghost path remains distinct enough to separate ghosting from veiling haze

veiling_flare_contrast_loss_relation.text: A strong source near or inside the frame spreads a broad optical veil that lowers black density and local contrast more strongly toward the source while preserving a directional gradient across the scene. | one bright source near or inside the frame plausibly drives the veil | a broad translucent haze spreads from the source-side region | black density and local edge contrast decrease within that region | the contrast loss follows a directional gradient instead of covering the frame uniformly | some unaffected reference region remains for comparison against fog or low-contrast grading

film_halation_highlight_edge_relation.text: Very bright highlight boundaries carry a thin localized warm or red-biased halo just outside the exposed edge, while the highlight core and surrounding nonhighlight detail remain sufficiently structured to reject global glow and flare. | one or more genuinely high-luminance edges anchor the effect | a thin warm or red-biased halo sits immediately outside those edges | halo width and intensity fall off locally rather than covering the frame | highlight core shape and adjacent nonhighlight detail remain readable | aligned ghost orbs broad veiling haze and chromatic edge pairs remain visibly distinct from the thin local halo

third_grid_focal_anchor_relation.text: One unmistakable primary visual anchor sits near a thirds-line intersection, remains clearly off the frame center, and preserves enough surrounding field to make the placement a compositional relation rather than a grid graphic or incidental crop. | an adult figure occupies the lower-left thirds crossing while the harbor and travel direction remain readable | 주 피사체 핵심이 화면 중앙을 벗어난 삼분할 교차점 근처에 있고 주변 장면이 충분히 보임 | the focal object holds an off-center thirds anchor without losing the scene that explains it | one primary focal anchor lies near a visible thirds-line intersection | 하나의 주 초점 기준물이 삼분할선 교차점 근처에 놓임 | the primary anchor remains unmistakably displaced from the exact frame center | 주 기준물이 화면 정중앙에서 분명히 벗어남 | enough surrounding field remains visible to explain the anchor's spatial relation | 기준물의 공간 관계를 설명할 주변 영역이 충분히 보임 | the relation is carried by subject placement rather than a visible grid overlay or accidental crop | 관계가 격자 오버레이나 우연한 크롭이 아니라 피사체 배치로 드러남 | off-center thirds anchor | single primary focal point | readable surrounding field | placement rather than overlay

centered_primary_anchor_relation.text: The identity-bearing or action-bearing part of one primary subject intersects the true frame center, surrounding margins reinforce its central dominance, and the center remains the first visual read without requiring mirrored scenery. | a clock repairer's hands and face align to the exact center while the workshop recedes around that axis | 주 피사체의 핵심 행동점이 화면 정중앙에 걸리고 주변 요소가 중앙성을 지지함 | the central anchor dominates even though left and right background details are not identical | one identity-bearing or action-bearing primary anchor intersects the true frame center | 하나의 정체성 또는 행동 핵심 기준물이 화면 정중앙과 만남 | the centered anchor remains the unmistakable first visual read | 중앙 기준물이 분명한 첫 시각 읽기로 유지됨 | surrounding margins and subordinate elements reinforce the anchor's central position | 주변 여백과 보조 요소가 기준물의 중앙 위치를 강화함 | centrality is proven by the primary anchor and does not depend on mirrored background decoration | 중앙성은 주 기준물로 증명되며 배경 장식의 좌우 대칭에 의존하지 않음 | true frame-center anchor | single central first read | supportive surrounding margins | centrality without required symmetry

axial_bilateral_symmetry_relation.text: One explicit vertical or diagonal axis organizes corresponding masses on both sides, with paired contours, spacing, and visual weight remaining recognizably matched while a central anchor binds the two halves. | paired conservatory arches and worktables mirror each other around the adult subject on the center aisle | 명확한 중심축 양쪽의 형태와 간격이 대응하고 중앙 기준물이 두 절반을 묶음 | two scene halves remain measurably correspondent beyond merely placing one object in the middle | one explicit scene axis remains continuously readable through the composition | 하나의 명확한 장면 축이 구도 전체에서 연속적으로 읽힘 | paired contours or objects correspond on opposite sides of that axis | 대응하는 윤곽 또는 물체가 축의 반대쪽에 짝으로 놓임 | spacing and visual weight remain recognizably matched across the two halves | 간격과 시각 무게가 두 절반 사이에서 알아볼 수 있게 대응함 | the bilateral relation extends beyond a single centered object or isolated reflection | 좌우 관계가 단일 중앙 물체나 고립된 반사보다 넓게 이어짐 | explicit scene axis | paired opposite contours | matched spacing and weight | bilateral relation beyond one object

asymmetric_counterbalance_relation.text: A dominant off-center primary mass is balanced across the field by a smaller but visually stronger secondary cue, while intervening space keeps the two weights distinct and the total frame intentionally stable. | a large adult figure at one edge is counterweighted by a small bright lantern across an open rain-dark field | 큰 오프센터 주 피사체와 떨어진 작은 고대비 요소가 빈 공간을 사이에 두고 균형을 만듦 | unequal forms reach equilibrium through scale, contrast, and separation rather than mirror matching | one dominant primary mass occupies a clearly off-center region | 하나의 지배적인 주 덩어리가 분명한 오프센터 영역을 차지함 | a smaller separated cue gains enough contrast or meaning to counterweight the primary mass | 떨어진 작은 단서가 충분한 대비 또는 의미로 주 덩어리의 무게를 상쇄함 | intervening open or low-detail space keeps the unequal weights spatially distinct | 사이의 열린 또는 저정보 공간이 불균등한 무게를 공간적으로 구분함 | the equilibrium follows deliberate scale contrast and separation rather than bilateral matching or random clutter | 균형이 좌우 대응이나 무작위 혼잡이 아니라 의도한 크기 대비와 분리에서 생김 | dominant off-center mass | smaller high-value counterweight | separating open field | unequal but stable balance

leading_line_target_continuity.text: One continuous physical line or aligned scene edge enters away from the subject, travels visibly through the frame, and terminates at the primary target with no stronger competing endpoint interrupting the viewing path. | wet rail edges begin at a lower corner and continue without interruption to the adult courier's hand | 화면 가장자리에서 시작한 실제 선이 중간에 끊기지 않고 주 피사체에 도달함 | a path of repeated aligned edges delivers the eye to one subject rather than merely pointing toward a vanishing point | one physical line or aligned edge begins away from the primary subject | 하나의 실제 선 또는 정렬된 경계가 주 피사체와 떨어진 곳에서 시작함 | the line remains visibly continuous or rhythmically linked across the intervening frame | 유도선이 사이 화면을 가로질러 연속적 또는 리듬 있게 연결됨 | the line terminates at the primary target's identity-bearing or action-bearing anchor | 유도선이 주 목표의 정체성 또는 행동 핵심 기준물에서 끝남 | the viewing route avoids a stronger competing endpoint and is not decorative striping or speed graphics | 시선 경로가 더 강한 경쟁 끝점을 피하며 장식 줄무늬나 속도 그래픽이 아님 | distant line origin | continuous physical eye path | target termination | single dominant endpoint

look_motion_room_direction_relation.text: A visible gaze, body-travel, or action vector establishes one direction, the subject's origin remains inside the frame, and noticeably more usable open space lies ahead of that vector than behind it. | the cyclist travels toward camera right and the frame leaves a wider readable pier ahead than behind the rear wheel | 인물의 시선 또는 이동 벡터가 분명하고 그 앞쪽 여백이 뒤쪽보다 눈에 띄게 큼 | open space extends the action direction rather than appearing on an unrelated side | one visible gaze body-travel or carried-action vector defines a clear direction | 하나의 가시적 시선 몸 이동 또는 행동 벡터가 분명한 방향을 정함 | the subject or action origin remains visibly inside the frame | 피사체 또는 행동 시작점이 화면 안에 보이게 남음 | the frame preserves noticeably more usable open space ahead of the vector than behind it | 화면이 벡터 뒤보다 앞에 눈에 띄게 더 큰 사용 가능한 여백을 남김 | the open field extends the declared direction rather than sitting on an unrelated side or behind the subject | 열린 영역이 무관한 쪽이나 피사체 뒤가 아니라 선언된 방향을 연장함 | visible direction vector | in-frame action origin | greater room ahead | directionally relevant open field

subject_field_negative_space_relation.text: One large contiguous low-detail field remains visibly simpler than the primary subject, separates cleanly from its contour, and strengthens the subject's hierarchy while retaining enough tonal or material information to read as intentional space. | a small adult subject is isolated against a broad misty wall whose subtle texture remains visible | 넓고 연속된 저정보 영역이 피사체 윤곽과 분리되고 의도한 여백으로 읽힘 | the open field carries calm visual weight instead of reading as missing scenery or crushed blacks | one large contiguous low-detail field occupies a substantial part of the frame | 하나의 크고 연속된 저정보 영역이 화면의 상당 부분을 차지함 | the primary subject contour separates cleanly from that simpler field | 주 피사체 윤곽이 더 단순한 영역에서 선명하게 분리됨 | the low-detail field visibly strengthens the subject's first-read hierarchy | 저정보 영역이 피사체의 첫 읽기 위계를 눈에 띄게 강화함 | subtle tonal or material information keeps the field intentional rather than an empty crop or lost exposure | 미세한 톤 또는 재질 정보가 영역을 빈 크롭이나 노출 손실이 아닌 의도한 공간으로 유지함 | large contiguous low-detail field | clean subject contour | strengthened first-read hierarchy | intentional tonal field

frame_within_frame_boundary_relation.text: A physical scene-bound foreground opening encloses the primary subject on multiple sides, its thickness or occlusion proves that it occupies a nearer plane, and the subject remains legible through the opening. | an adult conservator is surrounded by the near arch and door jamb while the recess depth remains visible | 실제 전경 개구부가 여러 방향에서 피사체를 둘러싸고 경계 두께와 가림이 깊이를 증명함 | the subject is framed by architecture or foliage that belongs to the photographed space rather than a graphic border | one physical foreground opening belongs visibly to the photographed scene | 하나의 실제 전경 개구부가 촬영된 장면에 속한 것으로 분명히 보임 | the opening encloses the primary subject on at least three readable sides | 개구부가 읽을 수 있는 최소 세 방향에서 주 피사체를 둘러쌈 | boundary thickness overlap or occlusion proves a nearer foreground plane | 경계의 두께 겹침 또는 가림이 더 가까운 전경 면을 증명함 | the subject remains legible through the opening and the enclosure is not a digital vignette or graphic border | 피사체가 개구부 안에서 읽히며 둘레가 디지털 비네팅이나 그래픽 테두리가 아님 | scene-bound foreground opening | three-sided enclosure | near-plane thickness and occlusion | legible subject through opening

three_plane_depth_chain.text: Distinct foreground, middle-distance, and background anchors remain readable in one continuous space, with coherent overlap and scale recession linking each adjacent plane rather than merely listing three objects or blurring the backdrop. | a near glass edge overlaps an adult subject in the middle distance while a smaller greenhouse door anchors the background | 전경 중경 배경 기준물이 각각 보이고 겹침과 크기 변화가 인접 층을 이어 줌 | three depth planes form one navigable scene instead of three flat bands | distinct foreground middle-distance and background anchors are all simultaneously readable | 서로 다른 전경 중경 배경 기준물이 모두 동시에 읽힘 | coherent partial occlusion links the foreground to the middle distance and the middle distance to the background | 일관된 부분 가림이 전경과 중경 그리고 중경과 배경을 연결함 | relative scale or atmospheric change recedes consistently from near to far | 상대 크기 또는 대기 변화가 가까운 곳에서 먼 곳으로 일관되게 후퇴함 | the three anchors occupy one continuous navigable space rather than flat bands a collage or background blur alone | 세 기준물이 평면 띠 콜라주 또는 배경 흐림만이 아니라 하나의 연속된 이동 가능 공간을 차지함 | three readable plane anchors | adjacent-plane occlusion | near-to-far scale recession | continuous navigable space

pattern_break_focal_exception.text: A sufficiently long baseline of similar repeated forms establishes one readable rhythm, exactly one local exception breaks a single salient property, and that exception becomes the first focal read while the surrounding pattern remains intact. | a row of identical gray umbrellas establishes rhythm while one open amber umbrella becomes the sole focal break | 충분히 반복된 동일 형태 속 하나의 색 또는 방향 예외만 첫 초점으로 읽힘 | the viewer reads both the rule and the one violation at thumbnail scale | at least four similar forms establish one stable repeated visual baseline | 최소 네 개의 유사한 형태가 하나의 안정된 반복 기준을 만듦 | exactly one local element breaks color orientation spacing or state relative to that baseline | 정확히 하나의 국소 요소가 반복 기준과 비교해 색 방향 간격 또는 상태를 깸 | the single exception becomes the unmistakable first focal read while the baseline stays legible | 단일 예외가 분명한 첫 초점이 되면서 반복 기준도 계속 읽힘 | the relation remains one rule and one exception rather than random variety several anomalies or chaotic texture | 관계가 무작위 다양성 여러 이상 또는 혼란한 질감이 아니라 하나의 규칙과 하나의 예외로 유지됨 | stable repeated baseline | single local exception | exception as first focal read | one rule and one break

primary_secondary_figure_ground_hierarch.text: One primary figure owns the strongest edge, contrast, or semantic signal, a secondary element remains visibly subordinate yet readable, and the background supplies separation without competing for first attention. | the adult face and working hand read first, a small brass tool reads second, and greenhouse detail stays supportive | 주 도형이 가장 강한 경계와 대비를 갖고 보조 요소와 배경이 단계적으로 낮아짐 | three attention levels survive without relying on blur as the only separator | one primary figure owns the frame's strongest edge contrast or semantic signal | 하나의 주 도형이 화면에서 가장 강한 경계 대비 또는 의미 신호를 가짐 | one secondary element remains readable but visibly subordinate to the primary figure | 하나의 보조 요소가 읽히지만 주 도형보다 분명히 종속됨 | the background separates and supports both figures without competing for first attention | 배경이 첫 시선을 경쟁하지 않으면서 두 도형을 분리하고 지지함 | the three attention levels follow edge contrast scale or meaning rather than background blur alone | 세 주의 단계가 배경 흐림만이 아니라 경계 대비 크기 또는 의미에서 생김 | strongest primary signal | readable subordinate secondary | supportive background separation | three attention levels

peak_action_event_phase.text: The photograph freezes an unstable mid-action instant in which a visible cause, a directional body or object trajectory, and an immediate consequence already beginning remain simultaneously legible before the event settles. | wind tears one paper panel free as the adult installer reaches across and the first fastener bends visibly | 가시적 원인과 진행 중 궤적과 즉시 시작된 결과가 사건이 끝나기 전에 한 프레임에 함께 보임 | the frame catches the point of maximum change rather than a posed anticipation or completed aftermath | one visible cause or trigger remains identifiable inside the frame | 하나의 가시적 원인 또는 촉발 요소가 화면 안에서 식별됨 | a body limb fabric liquid or object shows one directional trajectory in mid-transition | 몸 팔다리 천 액체 또는 물체가 전환 중 하나의 방향 궤적을 보임 | one immediate physical consequence has already begun but has not reached a settled endpoint | 하나의 즉시 물리적 결과가 이미 시작됐지만 안정된 끝점에 도달하지 않음 | cause trajectory and consequence coexist in the same instant rather than a before pose completed aftermath or decorative speed graphic | 원인 궤적 결과가 이전 포즈 완료된 사후 장면 또는 장식 속도 그래픽이 아니라 같은 순간에 공존함 | visible in-frame cause | directional mid-transition trajectory | immediate unfinished consequence | single decisive instant

mirror_selfie_reflection_device_topology.text: A physical mirror boundary contains both one clearly adult subject's reflection and the phone held by that subject. The reflected gaze, hand-device contact, mirror-plane depth, and occlusion agree as one capture topology, so a direct front-camera selfie, an empty reflection, or an arbitrary phone cannot substitute. | the mirror edge and reflected room establish a physical plane containing both the adult subject and her held phone | 거울 경계 안에서 성인 피사체와 손에 든 휴대폰이 같은 반사 공간을 공유함 | the subject's reflection gaze and phone occlusion agree with the mirror rather than a software frame | a visible mirror edge thickness seam or reflected-room discontinuity establishes one physical reflective plane | 거울 테두리 두께 이음 또는 반사된 공간 차이가 물리 반사면을 증명함 | one clearly adult subject's face hair and body appear inside that same reflected space | 한 명의 분명한 성인 피사체 얼굴 머리카락 몸이 같은 반사 공간 안에 보임 | the reflected subject visibly grips one phone and the hand-to-device contact remains anatomically coherent | 반사된 피사체가 휴대폰 하나를 실제로 쥐고 손과 기기 접촉이 일관됨 | reflection gaze phone placement and any facial occlusion agree with the mirror geometry | 반사 시선 휴대폰 위치와 얼굴 가림이 거울 기하와 일치함 | a direct selfie empty mirror detached phone phone-screen image or software border does not substitute | 직접 셀피 빈 거울 분리된 휴대폰 화면 사진 또는 소프트웨어 테두리는 대체하지 못함 | physical mirror plane | adult subject and held phone inside reflection | coherent reflection gaze and occlusion | hand-device contact | not direct selfie or software frame

overhead_social_snapshot_relation.text: A camera visibly close above one clearly adult subject looks steeply downward. A surrounding ground plane, upward response, coherent top-down body foreshortening, and enlarged near hand or prop establish the elevated relation without turning a drone view, eye-level crop, or isolated stretched limb into an overhead portrait. | a crouching adult looks up toward a nearby high camera while pavement radiates around the body and one raised hand becomes the near anchor | 가까운 상공 카메라와 바닥면과 위로 향한 반응이 같은 수직 관계를 보임 | top-down foreshortening remains coherent across head torso limbs and a raised prop | the camera is visibly close above one clearly adult subject and points steeply downward | 카메라가 분명한 성인 피사체 가까운 위쪽에서 가파르게 아래를 향함 | a readable ground or floor plane surrounds the subject and anchors the vertical separation | 읽히는 바닥면이 피사체 주위를 둘러싸며 수직 거리를 고정함 | the subject's face gaze or raised hand responds toward the elevated camera position | 피사체 얼굴 시선 또는 든 손이 위쪽 카메라 위치를 향해 반응함 | head torso limbs and one near prop follow coherent top-down foreshortening and scale change | 머리 몸통 팔다리와 가까운 소품이 일관된 탑다운 단축과 크기 변화를 따름 | a drone landscape eye-level crop telephoto view or isolated stretched limb does not substitute | 드론 풍경 아이레벨 크롭 망원 시점 또는 한 팔다리 늘리기는 대체하지 못함 | near elevated camera | surrounding ground plane | upward subject response | coherent top-down foreshortening | not drone or eye-level crop

intentional_face_occluded_mood_portrait.text: One clearly adult subject remains readable through hair, posture, hands, clothing, and action while a scene-bound hand, prop, hair curtain, or deliberate head turn covers the identity-bearing eye-and-nose region. The occluder has visible contact or overlap, and setting plus action carries the mood; accidental crop, missed focus, total silhouette, or an absent face cannot substitute. | a broad pressed fern held by the adult subject overlaps both eyes and the nose bridge while her hands and seed-sorting action remain clear | 소품 접촉이 눈과 콧대 식별 영역을 의도적으로 가리되 성인 인물의 행동과 장소는 읽힘 | mood comes from storm light and an unfinished task rather than a missing or blurred face | one clearly adult subject remains readable through hair posture hands clothing and body orientation | 한 명의 분명한 성인 피사체가 머리카락 자세 손 의상 몸 방향으로 계속 읽힘 | the eye-and-nose identity-bearing region is deliberately covered or turned away while some surrounding head structure remains visible | 눈과 코의 식별 영역은 의도적으로 가려지거나 돌아가고 주변 머리 구조 일부는 남음 | a scene-bound hand prop hair curtain or head turn has visible overlap contact or directional cause | 장면 속 손 소품 머리카락 또는 머리 회전이 가시적 겹침 접촉 또는 방향 원인을 가짐 | one concrete unfinished action and one identifiable setting carry the image's mood | 하나의 구체적인 미완 행동과 식별 가능한 장소가 이미지의 무드를 전달함 | accidental crop missed focus motion blur empty scene or full silhouette alone does not substitute | 우연한 크롭 초점 실패 모션 블러 빈 장면 또는 전신 실루엣만으로는 대체하지 못함 | clearly adult subject remains readable | eye-and-nose identity zone deliberately hidden | scene-bound occluder contact | action and setting carry mood | not accidental crop or blur

sheer_complexion_texture_preservation.text: A thin cosmetic correction lightly evens the complexion while pores, fine texture, and local natural color variation remain visible. Coverage amount stays separate from surface shine and lighting; literal transparency, full opaque coverage, overexposure, digital blur, or plastic smoothing cannot substitute. | thin tone correction evens broad color while pores and small local variation remain readable | 얇은 톤 보정 아래 모공 잔결과 국소 색 변화가 남음 | surface highlight may vary independently from the preserved low-coverage texture | a thin cosmetic layer lightly evens broad complexion tone without opaque masking | 얇은 화장층이 불투명하게 덮지 않고 넓은 피부톤을 가볍게 고름 | pores fine texture and small surface irregularities remain visible through the correction | 보정 아래 모공 잔결과 작은 표면 불균일이 계속 보임 | subtle local natural color variation remains instead of one uniform painted skin color | 하나의 균일한 페인트 피부색 대신 미세한 국소 자연 색 변화가 남음 | surface shine lighting and grading remain separate and literal transparency blur overexposure or plastic smoothing does not substitute | 표면 광 조명 색보정은 분리되며 문자 그대로의 투명함 블러 과노출 플라스틱 보정은 대체하지 못함 | thin complexion correction | visible pores and fine texture | local natural color variation | coverage separate from finish | not transparency blur or overexposure

under_eye_high_cheek_blush_distribution.text: Bilateral cosmetic pigment occupies the upper cheek directly below, but not inside, the lower-eyelid boundary. Its hue, soft edge, and controlled placement distinguish blush from dark circles, fatigue shadow, tears, eye irritation, or generalized facial redness. | soft rose pigment sits on both upper cheeks immediately beneath the lower lids with a narrow clean eye boundary | 양쪽 눈 아래 높은 볼에 화장 색소가 놓이고 눈 점막과는 경계가 남음 | the color reads as controlled cosmetic placement rather than shadow irritation or tears | bilateral cosmetic color occupies both upper cheeks directly below the lower eyelids | 양쪽 아래눈꺼풀 바로 밑 높은 볼에 화장 색이 대칭적으로 놓임 | a narrow clean skin boundary keeps pigment outside the eye and lower-lid margin | 좁고 깨끗한 피부 경계가 색소를 눈과 아래눈꺼풀 가장자리 밖에 유지함 | the cheek pigment has controlled soft cosmetic edges and a readable blush hue | 볼 색소가 제어된 부드러운 화장 경계와 읽히는 블러셔 색을 가짐 | dark circles fatigue shadow tears irritation and generalized redness do not substitute | 다크서클 피로 그림자 눈물 자극과 얼굴 전체 홍조는 대체하지 못함 | bilateral upper-cheek cosmetic pigment | lower-lid-adjacent placement | clean eye boundary | soft blush edge | not dark circles or irritation

cheekbone_temple_blush_drape.text: A continuous elongated path of cosmetic pigment begins on each high cheekbone and blends upward-outward toward the corresponding temple. Color continuity, tapered diffusion, and bilateral placement distinguish the drape from facial anatomy, contour stripes, cast shadow, or colored light. | rose pigment starts high on both cheeks and remains visibly continuous as it thins toward each temple | 양쪽 높은 광대에서 관자놀이까지 색소가 위쪽 바깥 방향으로 이어짐 | soft tapered edges preserve a blush path instead of a hard contour stripe or lighting gradient | cosmetic pigment begins visibly on both high cheekbones | 화장 색소가 양쪽 높은 광대에서 분명히 시작함 | the pigment remains continuously readable along an upward-outward path toward both temples | 색소가 양쪽 관자놀이를 향한 위쪽 바깥 방향 경로로 계속 읽힘 | soft tapered edges thin gradually at the temple ends while preserving a recognizable blush hue | 부드럽게 가늘어지는 경계가 관자놀이 끝에서 점차 옅어지며 블러셔 색을 유지함 | facial anatomy contour stripes cast shadow and colored lighting do not substitute | 얼굴 해부학 윤곽선 캐스트 섀도와 유색 조명은 대체하지 못함 | bilateral high-cheek origin | continuous upward-outward pigment path | temple endpoint | soft tapered edges | not anatomy shadow or contour

photobooth_four_cut_sequence.text: Exactly four separated photobooth panels show the same clearly adult subject in one stable booth setup. Crop, background, and lighting remain coherent while pose, gaze, or hand action changes in a readable temporal progression; a single photo, random collage, duplicated tile, contact sheet, or illustrated comic cannot substitute. | four equal booth panels repeat the same adult, backdrop, crop, and frontal light while each frame advances a different hand-and-gaze beat | 정확히 네 패널에서 같은 성인 피사체와 부스 조건은 유지되고 포즈만 순차적으로 달라짐 | physical strip gutters separate a coherent timed sequence rather than four unrelated images | exactly four discrete image panels are separated by consistent photobooth gutters | 정확히 네 개의 개별 이미지 패널이 일관된 포토부스 여백으로 구분됨 | the same clearly adult subject with stable visible appearance repeats in all four panels | 같은 분명한 성인 피사체와 안정된 보이는 외형이 네 패널 모두에 반복됨 | camera crop booth background and frontal lighting remain substantially consistent across panels | 카메라 크롭 부스 배경과 정면 조명이 패널 사이에서 대체로 일관됨 | pose gaze or hand action changes across all four panels in one readable timed progression | 포즈 시선 또는 손동작이 네 패널에 걸쳐 읽히는 시간 진행으로 달라짐 | a single portrait random collage duplicated tile contact sheet or comic strip does not substitute | 단일 인물사진 무작위 콜라주 복제 타일 컨택트 시트 또는 만화 칸은 대체하지 못함 | exactly four separated panels | same clearly adult subject | stable booth setup | four distinct sequential poses | not collage duplicate or comic

adult_everyday_controlled_reveal_moment.text: One unmistakably adult subject continues a concrete self-directed everyday action that visibly changes or holds one exact stable garment boundary. That boundary reveals or re-covers one bounded, non-explicit target relation such as a shoulder or collarbone area, a side or back interval, or a clearly separate foundation layer. Face, action, setting, target, material edge, and gravity remain legible together, and the boundary is salient enough that closing or removing it would erase the controlled-reveal proposition. Exposure amount, generic opaque-over-opaque layering, an unrelated gesture, a body crop, or an apparently covert viewpoint cannot establish the meaning. | an adult fastening a cuff beside a window while one overlapping shirt edge and its contact shadow remain physically traceable | 성인 인물이 머리를 묶는 일상 동작을 계속하는 동안 한 개의 안정된 직물 가림 경계와 장소가 함께 읽힘 | the frame preserves face action room context and a
